questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Rearrange to make a meaningful paragraph:
A. Secondly, stretch your arms and legs to avoid injuries.
B. Finally, cool down with light stretch to relax your muscles.
C. Then, begin your main exercise such as running or cycling.
D. To do a physical exercise, first start with quick warm up like jogging.
questions.explanation: The logical order is: start with warm up (D) → then stretch to avoid injury (A) → then do the main exercise (C) → finally cool down (B) — i.e. D, A, C, B.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Rearrange to make a meaningful paragraph:
A. Fruits are healthy and delicious.
B. They are a great source of vitamins and minerals.
C. Therefore, eating fruits regularly can improve overall health.
D. Apples, bananas, and oranges are common examples of fruits.
questions.explanation: The logical order is: introduce the topic (A) → give examples (D) → explain why they're healthy (B) → conclude (C) — i.e. A, D, B, C.

options: I like eating apples bananas and oranges.

I like eating apples bananas, and oranges.
I like eating apples, bananas, and oranges.

my brother's birthday is in ianuary.

It was launched in China in 2016 under the name Douyin by the Chinese tech company ByteDance, and globally launched under the name TikTok in 2018. TikTok allows users to create short videos (15 to 60 seconds long) set to music or other audio, adding creative elements to make them more engaging. It is popular because it is fun and easy to use, user-friendly, encourages creativity and self-expression, and enables viral trends of popular songs or dances. The passage states TikTok was launched in China in 2016.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: According to the passage, how many colors make up a rainbow?
questions.explanation: Passage: "Rainbows" — Rainbows are multi-colored arcs made up of seven colors always in the same order: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet. They form when sunlight refracts, reflects, and disperses through water droplets. Sunlight looks white but actually contains all these colors; when a beam of light hits a water droplet at an angle it bends (refraction), and the colors separate to form a rainbow. Each color's wave slows and bends at a different angle inside the droplet, so different colors exit at different angles. Isaac Newton discovered white light contains the spectrum of colors that form the rainbow; a rainbow is actually a full circle of light that appears broken in half because we view it from the ground. It lists seven colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.

questions.explanation: Each color's wave slows down and bends at a different angle inside the water droplet, producing the fixed order of colors.

questions.subject: english

questions.subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The carpenter ______ different kinds of furniture. You can see them in the showroom.

questions.subject: english

options: The water in the bottle is dirty.
The merchant has a lot of money.
She put the new book on the shelf.
questions.explanation: "Book" can be counted (a book, two books), unlike milk, water, and money, which are uncountable.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: While she was riding on a bicycle, she ______ her friends and stopped to greet them.
questions.explanation: A simple past action ("met") interrupting a past continuous background action ("was riding") is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Before they announced the exact day of the meeting, they ______ on the issue.
questions.explanation: The past perfect "had discussed" shows the discussion happened before the earlier past action of announcing.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Belay usually uses a taxi when he goes to work, but ______ he walks on foot.

questions.subject: english

questions.subject: english
questions.q: If I understood the question, I ______ you how to solve it.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The trees in the park ______ by the environmental club members.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Lengitu is a clever student. She answered all the questions ______.

questions.q:
Samiro: ______ should be done to reduce car accidents in the town?
Kasech: The administration has to warn pedestrians to use walk ways.
questions.explanation: Kasech's answer describes an action to be taken, matching the question word "What".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Interviewer: Your English is getting better. ______ did you improve it?
Interviewee: I practice speaking every day and listen to different radio broadcasts in English.
questions.explanation: The interviewee explains a method/manner of improvement, matching "How".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Belete: ______ will win the 5000 meters race next week?
Yeshi: In my opinion Kenenisa will win.
questions.explanation: Yeshi names a person (Kenenisa) as the answer, matching "Who do you think".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Aster: You have to buy the latest smart phone.
Blen: ______, but it will be very expensive. I don't have much money.
questions.explanation: "I see your point" concedes Aster's suggestion before raising a concern ("but it will be very expensive"), unlike the flat disagreement options.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Amen: We have worked for three hours. Let's take a rest.
Fitsum: ______. I am also feeling tired.
questions.explanation: Fitsum agrees and gives a supporting reason (also feeling tired), matching "You are right".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Meaza: I couldn't read what the teachers write on the black board. ______?
Henok: I think you should sit at the front desk.
questions.explanation: Meaza is asking for advice about her own problem, matching "What should I do".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Senait: I like watching the moon at night. How about you?
Duguna: I ______ staying out at night because I'm afraid of darkness.
questions.explanation: Being afraid of darkness fits disliking staying out at night: "hate".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Argaw: Tell me one difference between you and your twin brother.
Hailu: I like reading books ______ my twin brother enjoys watching TV.
questions.explanation: "Whereas" shows contrast between the two different preferences, fitting a question about a difference.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence with the correct word order: music / to / she / listening / likes /
questions.explanation: The correctly ordered sentence is "She likes listening to music."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence with the correct word order: to / were / school / yesterday / we / late
options: To school we were late yesterday.
We were yesterday late to school.
Yesterday, we were to school late.
We were late to school yesterday.
questions.explanation: The correctly ordered sentence is "We were late to school yesterday."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph:
A. Others may bring back memories.
B. Some songs make people feel happy.
C. Music has the power to influence emotions.
D. That is why music is loved by people worldwide.
questions.explanation: The logical order is: state music influences emotions (C) → give an example, happy songs (B) → give another example, songs bringing back memories (A) → conclude why it's loved worldwide (D) — i.e. C, B, A, D.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Rearrange the sentences to make a meaningful paragraph:
A. This is why cooperation is important.
B. Each member contributes different skills.
C. Together they achieve goals more easily.
D. Teamwork is essential in many activities.
questions.explanation: The logical order is: introduce teamwork (D) → each member contributes skills (B) → together they achieve goals (C) → conclude cooperation is important (A) — i.e. D, B, C, A.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correctly punctuated and capitalized?
options: Fatuma works in the new hospital.
Fatuma works in the new hospital?
Fatuma works in the new hospital,
Fatuma works in the new hospital!
questions.explanation: A plain declarative statement should end with a period, not a question mark, comma, or exclamation mark.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correctly punctuated and capitalized?
options: almaz will go to Addis Ababa.
Almaz will go to Addis Ababa.
Almaz will go to addis ababa.
almaz will go to addis ababa.
questions.explanation: The first word of the sentence and both proper nouns ("Almaz" and "Addis Ababa") must be capitalized.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correctly punctuated and capitalized?
options: When, I saw him he ran away.
When I saw, him he ran away.
When I saw him he, ran away.
When I saw him, he ran away.
questions.explanation: A comma is needed after the introductory clause "When I saw him", before the main clause "he ran away".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Read the paragraph: "Many people enjoy reading books. Books can teach new ideas. They also help improve vocabulary. Reading can reduce stress. Some people read every day before bed. Reading books is a very helpful habit." Which is the topic sentence?
options: Some people read every day before bed.
questions.explanation: The topic sentence introduces the paragraph's general idea, which the other sentences then support: "Many people enjoy reading books."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Read the paragraph: "Exercise is important for good health. It makes the body strong. Exercise also improves feeling. People can walk, run, or play sports. Doing exercise every day is helpful. Regular exercise keeps people healthy." Which is the concluding sentence?
options: People can walk, run, or play sports.
questions.explanation: The concluding sentence sums up the paragraph's main point: "Regular exercise keeps people healthy."

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q:
ቀጥሎ የቀረበውን ምልልስ የተሟላ የሚያደርገው አማራጭ የቱ ነው?
በሃይሉ፦ እኛ ተማሪዎች ሃገራችንን መውደድ ይኖርብናል።
ሰብለ፦ የሃገር መውደድ በምን ይገለጻል?
በሃይሉ፦ አያቶቻችንን በፅናት እና በአንድነት ጣልያንን ድል አድርገዋል።
ሰብለ፦ አሁን ማድረግ የምንችለውን ንገሪኝ ነው የምልህ!
በሃይሉ፦ ______
questions.explanation: ውይይቱ ስለ ሃገር ፍቅርና ስለ ተማሪዎች ኃላፊነት ስለሆነ፣ ትክክለኛው ምላሽ ተምረው ሃገራቸውን የማገልገል ኃላፊነትን የሚያሳየው ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q:
ቀጥሎ የቀረበውን ሠንጠረዥ መሰረት በማድረግ የክስተቶችን ትክክለኛ ቅደም ተከተል የሚያሳየው የቱ ነው?
1. ርቤል በ2004 ዓ.ም ተወለደ።
2. በ2018 ዓ.ም የ8ኛ ክፍል ፈተና በመፈተን ላይ ነው።
3. በ2016 ዓ.ም የ6ኛ ክፍል ክልላዊ ፈተና ተፈትኖ 100% አገኘ።
4. እድሜው ለትምህርት ሲደርስ በ2008 ዓ.ም ወደ ህፃናት ማቆያ ገባ።
questions.explanation: በዘመን ቅደም ተከተል፦ ተወለደ (2004፣ #1) → ወደ ህፃናት ማቆያ ገባ (2008፣ #4) → 6ኛ ክፍል ፈተና 100% አገኘ (2016፣ #3) → 8ኛ ክፍል እየተፈተነ ነው (2018፣ #2)። ማለትም 1፡4፡3፡2።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሁለት ሰዎች ወይም ሁለት ቡድኖች ዳኞችን በመመደብ የሚያደርጉት ስርዓት ያለው ሙግት ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ዳኞች ተመድበውለት፣ በስርዓት የሚካሄድ መደበኛ ሙግት "ክርክር" ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q:
ቀጥሎ የቀረበውን ምልልስ የተሟላ የሚያደርገው አማራጭ የቱ ነው?
አባት፦ ልጄ! ሰላምን ውደዳት! ለሰው አትጣላ።
ልጅ፦ እኔን እየመቱኝ ነው እኔ ስለሰላም እኮ ካንተ ተምሬያለሁ።
አባት፦ እንደሱ አትበል ልጄ! ተቻችሎ መኖር ያስፈልጋል።
ልጅ፦ በጣም ሲመቱኝ ነው እንጂ ትክክል ነህ።
አባት፦ ግቤዝ ልጄ! ስለዚህ አንተስ ምን ማድረግ አለብህ?
ልጅ፦ ______
options: ለሰላም ስል በድን ፈጥሬ ራሴን አስከብራለሁ።
questions.explanation: አባትየው ሰላምን መውደድና ላለመጣላት ስለሚመክሩት፣ ትክክለኛው ምላሽ ልጁ ራሱ መጣላትን ማቆም እንዳለበት የሚገልጸው ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የግለሰብ የሂይወት ታሪክ አፃፃፍን በሚመለከት ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ታሪኮችን ቀላል እና ግልፅ በሆነ ቋንቋ መግለፅ ብቻ ይበቃል።
ያበረከትነውን አስተዋፅኦ ብቻ በቅደም ተከተል ማቅረብ ይበቃል።
የራስን የትውልድ ስፍራና ዘመን በግልፅ ማስፈር ብቻ ይበቃል።
የግለሰቡን መረጃ መሰብሰብ፣ ማደራጀትና መፃፍ ያስፈልጋል።
questions.explanation: የሂይወት ታሪክ በትክክል ለመፃፍ መረጃ መሰብሰብ፣ በስርዓት ማደራጀትና ከዚያ መፃፍ ሙሉውን ሂደት ይወክላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "አየሩ በፋብሪካዎች ጭስ ስለተበከለ፣ ______" ለሚለው ምክንያት በባዶ ቦታው ላይ በውጤትነት ሊገባ የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አየር በፋብሪካ ጭስ በመበከሉ ምክንያት በቀጥታ የሚከሰተው ውጤት የሰዎች ጤና መታወክ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "______፤ ከትምህርት ቤት ተባረረ" ለሚለው ውጤት በባዶ ቦታው ላይ በምክንያትነት ሊገባ የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
options: ከሰፈሩ ልጆች ጋር ብዙ ጊዜ በመጫወቱ
questions.explanation: ከትምህርት ቤት መባረር የሚያስከትለው ዋነኛ ምክንያት የትምህርት ቤቱን ህግ ደጋግሞ መጣስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የውይይት አቀራረብ መመሪያን በሚመለከት ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ውጤታማ ውይይት ለማድረግ በርዕሱ ዙሪያ ቁልፍ ፍሬ ነገሮችን አስቀድሞ መለየት ተገቢ መመሪያ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "መሰላል" የሚለው ቃል በቀጥተኛ (ፍቃደኛ) ፍቺው የገባው በየትኛው ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው?
questions.explanation: "አምፖኑን ለመቀየር በመሰላል ወጣ" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ "መሰላል" ቀጥተኛ (ትክክለኛ) ትርጉሙን ይዞ ገብቷል — ለመውጣት የሚያገለግል መሳሪያ።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "እጅ በረዶ ሆነ" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የሚታየው ዘይቤ ______ ነው።
questions.explanation: "እጅ በረዶ ሆነ" የሚለው አነጋገር የተጋነነ ዘይቤ (እንቶኔ) ሲሆን፣ እጅ በጣም መቀዝቀዙን ለማጋነን የገባ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "በወፉ መጣሽ እማጣለሁ" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍቺ ______ ነው።
questions.explanation: በዚህ ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የተሰመረበት ቃል የሚያመለክተው "መጨረሻ"ን ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "እኩይ በመሆኑ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይፈሩታል" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍቺ ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: "እኩይ" ማለት "መጥፎ" ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ቤታቸው ኩታ ገጠም በመሆኑ አልፎ አልፎ እየተገናኙ ይወያያሉ" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍቺ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: "ኩታ ገጠም" ማለት ቤቶች እርስ በርስ "ማድ ለማድ" (ተያይዘው/ተጎራብተው) መሆናቸውን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "የእድገታቸው መነሻ እውቀት የዘሁ ሃገሮች ናቸው" የሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ትክክለኛ አቀማመጥ የትኛው ነው?
options: እውቀት የዘሁ ሃገሮች የእድገታቸው መነሻ ናቸው።
የእድገታቸው መነሻ እውቀት የዘሁ ሃገሮች ናቸው።
የዘሁ ሃገሮች የእድገታቸው መነሻ እውቀት ናቸው።
ሃገሮች የእድገታቸው መነሻ እውቀት የዘሁ ናቸው።
questions.explanation: ትክክለኛው የርዕሰ ጉዳይ-ተሳቢ አቀማመጥ 'እውቀት የዘሁ ሃገሮች የእድገታቸው መነሻ ናቸው' የሚለው ነው። (ይህ ጥያቄ ከዋናው ገጽ አነስተኛ ብዥታ ስላለበት በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የቢጋር (charts/diagrams) ጠቀሜታ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ጽሁፍ በሚፃፍበት ጊዜ የተካተተውን ሃሳብ ላለማገናዘብ ይጠቅማል።
ለአንባቢው ርዕሱን አስቀድሞ ለመወሰንና ለመምረጥ ይጠቅማል።
ለአንባቢው ጽሁፉን ለመረዳትና ለማቃናት ከፍተኛ ጠቀሜታ አለው።
questions.explanation: ቢጋር (ገበታ/ሠንጠረዥ) ዋና ጠቀሜታው ለአንባቢው ይዘቱን በቀላሉ እንዲረዳና እንዲያቃና የሚያግዝ መሆኑ ነው። (ይህ ጥያቄ ከዋናው ገጽ አነስተኛ ብዥታ ስላለበት በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ ሁለት መሰረት፣ ለሱስ ለተጋለጡ ወጣቶች የመጨረሻ ችግር የሚሆነው ነጥብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ምንባብ ሁለት — ስለ ሱስኝነት፦ ሱስኝነት ሲጋራ በማጨስ፣ ሺሻ በመሳብ፣ የተለያዩ አደንዛዥ እፆችን በመጠቀምና አልኮል መጠጥ በመጠጣት የሚመጣ ልማድ ነው። አንዳንድ ሰዎች በጓደኞቻቸው ግፊት ወይም ስለ ሱስ አደጋ ባለማወቅ ወደ ሱስ ይገባሉ፤ በተለይ ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ሲጋራ ማጨስን የዘመናዊነት ምልክት አድርገው ይመለከቱታል። ለሱስ የተጋለጡ ሰዎች ጤናቸው ይታወካል፣ ገንዘባቸውን በአግባቡ ባለመጠቀማቸው ማህበራዊ ግንኙነታቸው ይላላል፣ እንዲሁም ቤተሰባቸውን በአግባቡ መምራት ይሳናቸዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) ሱስ የተጋለጠ ሰው ራሱን በራሱ የመምራት አቅሙ እየደከመ ስለሚሄድ፣ የመጨረሻው ችግር ህይወትን በራስ አለመምራት ነው። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ ሁለት "መጠጊያቸው ሺሻ ወይም ሲጋራ ነው" ሲል ምን ማለቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ምንባብ ሁለት — ስለ ሱስኝነት፦ ሱስኝነት ሲጋራ በማጨስ፣ ሺሻ በመሳብ፣ የተለያዩ አደንዛዥ እፆችን በመጠቀምና አልኮል መጠጥ በመጠጣት የሚመጣ ልማድ ነው። አንዳንድ ሰዎች በጓደኞቻቸው ግፊት ወይም ስለ ሱስ አደጋ ባለማወቅ ወደ ሱስ ይገባሉ፤ በተለይ ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ሲጋራ ማጨስን የዘመናዊነት ምልክት አድርገው ይመለከቱታል። ለሱስ የተጋለጡ ሰዎች ጤናቸው ይታወካል፣ ገንዘባቸውን በአግባቡ ባለመጠቀማቸው ማህበራዊ ግንኙነታቸው ይላላል፣ እንዲሁም ቤተሰባቸውን በአግባቡ መምራት ይሳናቸዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) ሺሻ ወይም ሲጋራን እንደ 'መጠጊያ' መጠቀም ራስን በራስ መቆጣጠር አለመቻልን የሚያመለክት ዘይቤያዊ አገላለጽ ነው። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ ሶስት መሰረት፣ ከሱስ የመውጫ ዘዴዎች ተብለው ከተጠቀሱት የትኞቹ ናቸው?
options: ራስን ማወቅ፤ ስለ ቤተሰብ ማሰብና መወሰን
questions.explanation: ምንባብ ሁለት — ስለ ሱስኝነት፦ ሱስኝነት ሲጋራ በማጨስ፣ ሺሻ በመሳብ፣ የተለያዩ አደንዛዥ እፆችን በመጠቀምና አልኮል መጠጥ በመጠጣት የሚመጣ ልማድ ነው። አንዳንድ ሰዎች በጓደኞቻቸው ግፊት ወይም ስለ ሱስ አደጋ ባለማወቅ ወደ ሱስ ይገባሉ፤ በተለይ ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ሲጋራ ማጨስን የዘመናዊነት ምልክት አድርገው ይመለከቱታል። ለሱስ የተጋለጡ ሰዎች ጤናቸው ይታወካል፣ ገንዘባቸውን በአግባቡ ባለመጠቀማቸው ማህበራዊ ግንኙነታቸው ይላላል፣ እንዲሁም ቤተሰባቸውን በአግባቡ መምራት ይሳናቸዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) (ይህ ጥያቄ ከምንባቡ ሶስተኛ አንቀጽ ጋር በቀጥታ ስለሚገናኝ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ አራት መሰረት፣ ሱስኛ ሰው ቤተሰብን ለመምራት እንቅፋት የሚሆነው በምን ምክንያት ነው?
options: በቤተሰቡ ኢኮኖሚና ጤንነት ላይ ጉዳት ስለሚያደርሱ
ማህበራዊ ግዴታዎችን ስለሚያሳድጉ ላይ ጤናን ስለሚፈትን
questions.explanation: ምንባብ ሁለት — ስለ ሱስኝነት፦ ሱስኝነት ሲጋራ በማጨስ፣ ሺሻ በመሳብ፣ የተለያዩ አደንዛዥ እፆችን በመጠቀምና አልኮል መጠጥ በመጠጣት የሚመጣ ልማድ ነው። አንዳንድ ሰዎች በጓደኞቻቸው ግፊት ወይም ስለ ሱስ አደጋ ባለማወቅ ወደ ሱስ ይገባሉ፤ በተለይ ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ሲጋራ ማጨስን የዘመናዊነት ምልክት አድርገው ይመለከቱታል። ለሱስ የተጋለጡ ሰዎች ጤናቸው ይታወካል፣ ገንዘባቸውን በአግባቡ ባለመጠቀማቸው ማህበራዊ ግንኙነታቸው ይላላል፣ እንዲሁም ቤተሰባቸውን በአግባቡ መምራት ይሳናቸዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) ሱስ የያዘው ሰው ራሱንም ቤተሰቡንም በአግባቡ የመጠበቅ አቅሙ ስለሚደክም ቤተሰብን ለመምራት እንቅፋት ይሆንበታል። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የሱስ ምክንያትና ውጤት በተለይ የተገለጹባቸው አንቀጾች የትኞቹ ናቸው?
questions.explanation: የሱስ መንስኤዎች በአንቀጽ አንድ፣ የሚያስከትሉት ችግሮች ደግሞ በአንቀጽ ሁለት ተብራርተዋል። (ይህ ጥያቄ ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በምንባቡ አንቀጽ አንድ፣ መስመር ላይ ላለው "ይጠመዳሉ" የሚለው ቃል ትክክለኛ ፍቺ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ይጠመዳሉ" ማለት "ይያዛሉ" (በሱስ የመታሰር ሁኔታን ያመለክታል) ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ አንድ መሰረት፣ ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ለሱስ የሚጋለጡበት ምክንያት ምንድነው?
options: ሲጋራ ማጨስንና ሺሻ መሳብን የዘመናዊነት ማሳያ አድርገው በመቁጠራቸው
ሌላው ያደረገውን ሁሉ ለማድረግ ተነሳሽነት ያላቸው በመሆኑ
ስለ ሱስ ባለማወቅና ስለ ጉዳቱ ግንዛቤ ባለማግኘታቸው
ራሳቸውን ባለማወቅና ለተጋረጠው ነገር ተቀናቅሎ ባለመቆማቸው
questions.explanation: በአንቀጹ መሰረት ወጣቶች ወደ ሱስ የሚገቡት በዋነኝነት ስለ ሱስ ባለማወቅና ስለ ሱስኝነት ጉዳት ግንዛቤ ባለማግኘታቸው ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በምንባቡ አንቀጽ ሁለት፣ መስመር ላይ ላለው "ይሳናቸዋል" የሚለው ቃል ፍቺ ______ ነው።
questions.explanation: "ይሳናቸዋል" ማለት "ያቅታቸዋል" (መፈጸም አይችሉም) ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የምንባቡ ዋና ሃሳብ ምንድነው?
options: ሱስ በተለያዩ ምክንያቶች ቢመጣም ጉዳቱ ዘውታሪ መሆኑ
ሰዎች በሱስ ሲጠመዱ ስለሚያሳዩት ብቃትና መነሳት
ሱስኝነትን በቀላሉ መቀልበስና ማስወገድ የሚቻል መሆኑ
questions.explanation: ምንባቡ በጠቅላላው የሚያተኩረው በሱስ ለተጋለጡ ሰዎች በሚያጋጥሟቸው ችግሮችና ከዚያ ለመውጣት በሚያስችሉ መንገዶች ላይ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ለቀረበው ምንባብ ተስማሚ ርዕስ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ምንባቡ ስለ ሱስ መንስኤ፣ ጉዳትና መፍትሔ በጠቅላላ ስለሚያትት፣ ተስማሚው ርዕስ "የሱስ አደገኛነት" ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በስርዓት የተሳሰሩ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ስብስብ ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: በስርዓት ተሳስረው አንድ ሃሳብ የሚገልጹ የዓረፍተ ነገሮች ስብስብ "አንቀጽ" ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በምንባቡ አንቀጽ አንድ፣ ለግጥም መሰረት ሆኖ የቀረበው ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: ምንባብ አንድ — ስለ ግጥም፦ ግጥም ጥንታዊነት ያለው የኪነ ጥበብ ዘርፍ ነው። የሰው ልጆች ሃሳባቸውን በጽሑፍ ከመግለጻቸው በፊት፣ የእለት ተእለት ሁኔታቸውንና ልዩ ልዩ ገጠመኞቻቸውን በቃላዊ ሥነ ጽሑፍ (በአፍ ታሪክ) ያስተላልፉ ነበር፤ ይህም ለግጥም መሰረት ሆኗል። ግጥም አንድን ሃሳብ ወይም ስሜት በጥቂት የተመረጡ ቃላት አጠር አድርጎ የመግለጽ ችሎታ አለው፤ ይህም ለግጥም ቅልብነትና እምቅነት ባህርይ ይሰጠዋል። በተጨማሪም በምጣኔው (ስንኝ) አማካኝነት በሚፈጠረው ሙዚቃዊ ቃና የሰሚውን/የአንባቢውን ስሜት በቶሎ ይነካል፤ ይህም ግጥምን ለሰው ልጆች ስሜት ቅርብ ያደርገዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) ሰዎች ሃሳባቸውን በጽሑፍ ከመግለጻቸው በፊት በቃላዊ ሥነ ጽሑፍ ያስተላልፉ የነበረው ልማድ ለግጥም መሰረት ሆኗል። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ አንድ የተገለጸው ቁልፍ ሃሳብ ምንድነው?
options: ግጥም ጥንታዊነት ያለው የኪነ ጥበብ ዘርፍ መሆኑን
ሰዎች ግጥምን በመጠቀም ፍላጎታቸውን የሚያሟሉ መሆናቸውን
ለግጥም ቅርበትና ፍላጎት ያላቸው ጥቂቶች መሆናቸውን
ምሁራን ስለ ግጥም ምንነት የተጠየቁ መሆናቸውን
questions.explanation: ምንባብ አንድ — ስለ ግጥም፦ ግጥም ጥንታዊነት ያለው የኪነ ጥበብ ዘርፍ ነው። የሰው ልጆች ሃሳባቸውን በጽሑፍ ከመግለጻቸው በፊት፣ የእለት ተእለት ሁኔታቸውንና ልዩ ልዩ ገጠመኞቻቸውን በቃላዊ ሥነ ጽሑፍ (በአፍ ታሪክ) ያስተላልፉ ነበር፤ ይህም ለግጥም መሰረት ሆኗል። ግጥም አንድን ሃሳብ ወይም ስሜት በጥቂት የተመረጡ ቃላት አጠር አድርጎ የመግለጽ ችሎታ አለው፤ ይህም ለግጥም ቅልብነትና እምቅነት ባህርይ ይሰጠዋል። በተጨማሪም በምጣኔው (ስንኝ) አማካኝነት በሚፈጠረው ሙዚቃዊ ቃና የሰሚውን/የአንባቢውን ስሜት በቶሎ ይነካል፤ ይህም ግጥምን ለሰው ልጆች ስሜት ቅርብ ያደርገዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) የመግቢያው ዋና ሃሳብ ግጥም ረጅም ዘመናትን ያስቆጠረ ጥንታዊ የኪነ ጥበብ ዘርፍ መሆኑን መግለጽ ነው። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በምንባቡ አንቀጽ ሁለት፣ ላይ ላለው "ብያኔ" የሚለው ቃል ______ ማለት ነው።
questions.explanation: "ብያኔ" ማለት "ፍቺ" (ትርጓሜ) ማለት ነው። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ ሶስት መሰረት፣ ግጥም ለሰው ልጆች ስሜት ቅርበት እንዲኖረው ያደረገው ነጥብ የቱ ነው?
options: በሙዚቃዊ ቃናው የሰሚትን ስሜት በቶሎ መንካቱ
በጥቂት ምርጥ ቃላት ብዙ ነገሮችን አምቆ መያዙ
questions.explanation: ምንባብ አንድ — ስለ ግጥም፦ ግጥም ጥንታዊነት ያለው የኪነ ጥበብ ዘርፍ ነው። የሰው ልጆች ሃሳባቸውን በጽሑፍ ከመግለጻቸው በፊት፣ የእለት ተእለት ሁኔታቸውንና ልዩ ልዩ ገጠመኞቻቸውን በቃላዊ ሥነ ጽሑፍ (በአፍ ታሪክ) ያስተላልፉ ነበር፤ ይህም ለግጥም መሰረት ሆኗል። ግጥም አንድን ሃሳብ ወይም ስሜት በጥቂት የተመረጡ ቃላት አጠር አድርጎ የመግለጽ ችሎታ አለው፤ ይህም ለግጥም ቅልብነትና እምቅነት ባህርይ ይሰጠዋል። በተጨማሪም በምጣኔው (ስንኝ) አማካኝነት በሚፈጠረው ሙዚቃዊ ቃና የሰሚውን/የአንባቢውን ስሜት በቶሎ ይነካል፤ ይህም ግጥምን ለሰው ልጆች ስሜት ቅርብ ያደርገዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) ግጥም በምጣኔው (ስንኝ) አማካኝነት በሚፈጥረው ሙዚቃዊ ቃና የሰሚውን ስሜት በቀላሉና በፍጥነት ስለሚነካ ለስሜት ቅርብ ይሆናል። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ ሶስት እንደተገለጸው፣ "የግጥም ቅልብነትና እምቅነት ባህርይ" ምንን ያሳያል?
options: በጥቂት ቃላት ብዙ ሃሳብ ማለት የሚችል መሆኑን
questions.explanation: ምንባብ አንድ — ስለ ግጥም፦ ግጥም ጥንታዊነት ያለው የኪነ ጥበብ ዘርፍ ነው። የሰው ልጆች ሃሳባቸውን በጽሑፍ ከመግለጻቸው በፊት፣ የእለት ተእለት ሁኔታቸውንና ልዩ ልዩ ገጠመኞቻቸውን በቃላዊ ሥነ ጽሑፍ (በአፍ ታሪክ) ያስተላልፉ ነበር፤ ይህም ለግጥም መሰረት ሆኗል። ግጥም አንድን ሃሳብ ወይም ስሜት በጥቂት የተመረጡ ቃላት አጠር አድርጎ የመግለጽ ችሎታ አለው፤ ይህም ለግጥም ቅልብነትና እምቅነት ባህርይ ይሰጠዋል። በተጨማሪም በምጣኔው (ስንኝ) አማካኝነት በሚፈጠረው ሙዚቃዊ ቃና የሰሚውን/የአንባቢውን ስሜት በቶሎ ይነካል፤ ይህም ግጥምን ለሰው ልጆች ስሜት ቅርብ ያደርገዋል። (ማሳሰቢያ፦ ትክክለኛው የምንባብ ቃላት አጻጻፍ በዋናው ሰነድ ላይ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል፤ ይህ ማጠቃለያ ብቻ ነው።) ቅልብነትና እምቅነት ማለት በጥቂት በተመረጡ ቃላት ብዙ ሃሳብን አጭቆ የመያዝ ችሎታ ማለት ነው። (ከምንባቡ ጋር በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ለቀረበው ምንባብ ተስማሚ ርዕስ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ምንባቡ በጠቅላላው ስለ ግጥም ምንነት፣ አመጣጥና ባህርይ ስለሚያትት፣ ተስማሚው ርዕስ "ግጥም" ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ስለ አንድ ነጠላ ሃሳብ የሚያትት፣ በስርዓት የተሳሰረ የዓረፍተ ነገር ስብስብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ስለ አንድ ርዕሰ ጉዳይ በስርዓት ተሳስረው የሚቀርቡ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ስብስብ "አንቀጽ" ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የአንቀጽን ጠቅላላ ሃሳብ ጠቅልሎ የሚይዝ ዓረፍተ ነገር ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: የአንቀጹን ዋና ሃሳብ ጠቅልሎ የሚይዘው ዓረፍተ ነገር "መሪ ቃል" (topic sentence) ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ስለ መደበኛ ጽሑፍ ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ለድምጻዊ መልእክት ብቻ ጥንቃቄ የሚያደርግ ነው።
ለሃሳብ ቅደም ተከተል ብቻ ትኩረት ይሰጣል።
questions.explanation: መደበኛ (ፎርማል) ጽሑፍ ከሌሎች ጽሑፎች ተለይቶ ለስዋስዋዊ (ሰዋሰዋዊ) ቅንብር ልዩ ትኩረት ይሰጣል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ተጨማሪ ሃሳቦችን ለማያያዝ የሚጠቅም አያያዥ ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "እንዲሁም" ተጨማሪ ሃሳብን ለማያያዝ የሚያገለግል አያያዥ ቃል ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ስለ ልቦለድ ምንነት ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ሙሉ በሙሉ በሃቅና በእውነት ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው።
ሁልጊዜ በተውኔትና በግጥም ቅርጽ ብቻ ይቀርባል።
questions.explanation: ልቦለድ የራሱ የሆኑ አላባውያን (እንደ ገጸ ባህሪ፣ ሴራ፣ መቼት፣ ጭብጥ) ያሉት የስነ ጽሁፍ ዘርፍ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ትክክለኛውን ስርዓተ ነጥብ በመጠቀም የተጻፈው የቱ ነው?
options: ተማሪው፣ ደብተር፣ እርሳስ፣ መጽሐፍና እስክሪብቶ ይዞ መጣ።
ተማሪው ደብተር፣ እርሳስ፣ መጽሐፍና እስክሪብቶ ይዞ መጣ።
ተማሪው፣ ደብተር፣ እርሳስ፣ መጽሐፍና እስክሪብቶ፣ ይዞ መጣ።
ተማሪው፤ ደብተር፤ እርሳስ፤ መጽሐፍና እስክሪብቶ፤ ይዞ መጣ።
questions.explanation: "ተማሪው" ባለቤት ስለሆነ ከእሱ በኋላ ኮማ አያስፈልግም፤ በዝርዝሩ ውስጥ ባሉት ዕቃዎች መካከል ብቻ ኮማ ይገባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ትክክለኛው የስርዓተ ነጥብ አጠቃቀም የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ሰዓት ለመግለጽ በአማርኛ ስርዓተ ነጥብ ትክክለኛው ምልክት ድርብ ነጥብ (፡) ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "በር ተከፍቶ ሲገባ በትንሽዋ ሳሎን ውስጥ አራት ወንበሮችና አንድ መካከለኛ ጠረጴዛ ይታያል። በወንበሮቹ ላይ የፍየል ቆዳ ተነጥፎባቸዋል። በመስኮቱ ጥግ ባለው ትንሽ ጠረጴዛ ላይ ጨርቅ ተነጥፎ ራዲዮ ተቀምጦበታል።" የቀረበው እንቅጽ ለየትኛው የጽሑፍ ዓይነት ምሳሌ ሊሆን ይችላል?
questions.explanation: ይህ አንቀጽ አንድን ቦታ በዝርዝር በመግለጽ ስለሚያቀርብ "ገላጭ ጽሑፍ" ምሳሌ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ከሌሎቹ የተለየው የቱ ነው?
options: ኡመር ዛሬ ጠዋት ትምህርት ቤት ሄደ።
questions.explanation: "ዳግማዊ ቴዎድሮስ" የታሪክ ውስጥ የታወቀ ስም (ንጉሠ ነገሥት) ስለሆነ ከሌሎቹ መደበኛ የግል ስሞች ይለያል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች መካከል ውስብስብ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: አትሌት ጥሩነሽ ዲባባ በከፍተኛ ልዩነት አሸነፈች።
questions.explanation: "ሙሉ በወደ ገዛችው ቀሚስ ያምራል" የሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ጥገኛ ሃረግ (የገዛችው) ስላለው ውስብስብ ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "አባት ነገ ወደገበያ በመኪና ይሄዳል" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የጊዜ ተውሳከ ግስ ሆኖ የሚያገለግለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ነገ" ድርጊቱ የሚፈጸምበትን ጊዜ ስለሚገልጽ የጊዜ ተውሳከ ግስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች መካከል ብዙ ቁጥርን የያዘው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: "ፖሊሶቹ" እና "ወንጀለኞችን" ብዙ ቁጥር ያላቸው ስሞች ናቸው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ባለሃብቱ ጥሩ ጥሩ ______ ለትምህርት ቤቶች ሰጡ" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ሊገባ የሚችል ብዙ ቁጥር ያለው ስም የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "መጻሕፍት" የ"መጽሐፍ" ብዙ ቁጥር ስለሆነ በዓረፍተ ነገሩ ውስጥ በትክክል ይገባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የሃገር ስም ብቻውን ሲነገር፣ የሚፈጥረው ሃረግ ______ ሃረግ ነው።
questions.explanation: የሃገር ስም ራሱን የቻለ ስም ስለሆነ "ስማዊ ሃረግ" ይፈጥራል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት መካከል ቅጽላዊ ሃረግ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "በጣም ንጹህ" ቅጽልን (ንጹህ) በተውሳከ ቅጽል (በጣም) የተጠናከረ ስለሆነ ቅጽላዊ ሃረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ሃዋሳ በ1952 ዓ.ም የተመሰረተች ውብ ከተማ ናት" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ "ውብ ከተማ" የሚለው ______ ሃረግ ነው።
questions.explanation: "ውብ ከተማ" ቅጽልና ስም ተዳምረው የፈጠሩት ሃረግ ስሙ (ከተማ) ማዕከል ስለሆነ ስማዊ ሃረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች መካከል በተስፈለጊ (አድራጊ ያልታወቀ) ግስ የተነገረው የቱ ነው?
options: የበጎ አድራጎት ማዕከል ስራ ዛሬ ተመረቀ።
ህገ ወጥ የሰዎች ዝውውር ምክንያቶች ተለዩ።
questions.explanation: "የቀበሌዎቹ ሊቀ መንበር እንደገና ተመረጡ" የሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር በተስፈለጊ (passive) ግስ የተነገረ ነው — አድራጊው ሳይገለጽ ተግባሩ በባለቤቱ ላይ ተፈጽሟል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች መካከል በንግግር ዘይቤ (ገላጭ ሳይሆን ቀጥተኛ) የተነገረው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ህንፃው በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ተገንብቷል" ቀጥተኛ/ተራ የድርጊት መግለጫ ስለሆነ ከሌሎቹ ይለያል። (ትክክለኛነቱ ከዋናው ጥያቄ አገላለጽ ጋር ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: አንድ ደራሲ በልቦለድ ውስጥ ሊያስተላልፍ የፈለገውን ዋና መልእክት ወይም ፍሬ ሃሳብ የሚያመለክተው የልቦለድ አላባ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የደራሲው ዋና መልእክት ወይም ፍሬ ሃሳብ የሚንጸባረቅበት የልቦለድ አላባ "ጭብጥ" (theme) ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ልጆች አዋቂዎችን ማክበር አለባቸው" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ባለቤቱ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የዓረፍተ ነገሩ ባለቤት (ድርጊቱን የሚፈጽመው) "ልጆች" ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ልጅ ታዛዥ ______ አምነዋለሁ" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ በባዶ ቦታው ላይ በትክክል ሊገባ የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ስለሆነ" ምክንያትን ስለሚገልጽ ከዓረፍተ ነገሩ ሃሳብ ጋር በትክክል ይስማማል።

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Given the sets A = {1,2,3} and B = {1,2,3,4}, which of the following is true?
options: Set A is equal to set B
Set A is a subset of set B
Set B is a proper subset of set A
Set B is equivalent to set A
questions.explanation: Every element of A (1,2,3) is also in B, so A is a subset of B. A is not equal to B since B has an extra element (4).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In the Venn diagram, set A contains students who like Mathematics and set B contains students who like Science. What does the shaded (overlapping) region represent?
options: Students who like either Mathematics or Science
Students who like both Mathematics and Science
questions.explanation: The overlapping region of two circles in a Venn diagram is the intersection — the elements that belong to both sets at once.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following correctly represents the relationship between natural numbers (N) and whole numbers (W)?
questions.explanation: Whole numbers include 0 plus all natural numbers, so every natural number is whole, but not every whole number (like 0) is natural — making N a proper subset of W.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following correctly defines the set of all integers?
questions.explanation: Integers include all positive and negative whole numbers plus zero, extending infinitely in both directions.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the product of (−9) × (6)?
questions.explanation: A negative number multiplied by a positive number gives a negative result: 9 × 6 = 54, so the answer is −54.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the result of 41 ÷ 7 in two decimal places?
questions.explanation: 41 ÷ 7 = 5.857142…, which rounds to 5.86 at two decimal places.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the simplified form of the ratio 6 : 9?
questions.explanation: Dividing both terms by their greatest common factor, 3, gives 6÷3 : 9÷3 = 2 : 3.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A school has 1,200 students, and 52% of them are boys. How many boys are there in the school?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A company increased its employee's salaries by 20%. If an employee was earning 3,600 Birr before the increase, what is their new salary?
questions.explanation: A 20% increase on 3,600 is 0.20 × 3600 = 720. Adding that to the original salary gives 3,600 + 720 = 4,320 Birr.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which quadrant contains points where both the x-coordinate and y-coordinate are negative in the Cartesian coordinate system?
questions.explanation: By convention, Quadrant III is the lower-left region of the coordinate plane, where both x and y values are negative.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A cyclist has completed 90km which is 3/5 of his total planned distance. What is the total planned distance?
questions.explanation: If 3/5 of the distance is 90km, the total distance is 90 ÷ (3/5) = 90 × 5/3 = 150km.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If a triangle has one angle that measures 90°, then what type of triangle is it?
questions.explanation: A triangle with exactly one 90° angle is called a right triangle by definition.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A triangle has sides measuring 5cm, 12cm and 13cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.explanation: Perimeter is the sum of all sides: 5 + 12 + 13 = 30cm.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of 21cm? (Use π = 22/7)

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A rectangular field has a length of 80cm and a width of 40cm. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle = length × width = 80 × 40 = 3,200cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider the figure where ΔPQR ≅ ΔXYZ, with corresponding sides PQ=7cm, QR=5cm, PR=10cm equal to XY=7cm, YZ=5cm, XZ=10cm. Which congruence theorem applies?
questions.explanation: All three corresponding sides of the two triangles are equal in length, which satisfies the Side-Side-Side (SSS) congruence rule.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two rectangular gardens have identical dimensions. If a gardener used 40 meters of fencing for one garden, how much fencing is required for both gardens?
questions.explanation: Since both gardens are identical, each needs 40 meters, so two gardens need 40 + 40 = 80 meters total.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A pie chart represents a survey of 200 people: 120 prefer tea (216°), 60 prefer coffee (108°), and 20 prefer milk (36°). What percentage of people prefer coffee?
questions.explanation: 60 out of 200 people prefer coffee: 60/200 = 0.30 = 30%. This also matches 108°/360° = 30% of the full circle.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The test scores of five students are 7, 5, 8, 4, and 6. What is the mean score?
questions.explanation: Mean = sum of values ÷ count = (7+5+8+4+6)/5 = 30/5 = 6.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the absolute value of −5/11?
questions.explanation: Absolute value strips the sign of a number, turning any negative value positive: |−5/11| = 5/11.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following correctly arranges the numbers −2/3, 3/5, −5/8 in increasing order?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the result of 6/7 − 3/14?
questions.explanation: Convert 6/7 to a denominator of 14: 6/7 = 12/14. Then 12/14 − 3/14 = 9/14.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A farmer uses 4/7 of his land for wheat and 2/5 for corn. What fraction of his land is used?
questions.explanation: Using a common denominator of 35: 4/7 = 20/35 and 2/5 = 14/35. Adding gives 20/35 + 14/35 = 34/35.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Using the table of y = x², what is the value of √50.55?
questions.explanation: Looking up the table, 7.11² = 50.5521, which is the closest match to 50.55, so √50.55 ≈ 7.11.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the square root of 324?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the cube of 1/3?
questions.explanation: Cubing a fraction cubes both numerator and denominator: (1/3)³ = 1³/3³ = 1/27.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider a line l on a graph. Which equation represents the line l?
questions.explanation: Reading the slope and y-intercept from the graph: the line rises 2 units for every 3 units across (slope 2/3) and crosses the y-axis at −2.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following is the solution for 3x − 10 > 14?
questions.explanation: Add 10 to both sides: 3x > 24. Divide both sides by 3: x > 8.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A woman is three times as old as her brother, and the sum of their ages is 36. How old is the woman?
questions.explanation: Let the brother's age be x, so the woman's age is 3x. Then x + 3x = 36, so 4x = 36, x = 9. The woman is 3 × 9 = 27 years old.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following pairs of figures are NOT similar?
options: Two rectangles with different lengths and widths
Two equilateral triangles of different sizes
Two squares with different side lengths
questions.explanation: Two rectangles aren't automatically similar unless their length-to-width ratios match — unlike equilateral triangles, squares, and circles, which are always similar to each other regardless of size.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two similar triangles have a scale factor of 3:8. If the area of the smaller triangle is 9cm², what is the area of the larger triangle?
questions.explanation: For similar figures, the ratio of areas is the square of the scale factor: (3:8)² = 9:64. So the larger area = 9 × (64/9) = 64cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If two angles of a triangle measure 72° and 48°, what is the measure of the third angle?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle always sum to 180°: 180 − 72 − 48 = 60°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a right triangle ABC, right-angled at C, with AD = 9cm and AB = 25cm (D on AB, CD the altitude to the hypotenuse). What is the length of AC?
questions.explanation: By the geometric mean (altitude-on-hypotenuse) relation, AC² = AD × AB = 9 × 25 = 225, so AC = √225 = 15cm.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If a central angle measures 72°, what is the measure of the arc it intercepts?
questions.explanation: A central angle and the arc it intercepts always have the same degree measure, so the arc is also 72°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a circle with center O, arc AYD = 40° and arc BXC = 220°. What is the degree measure of ∠BEC (formed by intersecting chords)?
questions.explanation: The angle formed by two chords intersecting inside a circle equals half the sum of the two intercepted arcs: ½(220° + 40°) = 130°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a right circular cone, the perpendicular distance from the base to the vertex is called the
questions.explanation: The altitude of a cone is defined as the perpendicular distance from the base to the apex (vertex).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right rectangular prism has a length of 5cm, a width of 2cm, and a height of 3cm. What is its total surface area?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right circular cylinder has a radius of 4cm and a height of 10cm. What is the volume of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cylinder = πr²h = π × 4² × 10 = π × 16 × 10 = 160π cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following correctly describes an outcome in probability?
options: The ratio of successful outcomes to total outcomes
The probability of an event occurring
The total number of possible events
A single result of an experiment
questions.explanation: An 'outcome' specifically refers to one single possible result of an experiment — not a ratio or probability value.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A number is chosen randomly from 1 to 20. What is the probability that the chosen number is a multiple of 4?
questions.explanation: The multiples of 4 from 1–20 are 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 — that's 5 numbers out of 20, so the probability is 5/20 = 1/4.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Let A = {2, 4, 6, 8}, which of the following statement is correct about elements of set A?
options: 4 is an element of set A
2 is not an element of set A
5 is an element of set A
6 is not an element in set A
questions.explanation: Set A contains 2, 4, 6, and 8, so 4 is indeed an element of set A.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider the Venn diagram that relates sets A and B given below. Which one of the following sets correctly represents A ∪ B?
questions.explanation: A = {1,3,4} and B = {2,3,4}. The union A ∪ B combines every element from both sets: {1,2,3,4}.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which one of the following is a Natural number?
questions.explanation: Natural numbers are the positive counting numbers 1, 2, 3, ... . Of the choices, only 7 is a natural number; -3 is negative, and 2.5 and 3/4 are not whole numbers.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which one of the following is a correct relation among the sets of Natural numbers (N), Whole numbers (W), and Integers (Z)?
questions.explanation: Every natural number is a whole number, and every whole number is an integer, so N ⊂ W ⊂ Z.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What are the predecessor and successor of 35, respectively?
questions.explanation: The predecessor of 35 is one less (34), and the successor is one more (36).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: When we divide 81 by 25 the quotient is 3.24, then which one of the following is the correct interpretation about this division?
options: The quotient of 25 divided by 81 gives 3.24
questions.explanation: 81 ÷ 25 = 3.24 means 25 × 3.24 = 81 — multiplying the divisor by the quotient returns the dividend.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The value of x in the equivalent ratio 3:5 = x:20 is
questions.explanation: Cross-multiplying: 3 × 20 = 5 × x, so 60 = 5x, giving x = 12.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a certain school, 20% of 400 students are girls. Which one of the following is the correct identification of base, percentage, and rate, respectively?
questions.explanation: The base is the whole (400 students), the percentage/amount is the part it corresponds to (20% of 400 = 80), and the rate is 20%.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A school has 400 students. If 25% of them are boys and 30% of the boys are in the mathematics club. How many boys are in the mathematics club?
questions.explanation: 25% of 400 = 100 boys. 30% of those 100 boys are in the club: 0.30 × 100 = 30.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The solution set of the equation 3(x+2) = 2(x+5) is
questions.explanation: 3x+6 = 2x+10 → x = 4, so the solution set is {4}.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which one of the following quadrilaterals has four equal sides and four right angles?
questions.explanation: A square is defined as a quadrilateral with all four sides equal and all four angles right angles. A rhombus has equal sides but not necessarily right angles.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A figure is composed of a rectangle and a square as shown in the figure below. The rectangle has 8 cm long by 4 cm wide, and the square has a side of 4 cm. What is the total area of the figure?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 8 × 4 = 32 cm². Square area = 4 × 4 = 16 cm². Total = 32 + 16 = 48 cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A circle has radius of 6 cm, what is the area of the circle?
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = π × 6² = 36π cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A rectangular garden has 14 m long and 10 m wide. A fence will be built around it. What length of fence is needed?
questions.explanation: Perimeter = 2(length + width) = 2(14 + 10) = 2 × 24 = 48 m.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two triangular road signs have the same shape and size, which concept explains this situation?
questions.explanation: Figures with exactly the same shape and size are called congruent.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following is true about two table tops made with equal dimensions?
questions.explanation: Equal dimensions mean the same shape and size — this makes them congruent.

questions.explanation: Ranked from highest: Football (40%) is first, Basketball (25%) is second.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a certain school, the daily student's class attendance for five days is 38, 40, 39, 40, and 43, which statement correctly describes the data?
options: Attendance was the same every day
questions.explanation: 40 appears twice in the data set (38, 40, 39, 40, 43) while every other value appears once, so 40 is the mode — it occurred most frequently.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which one of the following is the application of rational number in real life?
options: Driving the value of π in a circle
questions.explanation: 3/4 is a rational number (a ratio of two integers) used directly in a real-life measurement. √2, π, and the cube root of 5 are all irrational.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A shopkeeper sold 2/5 of a pack of pens in the morning and 1/5 in the afternoon. How many packs of pens are sold in total?
questions.explanation: 2/5 + 1/5 = 3/5 of a pack sold in total.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: What is the square of 7/3?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The table given below is the function y = x². What is the value of √1.254?
questions.explanation: Reading the table, the row for x = 1.1 and the column for the hundredths digit 2 gives x² = 1.254 at x = 1.12, so √1.254 = 1.12.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which one of the following is the cube root of −64?
questions.explanation: (-4)³ = -4 × -4 × -4 = -64, so the cube root of -64 is -4.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The Cartesian coordinate system is a system that uses
options: two parallel axes to locate points.
a single vertical line to locate points.
a single horizontal line to locate points.
two perpendicular axes to locate points.
questions.explanation: The Cartesian system uses two perpendicular number lines (the x-axis and y-axis) that intersect at the origin to locate points.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider the graph given below showing line l. Which one of the following represents the equation of the line l?
questions.explanation: The line crosses the y-axis at (0,4) and the x-axis at (2,0), giving slope -2 and equation y = -2x+4, i.e. 2x+y-4=0.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A student must score at least 50 marks to pass the exam. If x represents the student score, which inequality represents this condition?
questions.explanation: "At least 50" includes 50 itself and anything above it, so x ≥ 50.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider the figure given below, AB = 4 cm, DE = 8 cm, and BC = 5 cm. If △ABC ∼ △DEF, then what is the length of EF?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is DE/AB = 8/4 = 2. So EF = BC × 2 = 5 × 2 = 10 cm.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If the ratio of the corresponding sides of two similar triangles is 5:3, then what is the ratio of their perimeter?
questions.explanation: For similar figures, the ratio of perimeters equals the ratio of corresponding sides, so it is 5:3.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a triangle, how is the exterior angle related to the two remote interior angles? The exterior angle equals
options: the sum of the two remote interior angles.
the difference of the two remote interior angles.
smaller than both remote interior angles.
questions.explanation: The Exterior Angle Theorem states an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two non-adjacent (remote) interior angles.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In a right angled triangle, the hypotenuse is
options: the shortest side of the right angled triangle.
the longest side opposite to the right angle.
the side adjacent to the right angle.
any side of the right angled triangle.
questions.explanation: The hypotenuse is always the longest side of a right triangle, and it lies opposite the right angle.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider the circle O given below. What is the shaded part of the circle?
questions.explanation: A region bounded by two radii and an arc is a sector; since the shaded region is the smaller of the two, it is the minor sector.

questions.explanation: When two chords intersect inside a circle, the measure of the angle formed equals half the sum of the two intercepted arcs.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which pyramid is named according to a square base?
questions.explanation: Pyramids are named after the shape of their base; a pyramid with a square base is called a square pyramid.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Consider the right circular cylinder with radius 5 cm and height 10 cm given below. What is the total surface area of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: Total surface area = 2πr(r+h) = 2π(5)(5+10) = 2π(5)(15) = 150π cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A card is drawn at random from a bag contains four identical cards numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4. Which of the following represents the sample space of the experiment?
questions.explanation: The sample space lists every possible outcome of the experiment — drawing any one of the four numbered cards: {1,2,3,4}.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A bag contains 5 white and 7 black identical balls; a ball is drawn at random. What is the probability of selecting a black ball?
questions.explanation: There are 12 balls total (5 white + 7 black). P(black) = 7/12.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What do we call the full and responsible membership in a particular state?
questions.explanation: "Citizenship" refers to the full and responsible membership of a person in a particular state, including its rights and duties.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Hailu always uses abusive words when communicating with his elders. Which feature of good citizen is Hailu missing?
questions.explanation: Using abusive words toward elders shows a lack of respect for others, a core feature of good citizenship.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following indicates acquisition of citizenship by descent?
options: Eligibility to citizenship being born in the territory of state.
Eligibility to citizenship based on citizenship of parents.
Acquisition of citizenship based on the application submitted.
Getting citizenship as a result of marriage contract.
questions.explanation: Citizenship by descent is acquired based on the citizenship of one's parents, not place of birth, application, or marriage.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is a requirement to obtain Ethiopian citizenship through naturalization?
questions.explanation: Naturalization requires meeting residency and character conditions, such as having lived in Ethiopia for a required number of years; being born in Ethiopia relates to citizenship by birth, not naturalization.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is the importance of having democratic government to create social stability.
questions.explanation: Democratic governments maintain social stability by enacting and enforcing laws that create order, unlike the other options which describe instability.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which form of government is characterized by having a single individual who has hereditary right to rule as a head of state?
questions.explanation: A monarchy is a form of government led by a single individual, such as a king or queen, who inherits the position by hereditary right.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Identify the correct statement about the relationship between state and government.
options: State is an element of government.
Government is an element of state.
Government is not essential for a state.
questions.explanation: Government is one of the essential elements of a state (along with population, territory, and sovereignty); a state cannot exist without a government to administer it.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is the feature of unitary state structure?
options: Concentration of power at the center
questions.explanation: A unitary state structure concentrates governing power at the central government, unlike federal systems which share power between levels.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is the advantage of federal state structure?
questions.explanation: Federal systems divide power between central and regional governments, which helps accommodate the diversity of different groups within a country.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following best explains the nature of Athenian democracy?
questions.explanation: Athenian democracy was based on direct popular participation, where eligible citizens took part in decision-making themselves rather than through representatives.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is the characteristic feature of social democracy.
options: State's rule is limited to maintaining order
questions.explanation: Social democracy emphasizes achieving greater equality in society, often through government intervention to reduce class-based disparities.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: A form of democracy where by elected representatives make decision on behalf of the people is:
questions.explanation: Indirect (representative) democracy is where citizens elect representatives who then make decisions on their behalf.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is correct about procedural and substantive democracy?
options: Procedural democracy focuses on process of government.
Substantive democracy focuses on form of government.
Procedural democracy focuses on result of decisions.
Substantive democracy focuses on how decisions are made.
questions.explanation: Procedural democracy is concerned with the process and rules of governing (elections, procedures), while substantive democracy is concerned with the actual outcomes/results for citizens.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is the role of indigenous democratic institutions?
questions.explanation: Indigenous democratic institutions traditionally play a role in resolving community conflicts using customary, traditional means.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following best indicates a parliamentary system of government?
questions.explanation: A parliamentary system typically has a nominal (ceremonial) head of state, such as a monarch or president, while the prime minister holds executive power.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One is correct concerning the relation between state and government.
options: State is one of the elements of government.
State is abstract while government is concrete.
State is temporary while government is permanent.
questions.explanation: The state is an abstract legal/political entity, while the government is the concrete body of people and institutions that exercises the state's authority at a given time.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: The principle of democracy which claims the consent of the people as the only legitimate source of government authority is:
questions.explanation: Popular sovereignty is the democratic principle that holds the consent and will of the people as the only legitimate source of government authority.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What would you do for the prevalence of democracy in your country?
questions.explanation: Upholding the rule of law is a positive action that supports the prevalence of democracy, unlike violating rights, breaking laws, or avoiding participation.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which value of democracy is related to being fair and impartial?
questions.explanation: Justice, as a democratic value, is directly related to being fair and impartial in treatment and decision-making.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: A person who committed a crime was convicted and sentenced to imprisonment for his crime by the court. This indicates
questions.explanation: A court properly convicting and sentencing a person who committed a crime is an example of justice being carried out through the legal system.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Identify the correct statement about customary rules.
options: Customary rules are irrelevant in society.
Violation of customs is not punishable.
Custom can't be source of enacted rules.
Customary rule can be converted to enacted rules.
questions.explanation: Customary rules, which develop from long-standing social practice, can be formally converted into enacted (written) laws.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: In what way, does rule of law contribute conditions for democracy? By
questions.explanation: Rule of law supports democracy by promoting an independent and free judiciary, which helps ensure fair governance.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How can we be sure that there is equal application of law for all?
options: When there is a rule of men
If presumption of innocence applies to all
questions.explanation: Equal application of law is demonstrated when legal protections, such as the presumption of innocence, apply equally to everyone, rather than officials having unchecked power.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Assume in a given state, laws are enacted on the basis of the will of the ruler. The laws are expected to govern citizens but the state never allowed it. In this state many people are arrested without the decision of the court. The above case indicates:
questions.explanation: When laws follow the personal will of a ruler and people are arrested without due court process, this indicates "rule of man" rather than rule of law.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is correct about indigenous values and institutions in Ethiopia? They
options: formulate the constitution of the state
mobilize the public for private gain
disturb peace and order of the state
questions.explanation: Indigenous values and institutions in Ethiopia are known for resolving conflicts through traditional means, not for formulating constitutions or disturbing peace.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is WRONG about the relationship and difference between constitution and constitutionalism.
options: Constitutionalism is a fundamental law of a state.
Constitution is a document that contains citizens' rights.
Constitutionalism is exercise of power based on constitution.
Constitution is a document that contains government's powers.
questions.explanation: It is the constitution, not constitutionalism, that is the fundamental law of a state; constitutionalism refers to the exercise of power in accordance with that constitution.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What is the main importance of constitutionalism?
questions.explanation: Constitutionalism's main importance is providing limited government, ensuring that those in power operate within legal bounds set by the constitution.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How do we determine a constitution as a rigid constitution? Based on it's
questions.explanation: A constitution is classified as rigid or flexible based on how difficult it is to amend; a rigid constitution requires a difficult, special amendment process.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Why is constitutionalism important for ensuring peace and stability? It
questions.explanation: Constitutionalism promotes orderly conduct by requiring that power be exercised according to established constitutional rules, supporting peace and stability.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is a factor that negatively affects rule of law.
questions.explanation: Widespread illiteracy negatively affects rule of law because citizens may not understand their legal rights and obligations, unlike patriotism, having a constitution, or good leadership, which support it.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What do you think is the importance of respecting human rights in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Respecting human rights is important because it helps ensure justice for individuals within society.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is a regional human rights instrument?
options: The 1995 Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopian constitution.
The 1948 Universal Declaration of Human Rights.
The 1989 International Convention on the Rights of Child.
The 1981 African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights.
questions.explanation: The African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights (1981) is a regional (African) human rights instrument, distinct from national constitutions or global UN instruments.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one do you think is the national human rights institution in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Among the given options, the Office of the Ombudsman is a national institution in Ethiopia related to protecting citizens' rights, unlike the African Union, UN, or the constitution itself. (This question's intended answer may benefit from teacher verification, since the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission is also a key national human rights body.)

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One should be the role of government to ensure human rights.
questions.explanation: A government that respects freedom of speech is fulfilling its role in ensuring human rights, unlike restricting or interfering with religious freedoms.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: In which categories of human rights does the right to life belong to?
questions.explanation: The right to life is classified under civil and political rights, the first generation of human rights.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following rights is NOT included in the regional constitutions of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Among the listed rights, the right to secession is the most distinct and is not typically listed as an individual right in regional constitutions in the same way life, liberty, and equality are. (This question involves a nuanced constitutional point and may benefit from teacher verification.)

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is among the obstacles of human rights protection in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Harmful traditional practices are recognized as an obstacle to human rights protection in Ethiopia, unlike peace, strong institutions, or development, which support it.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is a means to address the challenges of human rights protection in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Building a functional democracy is a positive means to address human rights challenges, unlike weakening institutions or worsening poverty and harmful practices.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following best indicates peace.
questions.explanation: Peace is best indicated by the absence of war and violence in a society.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: How could you promote community engagement?
options: Advocate one way flow of information
questions.explanation: Community engagement is promoted by encouraging the active involvement of people, not by discouraging participation or communication.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: The contribution of one's time, effort and talent to assist others without payment is termed as:
questions.explanation: Volunteerism is defined as contributing one's time, effort, and talent to help others without expecting payment.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: What do you think is the benefit of voluntary service?
questions.explanation: Voluntary service benefits individuals by boosting self-confidence, unlike the negative effects listed in the other options.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Which aspect of community engagement is an essential component to improve public service quality?
questions.explanation: The social aspect of community engagement — building relationships and participation among community members — is considered essential to improving public service quality. (Given some overlap with the political aspect of governance, this question may benefit from teacher verification.)

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Identify the correct statement about the contrast between social and economic aspects of community engagement.
options: Social aspect is about political participation.
Economic aspect is related to education system.
Social aspect deals with military engagement.
Economic aspect focuses on development initiatives.
questions.explanation: The economic aspect of community engagement focuses on development initiatives, while the social aspect deals with relationships and participation among community members.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: One of the following best explains the concept of objective analysis.
options: Reliance on one source of information only
Accepting all information as equally good
Basing our decision on irrelevant data
questions.explanation: Objective analysis, which involves evaluating information fairly and without bias, is an essential quality of critical thinking.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: What is the difference between true information and fake information.
options: True information leads to good consequence unlike fake ones.
Fake information results in good decision like true ones.
True information leads to negative result unlike fake ones.
Fake information results in positive outcome like true ones.
questions.explanation: True information tends to lead to good consequences, while fake information can lead to poor decisions and negative outcomes.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Which one of the following is the benefit of teamwork?
questions.explanation: Teamwork's benefit lies in collaborating effectively with others, unlike ineffective communication or disrespecting others' views.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: What do we mean by virtues?
options: Traits useful for healthy functioning of society
questions.explanation: Virtues are positive traits or dispositions that are useful for the healthy functioning of society, unlike vices which involve negative behaviors.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Identify the correct combination.
questions.explanation: Dishonesty is correctly paired as a vice (a negative trait), while compassion would pair with virtue and selfishness/injustice would pair with vice.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Which one of the following is the significance of honesty?
questions.explanation: Honesty facilitates progress in society by building trust, unlike promoting falsehood or misuse of resources.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: What should be your teacher's response, if he/she caught somebody cheating on exam?
questions.explanation: A teacher should disapprove of a student's dishonest act of cheating, rather than rewarding or respecting it.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Among the following one is the reason why virtue ethics is important. It
options: empower us to promote social evil.
enables us to become irresponsible persons.
helps us distinguish between right and wrong.
helps us develop negative attitude for challenges.
questions.explanation: Virtue ethics is important because it helps individuals distinguish between right and wrong conduct.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Which step of critical thinking is the first one in decision making?
questions.explanation: The first step in the critical thinking decision-making process is to identify the decision that needs to be made.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: Which one is related to the habit of critical thinking in problem solving?
questions.explanation: Organizing thoughts coherently is a habit associated with critical thinking, unlike using evidence poorly or being close-minded.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: A strategy of improving critical thinking related to engaging in repeated attempt at problem solving is:
questions.explanation: The trial-and-error method involves repeated attempts at problem solving, which is a strategy for improving critical thinking skills.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Community Engagement, Ethics & Critical Thinking
questions.q: What is the significance of critical thinking in decision making process?
questions.explanation: Critical thinking is significant in decision making because it helps in formulating convincing, well-reasoned conclusions.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is the cause of conflict?
questions.explanation: A difference in needs among individuals or groups is a common cause of conflict, unlike understanding, sharing, or avoiding name-calling, which help prevent it.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Identify the feature of litigation as conflict resolution mechanism.
options: Talking directly to another person in dispute
A neutral third party assists to reach an agreement
A third party to make a decision after hearing the case
Formally resolving conflict through court procedure
questions.explanation: Litigation is the formal resolution of a conflict through court procedures, unlike negotiation (direct talk), mediation (neutral third party assists), or arbitration (third party decides after hearing).

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What is the main attribute of a good negotiation?
questions.explanation: A good negotiation is characterized by reaching a mutually acceptable agreement, rather than withdrawing or disregarding the other party's interests.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one do you think is the purpose of indigenous conflict resolution institutions in maintaining peace?
questions.explanation: Indigenous conflict resolution institutions maintain peace by promoting traditions of forgiveness, unlike encouraging division or disrespect.

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ጉድፍ" ለሚለው ቃል በፍቺ ተመሳሳይ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ጉድፍ" ማለት ቆሻሻ ወይም እድፍ ማለት ነው፤ ስለዚህ በፍቺ ተመሳሳይ የሆነው "ቆሻሻ" ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ በፍቺ ልዩ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ጎመራ፣ ደረሰ እና በደቀ ከእድገት/መድረስ ጋር የተያያዙ ሲሆኑ፣ "አሸተ" (ማሽተት) ግን በፍቺ የተለየ ስሜታዊ ተግባርን ስለሚገልጽ ልዩ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ገሃድ" ለሚለው ቃል በፍቺ ተቃራኒ የሆነው ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ገሃድ" ማለት የተገለጠ/ግልጽ ማለት ሲሆን፣ ተቃራኒው "ስውር" (የተደበቀ) ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ቤት" የሚለው ቃል እንድምታዊ ፍቺ ሊሆን የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ቤት" የሚለው ቃል ቀጥተኛ ፍቺው መጠለያ/ማደሪያ ስፍራ ማለት ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.q: "እልቂት" ለሚለው ቃል በፍቺ ተመሳሳይ የሆነው የቱ ነው?

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀጽ ውስጥ ዋናውን ሀሳብ የያዘ ዓረፍተ ነገር ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: በአንቀጽ ውስጥ ዋናውን ሀሳብ የያዘ ዓረፍተ ነገር "ኃይለ ቃል" (topic sentence) ይባላል፤ የተቀሩት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ይህንኑ ሀሳብ ያብራራሉ/ይደግፋሉ።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ዝናቡ በተመጣጠነ ሁኔታ ዘነበ፤ _____ የተገኘው ምርት አመርቂ አይደለም።
questions.explanation: ሁለቱ ሀሳቦች እርስ በርስ የሚቃረኑ (ዝናብ በበቂ ሁኔታ ዘነበ፣ ነገር ግን ምርቱ ጥሩ አልነበረም) በመሆናቸው፣ ተቃርኖ የሚያሳይ አያያዥ ቃል "ይሁን እንጂ" ተገቢ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በሁለት ነገሮች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ለማሳየት የሚጠቀም የአንቀጽ ማስፈሪያ ዘዴ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: በሁለት ነገሮች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ለማሳየት የሚያገለግለው ዘዴ "የማነፃፀር ዘዴ" (contrast) ሲሆን፣ "የማወዳደር ስልት" ደግሞ ተመሳሳይነትን ለማሳየት ያገለግላል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ስለ አንቀጽ ምንነት ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አንድ አንቀጽ በመሰረቱ አንድን ዋና ሀሳብ ብቻ የሚያብራራ የፅሁፍ ክፍል ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የእግር ኳስ ተጫዋቾች ተገቢ ዝግጅት አድርገዋል፣ _____ የሚገባቸውን ውጤት አላስመዘገቡም።
questions.explanation: ሁለቱ ሀሳቦች እርስ በርስ የሚቃረኑ በመሆናቸው (ዝግጅት ቢያደርጉም ውጤት ግን አላገኙም)፣ ተቃርኖ የሚያሳይ "ነገር ግን" ተገቢው አያያዥ ቃል ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የራስ የሕይወት ታሪክ አፃፃፍን በተመለከተ ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ስለ አንድ ግለሰብ ሌላ ሰው የሚፅፈው ነው።
questions.explanation: የራስ የሕይወት ታሪክ (autobiography) ግለሰቡ ስለ ራሱ በህይወት እያለ የሚፅፈው የፅሁፍ ዓይነት ነው፤ ስለ ሌላ ሰው ሌላ ሰው ቢፅፈው "የህይወት ታሪክ" (biography) ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: አንድን ድርጊት፣ ሁነት በጊዜና በቦታ ቅደም ተከተል የሚያቀርብ የአንቀጽ ዓይነት ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ድርጊቶችን በጊዜና በቦታ ቅደም ተከተል የሚያቀርብ የአንቀጽ ዓይነት "ተራኪ" (narrative) ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የመሰናበቻና የመልካም ምኞት አገላለጽ የሚቀርበው በየትኛው የደብዳቤ ክፍል ነው?
questions.explanation: የመሰናበቻና የመልካም ምኞት አገላለጾች በደብዳቤ አጻጻፍ በመደምደሚያ ክፍል ውስጥ ይቀርባሉ።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ሰውነታቸው" የሚለው ቃል በምዕላድ ሲሸነሸን ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ሰውነታቸው" የሚለው ቃል ስረ-ቃል "ሰው"፣ የስም መፍጠሪያ ምዕላድ "ነት"፣ እና የባለቤትነት ምዕላድ "አቸው" ተጨምረው የተፈጠረ በመሆኑ ትክክለኛው ክፍፍል "ሰው-ነት-አቸው" ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ሰብአዊነታቸው" የሚለው ቃል በምዕላድ ሲከፋፈል ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ሰብአዊነታቸው" ስረ-ቃል "ሰብ" (ሰው)፣ ቅጽል መፍጠሪያ "አዊ"፣ የስም መፍጠሪያ "ንት"፣ እና የባለቤትነት "አቸው" ተጨምረው የተፈጠረ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "ዳኛ መልካም ሥነ ምግባር ያለው ሆራተኛ ነው" በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ቅጽል የሆነው ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "መልካም" የሚለው ቃል "ሥነ ምግባር" የሚለውን ስም የሚገልጽ ቅጽል ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: "መምህር" የሚለው ቃል ወደ ብዙ ቁጥር ሲለወጥ የሚወስደው ምዕላድ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "መምህር" የሚለው ቃል ብዙ ቁጥር ሲሆን "መምህራን" ተብሎ "-አን" የሚለውን ምዕላድ ይወስዳል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የሚቆጠር ስም የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ፍቅር" እና "ጤና" ረቂቅ (የማይቆጠሩ) ስሞች ሲሆኑ፣ "ሰው" ግን በቁጥር ሊቆጠር የሚችል (አንድ ሰው፣ ሁለት ሰዎች) ስም ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ብርሃኑ ልጁን _____ በተለቀመው ክፍት ቦታ ሊገባ የሚችለው የአሁን ጊዜ ግስ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የአሁን ጊዜ (present tense) ግስ "ያጥባል" ነው፤ የተቀሩት ያለፈ/ወደፊት ጊዜን ያመለክታሉ።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የወል ስም ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "ቤት" ነጠላ፣ የተለየ ነገርን የሚያመለክት ስም ሲሆን የወል (collective) ስም ባህርይ አይታይበትም። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ደራሲው መጥቷል። ይህ ዓረፍተ ነገር በየትኛው ጊዜ የተገለጸ ነው?
questions.explanation: "መጥቷል" የሚለው ግስ ያለፈ ድርጊትን የሚያመለክት በመሆኑ ዓረፍተ ነገሩ በሀላፊ (past) ጊዜ የተገለጸ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ተሳቢ የሆነው ግስ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "አመጣች" (አመጣች X) ተሳቢ (ተጨማሪ ግብ/ተሳቢ ስም) የሚፈልግ ግስ በመሆኑ ተሳቢ ግስ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: መለስ መጻሕፍትን ለወንድሙ ሰጠ። የተሰመረበት ቃል (መጻሕፍትን) ሚና ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: "መጻሕፍትን" ቀጥተኛ ተሳቢ (ርቱዕ ተሳቢ) ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ በቀጥታ የሚፈጸምበት ነገር ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የማይቆጠሩ ስሞችን በተመለከተ ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የማይቆጠሩ ስሞች (uncountable nouns) ብዛትን የሚያመለክት ምዕላድ (እንደ ብዙ ቁጥር ምልክት) አይወስዱም።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሀሰን የሰራው ቤት እጅግ ያምራል። የተሰመረበት ቃል (እጅግ) በየትኛው የተውሳከ ግስ ዓይነት ይመደባል?
questions.explanation: "እጅግ" የሚለው ቃል የመጠን/ሁኔታ ተውሳከ ግስ (adverb of degree/manner) ተብሎ ይመደባል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በምንባቡ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሲሆን፣ የፎቶግራፉ ግልጽነት ውስንነት ስላለበት መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል። / Note: this question depends on the exact wording of the source passage, which was difficult to read clearly from the photo, so the answer is a best-effort reading and should ideally be verified by a teacher against the original booklet.)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በዛብህ መጽሐፉን ለአባቱ ሰጠው። የተሰመረበት ቃል (ለአባቱ) ሚና ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: "ለአባቱ" ተዘዋዋሪ ተሳቢ (ኢ-ርቱዕ ተሳቢ) ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ በተዘዋዋሪ የተፈጸመለት አካልን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ ተሳቢ ግስ የያዘው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: "አነበበ" (አነበበ - መጽሐፍ) ተጨማሪ ተሳቢ ስም የሚፈልግ ተሳቢ ግስ ሲሆን፣ ቆመ፣ ሳቀ እና ገባ ግን ተሳቢ የማይፈልጉ (ኢ-ተሳቢ) ግሶች ናቸው።

questions.explanation: Reading passage — "The Three Children": Rahel lived with her two brothers, Genene and Dawit, in a small town in the countryside. She had the responsibility to look after them after both their parents had died. Rahel was 35 years old and the oldest child in the family. Genene was 25 years old. Dawit was the youngest boy in the family and he was 22 years old.
