questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Shalom: Good morning. Can I use your pen?
Eden: Good morning. Yes, you _____ use it.
questions.explanation: The modal verb "can" is used alone (without "to") to grant permission: "you can use it."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Nuriya: Hello, Selam!
Selam: Hello, Nuriya!
Nuriya: _____ my friend to you. Her name is Genet.
questions.explanation: Since Nuriya is presenting her friend by name, the correct expression is "Let me introduce my friend to you."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Basha: I feel headache. What do you advise me to do?
Balcha: You _____ go to clinic.
questions.explanation: "Should" is followed directly by the base verb ("should go"), making it the correct modal for giving advice here; "ought" would require "ought to go."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Muse: How is today?
Aster: It is _____ day. I love it.
questions.explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun "day," so "sunny" (not the noun "sun" or comparative/superlative forms) is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Medina: Hi, Bereket, how are you?
Bereket: _____. How are you medina?
questions.explanation: The grammatically correct and appropriate response to "How are you?" is "I am fine, thank you."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Sosina: Which do you prefer, orange or banana?
Nathan: I _____ orange to banana.
questions.explanation: The set expression "prefer X to Y" is used to compare preferences, matching Sosina's use of "prefer" in her question.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Beabsira: Excuse me, can I get a bank around here?
Betsega: Certainly, _____.
options: go along this road and turn left
it is not time to tell you now
you can get the shop around
questions.explanation: Since Betsega says "Certainly" (agreeing to help), the natural follow-up is to give directions: "go along this road and turn left."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Hana: Which hair style do you like?
Hirut: I like _____ hair.
questions.explanation: "Straight" is a proper hair-style descriptor, unlike "big," "fat," or "round," which don't naturally describe hair style.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Gabiso: What do you think about the corridor development program?
Lamiso: _____, it is good project.
questions.explanation: Since Gabiso asked for Lamiso's opinion ("What do you think"), the appropriate opening is "In my opinion," directly answering the question.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Elephants are _____ of all wild animals in the world.
questions.explanation: Comparing elephants to "all wild animals" (a group of three or more) requires the superlative form with "the": "the biggest."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: All our students _____ obey school rules.
questions.explanation: "Must" expresses a strong obligation, fitting the context of students being required to obey school rules.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: If he _____ quickly, he will get on time.
questions.explanation: In a first conditional sentence ("If + present simple, ... will + base verb"), the present simple "walks" is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Alemu is as _____ as Mesay.
questions.explanation: The comparative structure "as...as" for equal comparison uses the base adjective form: "as tall as."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: I _____ to use taxis because they are crowded.
questions.explanation: The subject "I" takes the auxiliary "don't" in the negative present simple: "I don't like."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Re-arrange the following jumbled words to make a complete sentence: textbook/my/I/read/yesterday
questions.explanation: The correct English word order is Subject–Verb–Object–Time: "I read my textbook yesterday."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Starting from September up to January, the rain <u>decreases</u> gradually. What is the Antonym of the underlined word?
questions.explanation: "Decreases" means to become smaller/less; its antonym (opposite) is "increase."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Drinking alcohol is a <u>harmful</u> practice. The Antonym of the underlined word is:
questions.explanation: "Harmful" means causing damage; its antonym is "useful" (beneficial). "Dangerous" and "destructive" are synonyms of harmful, not antonyms.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Parents should be very <u>kind</u> to their children. Choose the correct Synonym for the underlined word.
questions.explanation: "Kind" means gentle and considerate; "generous" is the closest synonym among the options, while "cruel" is its antonym.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Mothers always <u>desire</u> the success of their children. The Synonym of the underlined word is:
questions.explanation: "Desire" means to want strongly; its synonym is "wish." "Detest" and "dislike" are antonyms of desire.

questions.q: አግድም መስመሮች በካርታ ላይ የተሰመሩት የትኛውን አቅጣጫ ያመለክታሉ?
questions.explanation: አግድም መስመሮች (ላቲቲዩድ) ከምስራቅ ወደ ምዕራብ አቅጣጫ ይሰመራሉ። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — የምስራቅ አፍሪካ መገኛና ካርታ (Location & Maps)
questions.q: ምስራቅ አፍሪካን የማያዋስነው የውቅያኖስ/የባህር አካል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ምስራቅ አፍሪካ በህንድ ውቅያኖስ፣ በቀይ ባህርና በኤደን ባህረ ሰላጤ ይዋሰናል፤ በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ አይዋሰንም። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — የምስራቅ አፍሪካ መገኛና ካርታ (Location & Maps)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ሀገራት ውስጥ የአፍሪካ ቀንድ ሀገር የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሶማሊያ ከኢትዮጵያ፣ ከጅቡቲና ከኤርትራ ጋር በአፍሪካ ቀንድ አካባቢ ከሚመደቡ ሀገራት አንዷ ናት። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — የምስራቅ አፍሪካ መገኛና ካርታ (Location & Maps)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ትክክል ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ጎግል ካርታ (ኦንላይን) ለመጠቀም በአብዛኛው ኢንተርኔት ያስፈልጋል፤ ስለዚህ 'ኢንተርኔት አያስፈልግም' የሚለው ትክክል አይደለም። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት የአየር ውህዶች ውስጥ 78 በመቶ የሚሸፍነው ጋዝ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የከባቢ አየር ትልቁ ክፍል (~78%) ናይትሮጅን ጋዝ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ የመተንፈሻ ስርዓት ክፍል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አፍንጫ የመተንፈሻ ስርዓት (respiratory system) ዋነኛ ክፍል ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ድብልቆች ውስጥ አንዱ ተመሳሳይ (homogeneous) ድብልቅ ነው
questions.explanation: የጨው ውሃ ድብልቅ በደንብ ተቀላቅሎ ተመሳሳይ ስብጥር ስለሚይዝ ተመሳሳይ (homogeneous) ድብልቅ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ የጨው ውሃን መለያ ዘዴ ነው
questions.explanation: ትነት (evaporation) ውሃ በማትነን ጨው ብቻውን እንዲቀር በማድረግ ድብልቁን ለመለየት ይጠቅማል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ታዳሽ የጉልበት ምንጭ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ውሃ (ኃይድሮ ኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል ማመንጫ) ታዳሽ የጉልበት ምንጭ ነው፤ ድንጋይ ከሰልና ነዳጅ ግን ታዳሽ አይደሉም። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ውሃን ከጉድጓድ ለማውጣት የምንጠቀመው ቀላል መኪና ዓይነት የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ሽክርክሪትና ዘንግ (wheel and axle) ውሃ ከጉድጓድ ወይም ከጉድጓድ ውሃ ማውጫ (ጋን) ላይ ለማውጣት ከሚያገለግሉ ቀላል መኪኖች አንዱ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የሚገኙ አካባቢዎች ዝናብ የሚያገኙት መቼ ነው?
questions.explanation: የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል (እንደ ኢትዮጵያ ደጋማ አካባቢዎች) ዝናብ በዋናነት ከሰኔ እስከ መስከረም (ክረምት) ያገኛል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ዓመታዊ አማካይ የዝናብ መጠናቸው ከ250 ሚሜ በታች የሚገኙ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ የአየር ንብረት ክልል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: በረሃማ (arid/desert) አካባቢዎች ከ250 ሚሜ በታች ዝናብ ያገኛሉ። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ የማይገኘው የማዕድን ዓይነት የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ኢትዮጵያ ወርቅ፣ ጨውና ሶዳ አሽ ትታወቃለች፤ ዩራኒየም ግን በስፋት አይመረትም/አይታወቅም። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ውጤታማ የተፈጥሮ ሀብት አጠቃቀም ዘዴ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ዕፅዋትን መትከል የተፈጥሮ ሀብትን በዘላቂነት ለመጠበቅ የሚያግዝ ውጤታማ ዘዴ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ ለአፈር መሸርሸር ምክንያት የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ቁልቁለት ቦታን ቀጥ ብሎ ማረስ ውሃ በፍጥነት እንዲፈስ በማድረግ ለአፈር መሸርሸር ምክንያት ይሆናል፤ የእርከን ስራና አግድም ማረስ ግን መከላከያ ዘዴዎች ናቸው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — የምስራቅ አፍሪካ መገኛና ካርታ (Location & Maps)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ስምጥ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ያለ ትልቁ ሀይቅ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ቪክቶሪያ ሀይቅ በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ካሉ ሀይቆች ትልቁ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ቀልቀልና ግራር (አካሺያ) በየትኛው የአየር ንብረት ክልል ውስጥ ይገኛሉ?
questions.explanation: ቀልቀልና ግራር በዋናነት በሳር ምድር (ሳቫና) የአየር ንብረት ክልል ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ለመስኖ እርሻ የሚያገለግል ወንዝ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አዋሽ ወንዝ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ለመስኖ እርሻ በስፋት ከሚያገለግሉ ወንዞች አንዱ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ የውሃ ሀብቶች አጠቃቀም ተግዳሮት ነው
questions.explanation: የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ በምስራቅ አፍሪካ የውሃ ሀብት አጠቃቀም ላይ ትልቅ ተግዳሮት ይፈጥራል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ትክክለኛ ተዛምዶ ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ግልገል ጊቤ የኃይል ማመንጫ ግድብ ከኦሞ ወንዝ ጋር እንጂ ከተከዜ ወንዝ ጋር ስለማይዛመድ ትክክል ያልሆነው ተዛምዶ ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ በአልማዝ ማዕድን የሚታወቀው ሀገር የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ታንዛንያ በአልማዝ ማዕድን ምርት ትታወቃለች። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ለደን መመናመን ምክንያት ከሚሆኑ ድርጊቶች ውስጥ የማይመደበው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ችግኞችን ማዘጋጀትና መትከል ደንን ከመመናመን ይልቅ ለማልማት የሚያግዝ ተግባር ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ማዕድናት አጠቃቀም ተግዳሮት የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂ አለመኖር የማዕድናት ልማትና አጠቃቀም ላይ ተግዳሮት ይፈጥራል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት ውስጥ የሚመደብ የቱ ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: ሱዳን ከምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት ውስጥ ትመደባለች።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ሀገራት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የሕዝብ ብዛት ያለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ኢትዮጵያ ከምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት መካከል ከፍተኛ የሕዝብ ብዛት አላት። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: የብዊንዲ ጥቅጥቅ ደን ብሔራዊ ፓርክ የሚገኝበት ሀገር የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የብዊንዲ ጥቅጥቅ ደን ብሔራዊ ፓርክ በዩጋንዳ ይገኛል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ ቅርሶች ለሀገር ከሚያበረክቱት አስተዋፅኦ ውስጥ የማይመደብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ቅርሶች የኢኮኖሚ ዕድገትን ያሳድጋሉ እንጂ አይቀንሱም፤ ስለዚህ 'ለመቀነስ' የሚለው የማይመደብ አማራጭ ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ ሰው ሠራሽ የቱሪዝም መዳረሻ ነው
questions.explanation: አሞ ፓርክ (የመዝናኛ ፓርክ) ሰው ሠራሽ የቱሪዝም መዳረሻ ሲሆን የተቀሩት የተፈጥሮ መስህቦች ናቸው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ የቱሪዝም ጠቀሜታ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ቱሪዝም ሀገራትን ለዓለም ማስተዋወቅ ላይ ትልቅ ጠቀሜታ አለው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ በአደገኛ ዕፅ ሱስኝነት የማይገለጸው የቱ ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ምልክት ስላልነበረው፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: ቡና መጠጣት ከአልኮል፣ ጫትና ሲጋራ በተለየ በተለምዶ አደገኛ ዕፅ ሱስ ተብሎ አይመደብም።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ጎጂ ልማዳዊ ድርጊት የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የሴት ልጅ ግርዛት በጤናና በሰብዓዊ መብት ላይ ጎጂ ውጤት ስላለው ጎጂ ልማዳዊ ድርጊት ተብሎ ይመደባል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ አንዱ በምስራቅ አፍሪካ የድርቅ መንስኤ ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ከብቶችን ለረጅም ጊዜ አንድ ቦታ ማሰማራት
questions.explanation: አዝርዕት አፈራርቆ መዝራት (crop rotation) ጥሩ የግብርና ልማድ እንጂ ለድርቅ መንስኤ አይደለም።

questions.subject: english
questions.q: He ___ coffee twice a day.
questions.explanation: Habitual present action with 'he' takes the -s form: 'drinks'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The children ___ football now.
questions.explanation: 'The children' (plural) + present continuous for an action happening now: 'are playing'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: My sister ___ clothes yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' signals simple past tense: 'washed'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Teacher Genet ___ support her students in reading lesson.
questions.explanation: A simple future prediction/decision uses 'will'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Martha ___ go to market last week because she was sick.
questions.explanation: Past inability is expressed with 'couldn't'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Bursame is ___ food in Sidama culture.
questions.explanation: Superlative form: 'the most delicious'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Ato Mesfin ___ sufficient goods, so his shop is full now.
questions.explanation: Present perfect with singular subject 'Ato Mesfin': 'has bought'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Students ___ wear school uniform in the school compound.
questions.explanation: An obligation/rule is expressed with the modal 'must'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: My uncle stopped ___ cigarette last year.
questions.explanation: 'Stop' + gerund (stopped smoking) means to quit doing something.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the correct passive form: 'My mother makes breakfast every morning.'
options: Breakfast is made by my mother every morning.
Breakfast was made by my mother every morning.
Breakfast is being made by my mother every morning.
Breakfast is making by my mother every morning.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive: subject + is/am/are + past participle: 'Breakfast is made...'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The man ___ his lunch before he went to the garden.
questions.explanation: Past perfect is used for an action completed before another past action: 'had eaten'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: If Masantu ___ her lesson properly, she will pass the exam.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, ...will + base verb: 'studies'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: I ___ the meaning of words if I got a dictionary.
questions.explanation: Second conditional (hypothetical 'if I got'): would + base verb: 'would refer'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Leopards run ___ than elephants.
questions.explanation: Comparative form of a short adjective/adverb: 'faster'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Tedi: Good morning Alem, how are you doing? Alem: Not bad. How about you? Tedi: ___.
questions.explanation: A complete, grammatically correct reply to 'how about you' is 'I am fine, thank you'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Abeba: What do you prefer, fruit or vegetable? Duguna: I really prefer vegetable to fruit. What is the intention of Duguna?
options: He likes fruit better than vegetable.
He likes vegetables better than fruit.
He likes both fruit and vegetable equally.
questions.explanation: 'Prefer vegetable to fruit' means he likes vegetables more than fruit.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Stranger: Excuse me, can you tell me where the Ethiopian Commercial Bank is? Resident: ___.
options: I am not the customer of Ethiopian Commercial Bank.
Go straight along this road and turn left. It is near the first building.
Why do you need to know about the bank?
questions.explanation: A helpful, direct response giving directions fits the question asked.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Belay: Hard work is more important than wish. What is your opinion? Aster: ___. (Expressing agreement)
options: I am not so sure about that
questions.explanation: The instruction asks for an expression of agreement: 'I totally agree with you'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Ahmed: ___? Fatuma: You had better go to clinic.
options: I have bad headache. What do you advise me to do?
I should take shower and get rest.
I have lost my pen. What do you suggest me to do?
My English result is low. What do you advise me to do?
questions.explanation: Fatuma's advice to go to a clinic responds to a health complaint: 'I have bad headache...'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which one is true about the idea in paragraph 1? (Reading passage "Tessema's Grandparents": Grandparents are usually old but they have a young spirit. My mother's parents are very generous. They are always happy unless they are a bit ill. They have rheumatism or a cold that they control with some medicine. Mesele is Tessema's grandfather and he is 60 years old. Atote is Tessema's grandmother and she is five years younger than him. He was a carpenter when he was young and still he does some piece of furniture for me. I have a table in my bedroom made by him. My grandma who was a nurse and she worked at the local hospital for 40 years. They live 5 kilometers away from our house so we don't see them every day. We often have lunch on Sundays with them. My dad's grandparents live in Arbegona because they have a house there. We go to visit them every two years. They are very friendly and they are quite old too. Lalo is her name and Lamiso his name. They were both teachers. They met for the first time at the school. They have lived together for 45 years. People say that grandparents spoil grandchildren. Perhaps it's true but they are very happy to have their grandkids with them. They cook and buy presents for them. I love my grandparents very much.)
options: My father's parents are always generous.
My mother's parents are always healthy.
My mother's parents are always happy.
questions.explanation: The passage states the mother's parents 'are always happy unless they are a bit ill'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: How old is grandmother Atote?
questions.explanation: Grandfather Mesele is 60; Atote is five years younger than him, so she is 55.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What did Mesele do when he was young?
questions.explanation: The passage says: 'He was a carpenter when he was young'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: For how long did nurse grandma work in the local hospital?
questions.explanation: The passage says grandma 'worked at the local hospital for 40 years'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Who lives five kilometers away from Tessema's house?
questions.explanation: The passage refers to the mother's-side grandparents (Mesele and Atote) living 5 kilometers away. (ማስታወሻ፦ የመልስ አማራጮች ከምንጩ ፅሁፍ ጋር ሙሉ በሙሉ ስለማይመሳሰሉ በአስተማሪ ቢጣራ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Why do the grandparents live in Arbegona?
options: Because they have a house there.
Because they have a shop there.
Because they have a farm there.
questions.explanation: The passage says: 'My dad's grandparents live in Arbegona because they have a house there'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The grandchildren visit their dad's grandparents ___.
questions.explanation: The passage says: 'We go to visit them every two years'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Lalo and Lamiso met for the first time ___.
questions.explanation: The passage says: 'They met for the first time at the school'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What does the pronoun 'he' refer to in paragraph 1, line 4?
questions.explanation: 'he is 60 years old' refers to Mesele, Tessema's grandfather.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What does the pronoun 'they' refer to in paragraph 2, line 12?
questions.explanation: 'They were both teachers' refers to Lalo and Lamiso, described in the same sentence.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What does the word 'generous' mean in paragraph 1, line 2?
questions.explanation: 'Generous' in this context means kind/giving.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...to visit them' in paragraph 2, line 11. What does the word 'visit' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Visit' means to go and see/meet someone.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Farmers ___ seed when the rainy season comes.
questions.explanation: 'Sow seed' is the correct collocation, meaning to plant seeds.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Helicopter ___ the attention of people hovering over the stadium.
questions.explanation: 'Distracts' fits: the helicopter draws/distracts people's attention.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: When you continue to ___ school rules, you will be punished.
questions.explanation: 'Disobey school rules' means to break the rules, which leads to punishment.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Scientists are ___ in their work.
questions.explanation: 'Diligent' means hardworking/careful, fitting scientists' work habits.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Prepares/breakfast/for/the/family/my/mother — rearrange to make a correct sentence.
options: Breakfast prepares my mother for the family.
The family prepares my mother for breakfast.
For the family prepares breakfast my mother.
My mother prepares breakfast for the family.
questions.explanation: Correct word order: subject 'My mother' + verb 'prepares' + object 'breakfast' + phrase 'for the family'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Stranger/barks/it/the/dog/sees/when/a — rearrange to make a correct sentence.
options: The dog sees a stranger when it barks.
The dog barks when it sees a stranger.
A stranger barks the dog when it sees.
Barks the dog when it sees a stranger.
questions.explanation: Correct word order: 'The dog barks when it sees a stranger.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Combine: 'Technology is very important. Technology is not accessible.' Choose the correct compound sentence.
options: Technology is very important, or it is not accessible.
Technology is very important, and it is accessible.
Technology is very important, but it is not accessible.
Technology is very important, but it is accessible.
questions.explanation: The two ideas contrast, so they are joined with 'but': '...important, but it is not accessible.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Combine: 'Farmers harvest grain. Farmers feed the people.' Choose the correct compound sentence.
options: Farmers harvest grain, but they feed the people.
Farmers harvest grain, or they feed the people.
Farmers harvest grain, and they feed the people.
Farmers feed the people, but they harvest grain.
questions.explanation: The two ideas are both true and additive, so they are joined with 'and'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Decide the type of the paragraph: 'He has a round face with brown eyes. His hair is black and curly. Though young, he looks older than his age because of some wrinkles on his face. He also has a simple dimple on his cheeks which makes him to be handsome.'
questions.explanation: The paragraph describes physical appearance in detail, which makes it a descriptive paragraph.

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: 'ናፈ' ለሚለው ቃል ተመሳሳይ ፍቺ ያለው የቱ ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: 'ናፈ' የመቀነስ/የመጎደል ስሜት ያለው ቃል ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ቃላት ውስጥ በፍቺ ልዩ የሆነው (odd one out) የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ምሁር፣ ሊቅ እና ጠቢብ ሁሉም 'የተማረ/ጠቢብ' ማለት ሲሆኑ፣ ሰነፍ ግን 'ሰነፍ' ማለት ተቃራኒ ትርጉም አለው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ውብ ለሚለው ቃል በፍቺ ተመሳሳይ የሆነው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ውብ' እና 'ቆንጆ' ተመሳሳይ ትርጉም ያላቸው ቃላት ናቸው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ጎታታ ለሚለው ቃል በፍቺ ተቃራኒ የሆነው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ጎታታ' የዝግተኝነት ስሜት ሲሰጥ፣ ተቃራኒው 'ቀልጣፋ' (ፈጣን) ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ዱካሞ በትምህርቱ እሳት ነው። የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺ ምንድን ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: 'እሳት ነው' የሚለው በዚህ አገባብ 'በጣም ጎበዝ ነው' የሚል ፍካሬያዊ ትርጉም አለው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሁላማዊት በስራዋ ንብ ናት። የተሰመረበት ቃል እማሪያዊ (ፍካሬያዊ) ፍቺ ምንድን ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ንብ' የመትጋትና የትጋት ምልክት ሆኖ ስለሚያገለግል 'ታታሪ' ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ቃላት በተለያዩ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ በተመሳሳይ ቦታ ገብተው የሚሰጡት የተለያየ ፍቺ ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: በዓረፍተ ነገር አውድ ውስጥ የሚለያይ ፍቺ 'አውዳዊ ፍቺ' ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የተተከለው በርበሬ ወቅቱን ጠብቆ ቀላ። የተሰመረበት ቃል አገባዊ ፍቺ ምንድን ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ቀላ' በዚህ አገባብ 'ደረሰ' (ripened) ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሰፈረ ብሎ ከተመ አሆነ፤ አለመ ብሎ ___ ይሆናል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: 'አለመ' ማለት ኢላማ/ግብ ማድረግ ማለት ስለሆነ 'አነጣጠረ' ከሚለው ጋር ይዛመዳል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በከፍተኛ የትምህርት ተቋማት የሚሰጠው የግጭት አፈታት የትምህርት መስክ ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: በከፍተኛ የትምህርት ተቋማት 'የሠላም መፈለጊያ ዘዴ' (Peace Studies) እየተሰጠ ይገኛል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: በየትኛውም አካባቢ በሚኖር ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ ግለሰቦች እርስ በርስ ሲጣሉ ሊፈጠር ከሚችሉ ችግሮች ውስጥ የሚካተተው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ግጭት ሲፈጠር ከሚያስከትላቸው አሉታዊ ውጤቶች አንዱ የሰው ህይወት ማለፍ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: በሀገራችን ውስጥ በሚኖር ሁሉም ማህበረሰብ ዘንድ ሊገኝ የሚገባው የቱ ነው?
options: ግጭትን ለመፍታት ፍርድ ቤት ብቻ መጠቀም
የሰላም መፈለጊያ ዘዴዎችን ወደ ጎን መተው
questions.explanation: ግጭት ሲፈጠር በህግ አግባብ መስተካከል ያለበት በመሆኑ ትክክለኛው መልስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: አንቀጽ አንድ፣ አራተኛ መስመር ላይ 'ዘርፍ' የሚለው ቃል አገባዊ ፍቺ ምንድን ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: 'ዘርፍ' በዚህ አገባብ 'ዓይነት/መስክ' ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: ሁለተኛ አንቀጽ፣ ሶስተኛ መስመር ላይ 'መገሰፅ' የሚለው ቃል አገባዊ ፍቺ ምንድን ነው?
questions.explanation: 'መገሰፅ' ማለት ማስተማር/መምከር ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: ሶስተኛ አንቀጽ፣ አራተኛ መስመር ላይ 'ደንብ' የሚለው ቃል አገባዊ ፍቺ ምንድን ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: 'ደንብ' በዚህ አገባብ 'ውሳኔ' ወይም ደንብ/ስርዓት ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት አምስት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ ትክክለኛው ቅደም ተከተል የቱ ነው? (1. ከዚያም ከቤተሰቦቹ ጋር ቀርስ በላ፤ 2. ከመኝታው እንደተነሳ ፊቱን ታጠበ፤ 3. በመጨረሻም ደብተሩን ይዞ ወደ ትምህርት ቤት ሄደ፤ 4. በመቀጠልም የትምህርት ቤት ደንብ ልብሱን ለበሰ፤ 5. መልሙ በጠዋት ከእንቅልፉ ተነሳ)
questions.explanation: ትክክለኛው ቅደም ተከተል፦ ከእንቅልፍ መንቃት(5)→ፊት መታጠብ(2)→ደንብ ልብስ መልበስ(4)→ቁርስ መብላት(1)→ወደ ትምህርት ቤት መሄድ(3) ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: አለሙ መጽሐፍ ገዛ ___ ደረሰ። በዓረፍተ ነገሩ ውስጥ 'ወይም' የሚለውን ቃል ተክቶ ሊገባ የሚችለው ስርዓተ ነጥብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: '፡' የሚለው ስርዓተ ነጥብ በአማርኛ ፅሁፍ ውስጥ አማራጭ ሃሳቦችን ለማገናኘት ሊያገለግል ይችላል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: በፅሁፍ ውስጥ ቀን፣ ወርና ዓመተ ምህረትን ለይቶ ለመፃፍ የሚያገለግለው ስርዓተ ነጥብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: '፡' (ኮሎን) ቀን፣ ወርና ዓመተ ምህረትን ለይቶ ለመግለጽ ያገለግላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: በድርሰት ውስጥ ስለሚፃፈው ጉዳይ የሚተዋወቅበት ክፍል ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ድርሰት ስለሚፃፈው ጉዳይ የሚተዋወቅበት ክፍል 'መግቢያ' ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የድርሰት ማዕከላዊ ክፍልን የሚይዘው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ድርሰት ውስጥ ዋነኛውን ሃሳብ የያዘው ክፍል 'ሐተታ' ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: ከላይ በቀረበው የማመልከቻ አፃፃፍ ቅፅ ውስጥ በተራ ቁጥር 3 የሚፃፈው ምንድን ነው? (ቅደም ተከተል፦ 1.ቀን 2.የሚፃፍለት ድርጅት/ተቋም ስም 3.___ 4.ሐተታ 5.ከሠላምታ ጋር 6.ፊርማ 7.የአመልካች ስም) (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: በማመልከቻ አጻጻፍ ቅፅ ውስጥ ከድርጅቱ ስም በኋላ 'ጉዳዩ' (subject) ይፃፋል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: የሰው የሕይወት ታሪክ ሲፃፍ የማይካተተው የትኛው ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: የዕለት ክንውኖች (daily events) ከሕይወት ታሪክ ይልቅ ለማስታወሻ ደብተር (diary) ይመች እንደሆነ ስለሚቆጠር አይካተትም።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 2 — የንባብ ክፍልና የፅሁፍ ስራ (Reading & Composition)
questions.q: የሰው የሕይወት ታሪክ አፃፃፍን በተመለከተ ትክክል የሆነው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: የሕይወት ታሪክ ሲፃፍ ሁለቱንም አዎንታዊና አሉታዊ ገጽታዎች ማካተት ትክክለኛ አካሄድ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: 'አስቴር በጣም ንቁ ተማሪ ናት።' በዚህ ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የግል (ልዩ) ስም የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'አስቴር' የግለሰብ ስም (ልዩ ስም) ስለሆነ ትክክለኛው መልስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የወል ስም የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ፍራፍሬ' የተለያዩ ፍራፍሬ ዓይነቶችን በጠቅላላ የሚወክል የወል ስም ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የጊዜ ተውሳከ ግስ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ዛሬ' ጊዜን የሚገልጽ ተውሳከ ግስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: 'ትላንት የወንድሜ የልደት በዓል ተከበረ።' ይህ ዓረፍተ ነገር በየትኛው የጊዜ ገፅታ ይመደባል?
questions.explanation: 'ትላንት...ተከበረ' ያለፈ ጊዜን ስለሚገልጽ 'በሐላፊ' ይመደባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ በሐላፊ ጊዜ የቀረበው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ትናንት መጥቷል' ያለፈ ጊዜን የሚገልጽ ግስ ስላለው ትክክለኛው መልስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: [ልብሳችንን] በሚለው ቃል ውስጥ ድህረ ቅጥያው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ልብስ' + 'ኣችን' (የእኛ የብዙ ቁጥር ንብረት ቅጥያ) = 'ልብሳችን(ን)'።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ___ በጣም ፈጣን ሯጮች ናቸው። በክፍት ቦታው ሊገባ የሚችለው ተውላጠ ስም የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ናቸው' የሚለው ግስ ብዙ ቁጥር ስለሆነ 'እነርሱ' ይገባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ቅጽል የሆነው ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ቸር' ስምን የሚገልጽ ቅጽል ቃል ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: 'መንገዱ በጣም ሰፊ ___ ነው።' በተሰመረበት ቦታ ሊገባ የሚችለው የቃል ክፍል ምንድን ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: 'ሰፊ' የቅጽል ቃል ስለሆነ ተመሳሳይ የቃል ክፍል (ቅጽል) ይገባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ላቢ (ተሳቢ የሚፈልግ) ግስ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ሰበረ' ተሳቢ (ምን?) የሚፈልግ ላቢ ግስ ነው (ምሳሌ፦ ብርጭቆ ሰበረ)።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ቀጥሎ ከቀረቡት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ውስጥ ኢ-ላቢ ግስን የያዘው የቱ ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ በዝርዝር ግልጽ ስላልነበረ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: በአማራጮቹ መካከል ተሳቢ የግድ የማይፈልገው ግስ የያዘው ዓረፍተ ነገር ለይቶ ማወቅ ስለሚያስቸግር በአስተማሪ ቢጣራ ይመረጣል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: [እንደቤታቸው] የሚለው ቃል በምዕላድ ሲከፋፈል ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'እንደቤታቸው' = እንደ + ቤት + አቸው ተብሎ በምዕላድ ይከፋፈላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ርቱዕ (ቀጥተኛ) ተሳቢ ሊወስድ የሚችለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ወሰደ' ተሳቢ (ምን ወሰደ?) ስለሚፈልግ ቀጥተኛ ተሳቢ ሊወስድ የሚችል ግስ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: 'ስባሩ' የሚለው ቃል ከያዘቻቸው ጥገኛ ምዕላዶች መካከል የድርጊት መደጋገምን የሚያመለክተው የትኛው ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ያልነበረ ስለሆነ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: '-ራ-' የሚለው ጥገኛ ምዕላድ በአማርኛ ግስ ውስጥ የድርጊት መደጋገምን (frequentative) ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «መምህሩ ሲመጡ ተማሪዎች ወደ ክፍል ገቡ» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ጥገኛ ሃረግ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'መምህሩ ሲመጡ' ራሱን ችሎ ሙሉ ሃሳብ መስጠት ስለማይችል ጥገኛ ሃረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «እግሬን ወለም ስላለኝ ከዘራ መያዝ አለብኝ» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ጥገኛ ሃረግ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'እግሬን ወለም ስላለኝ' ምክንያትን የሚገልጽ ጥገኛ ሃረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች መካከል የቦታ ተውሳከ ግስ የሚያገለግል ቃል ወይም ሃረግ ያለበት የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ወደ ውስጥ' ቦታን የሚገልጽ ተውሳከ ግስ ሃረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ሰጠችኝ» እና «ሰጠሽኝ» በሚሉት ሁለት ቃላት መካከል ያለው የፍቺ ልዩነት በቅደም ተከተል የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ሰጠችኝ' ሦስተኛ መደብ ሴት ተናጋሪን (እሷ) ሲያመለክት፣ 'ሰጠሽኝ' ሁለተኛ መደብ ሴት ተናጋሪን (አንቺ) ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ደስታና ሃዘን ተስፋና ፍራት፣ የሰውን ልጅ ዕድሜ ይዘው ያሳት፣ እየቆራረጡ ተከፋፍሏት። (ከበደ ሚካኤል፣ 2007፡78) ይህ ግጥም ስንት ሃረጋት አሉት?
questions.explanation: ግጥሙ ሰባት ሃረጋት አሉት፦ ደስታና/ ሃዘን/ ተስፋና/ ፍራት/ የሰውን ልጅ ዕድሜ/ ይዘው ያሳት/ እየቆራረጡ ተከፋፍሏት።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከላይ በቀረበው ግጥም ውስጥ የሁለተኛው ስንኝ የመጀመሪያው ሃረግ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የሁለተኛው ስንኝ ('የሰውን ልጅ ዕድሜ ይዘው ያሳት') የመጀመሪያ ሃረግ 'የሰውን ልጅ ዕድሜ' ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ጀግና ነው ይላሉ ደላሉ ተኪሽ ነው ይላሉ ደላሉ የታል ጀግንነቱ፣ በክር አይደለም ወይ የታሰረው ጣቱ» የሚለው ግጥም የመጀመሪያ ስንኝ በሃረግ ሲከፈል ትክክለኛው የትኛው ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ያልነበረ ስለሆነ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
options: ጀግና ነው/ ይላሉ ደላሉ/ ተኪሽ ነው/ ይላሉ ደላሉ/ የታል ጀግንነቱ
ጀግና ነው ይላሉ ደላሉ/ ተኪሽ ነው/ ይላሉ ደላሉ/ የታል ጀግንነቱ
ጀግና/ ነው ይላሉ/ ደላሉ/ ተኪሽ/ ነው ይላሉ/ የታል ጀግንነቱ
ጀግና ነው/ ይላሉ ደላሉ ተኪሽ ነው ይላሉ/ የታል ጀግንነቱ
questions.explanation: ስንኙ በተፈጥሮ ንባብ ክፍተት መሰረት 'ጀግና ነው/ ይላሉ ደላሉ/ ተኪሽ ነው/ ይላሉ ደላሉ/ የታል ጀግንነቱ' ተብሎ በአምስት ሃረግ ይከፈላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ተነስቶ ቢሄድ ምን ነው ወይ በሬ፣ ነገርን ካልተዉት ______» የሚለውን ስንኝ ሃሳብ የተሟላ የሚያደርገው የቱ ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ያልነበረ ስለሆነ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: ስንኙ ነገርን አለመተው የሚያመጣውን ጉዳት ስለሚገልጽ፣ ትርጉሙን የሚያሟላው 'ከነገር ቢርቁ' የሚለው ሃረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «እሱህ ነው እንጂ ያከሳው ደረቴን፣ መች ሳልበላ አደርኩ አንድ እንጀራ ራቴን» የሚለውን የግጥም ሃሳብ በአንድ ዓረፍተ ነገር ብናስቀምጠው ትክክለኛው የቱ ነው?
options: በልቶ ማደር አንድ እንጀራ ቢያንስም ሃዘን ግን አያመጣም።
questions.explanation: ግጥሙ አንድ እንጀራ እንኳን ሳይበላ ማደር የሚያመጣውን ችግር ስለሚገልጽ 'እራት ሳልበላ ማደር ያሳዝናል' የሚለው ሃሳብ ትክክለኛ ማጠቃለያ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሁለቱ ቃላዊ ግጥሞች ልዩነት ምንድነው? ሀ. «በሬ እንዳለ የሚያርስ የሚያሽከረክር እንዝርትም አይገኝ ከዚያ መንደር።» ለ. «እርሻ ያረሰና የወንዝ ዳር ዛፍ ዘላለም ይኖራል አበባው ሳይረግፍ።»
options: የመጀመሪያው ስለ በሬ፣ ሁለተኛው ስለ ወንዝ ዳር ዛፍ መናገሩ
የመጀመሪያው በሬን፣ ሁለተኛው እርሻ ገበሬን ማድነቁ
የመጀመሪያው የእርሻ ግጥም ሲሆን፣ ሁለተኛው የውዳሴ ግጥም መሆኑ
የመጀመሪያው የጀግንነት፣ ሁለተኛው የስንፍና ግጥም መሆኑ
questions.explanation: የመጀመሪያው ግጥም በሬን ሲያደንቅ፣ ሁለተኛው ግጥም እርሻ ገበሬን (ገበሬውን) ያደንቃል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «የወንድነት ክብሩን ለልጅ ሲል የጣለ፣ ካባቶችም መሃል፣ እናት አባት አለ።» (ኢዛና መስፍን፣ 2000፡68) የዚህ ግጥም ጭብጥ ምንድነው?
options: ወንድ ልጅ ሲል እንደ እናት ክብር አለ።
ልጅ በእናቱና በአባቱ መሃል ክብር አለው።
ለልጅ ሲል ወንድነቱን ትቶ እንደ እናት የሚሆን አባት አለ።
ልጅ፣ አባትና እናት አብረው ሲኖሩ ይከበራሉ።
questions.explanation: ግጥሙ ለልጁ ሲል የወንድነት ክብሩን ትቶ እንደ እናት ተንከባካቢ የሚሆን አባት እንዳለ ይገልጻል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — ስርዓተ ነጥብና የዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀር
questions.q: «አንቺ ወዲያ ማድ እኔ ወዲህ ማድ፣ ______ ገደሉ ተንደ» ባዶ በታውን ሲሞላ የሚችለው ተመጣጣኝ ሃረግ የቱ ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ያልነበረ ስለሆነ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
questions.explanation: ስንኙ በሁለት ተቃራኒ አቅጣጫ የቆሙ ሰዎችን መራራቅ ስለሚገልጽ 'አንገናኝም ወይ' የሚለው ሃረግ ተስማሚ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — ስርዓተ ነጥብና የዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀር
questions.q: «ዓሳ ጎርንብር ዘንድ ያወጣል እንዲሉ የሰውን ጥፋት እየተናገረ የራሱን ወንጀል አጋለጠ» የሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር በትክክለኛ ስርዓተ ነጥብ ሲፃፍ ከሚከተሉት የትኛው ነው? (ማስታወሻ፦ ይህ ጥያቄ በፎቶግራፉ ላይ ግልጽ ያልነበረ ስለሆነ፣ መልሱ በአስተማሪ ቢረጋገጥ ይመረጣል።)
options: «ዓሳ ጎርንብር ዘንድ ያወጣል» እንዲሉ፤ የሰውን ጥፋት እየተናገረ የራሱን ወንጀል አጋለጠ።
ዓሳ ጎርንብር ዘንድ ያወጣል እንዲሉ፤ የሰውን ጥፋት እየተናገረ የራሱን ወንጀል አጋለጠ
«ዓሳ ጎርንብር ዘንድ ያወጣል» እንዲሉ፤ የሰውን ጥፋት እየተናገረ የራሱን ወንጀል አጋለጠ
«ዓሳ ጎርንብር ዘንድ ያወጣል እንዲሉ»፤ የሰውን ጥፋት እየተናገረ የራሱን ወንጀል አጋለጠ።
questions.explanation: የተጠቀሰው አገላለጽ ('ዓሳ ጎርንብር ዘንድ ያወጣል') በጥቅስ ምልክት ውስጥ መግባትና ዓረፍተ ነገሩ በነጥብ መጠናቀቅ ስላለበት አማራጭ A ትክክለኛ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — ስርዓተ ነጥብና የዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀር
questions.q: ትክክለኛው የጥያቄ ምልክት አጠቃቀም የሚታይበት ዓረፍተ ነገር የቱ ነው?
options: መምህሩ እንደ ነገሩኝ ከሆነ ፈተናችን ነገ ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ግራ ገባህ ወይ?' ትክክለኛ ጥያቄ ስለሆነ በጥያቄ ምልክት በትክክል ያለቀ ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው፤ የተቀሩት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ትዕዛዝ ወይም ተራ አረፍተ ነገር ስለሆኑ በጥያቄ ምልክት መጠናቀቅ የለባቸውም።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — ስርዓተ ነጥብና የዓረፍተ ነገር አወቃቀር
questions.q: «ጎበኚዎቹ ነገ ሎጊታ ፉፉቴን በጥንቃቄ ይጎበኛሉ» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የጊዜ ተውሳከ ግስ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: 'ነገ' ጊዜን የሚገልጽ ተውሳከ ግስ ነው።

questions.subject: english
questions.q: According to the passage: (Reading passage "Volcanoes": A volcano is a mountain that opens down into the Earth. Volcanoes release gases, and very hot melted rock (molten rock) escapes to earth's surface. The large plates underneath the earth sometimes move. When these plates collide, magma is pushed upwards through the opening of the volcano. When the molten rock is still inside the ground, it is called magma. After it has left the volcano, it is called lava. Not all volcanoes erupt in the same way. Some volcanoes erupt powerfully, shooting lava out of the top of the volcano and into the air. Other volcanoes erupt more gently, letting lava flow out slowly. Lava can sometimes flow out of the sides of the volcano. Many people live near volcanoes. One reason people choose to live near a volcano is farming. Volcanoes drop minerals in the soil which help make the soil excellent for growing food. Another reason is tourism. Some people choose to visit volcanoes on their holidays. For this reason, there are many jobs near volcanoes. Many people who live near volcanoes can't afford to move away from their home. Other people live near a volcano for religious or spiritual reasons.)
options: Volcanoes are very dangerous and useless.
People benefit from living around volcanoes.
Volcanic eruptions are caused by manmade forces.
People live near volcanoes for similar reasons.
questions.explanation: The passage lists several benefits people get from living near volcanoes: farming (fertile soil), tourism/jobs, and religious/spiritual reasons.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which one of the following statements is true about volcanoes?
options: All volcanoes erupt at the same time.
Collision of the magma causes volcanic eruption.
Volcanoes that erupt powerfully don't let lava flow.
Volcanic eruption releases molten rocks and gases.
questions.explanation: The passage states volcanoes release gases and very hot melted rock (magma/lava).

questions.subject: english
questions.q: One of the following is NOT mentioned as a reason for people to live near volcanoes.
questions.explanation: The passage mentions farming, tourism, and religious/spiritual reasons — sports activities are not mentioned.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...erupt...' paragraph 2 means:
questions.explanation: In this context, 'erupt' means to explode or burst out forcefully.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...which...' paragraph 3, line 2 refers to:
questions.explanation: '...minerals in the soil which help make the soil excellent...' — 'which' refers back to 'minerals'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Chelada baboon and Walia ibex are ___ animals. They are found only in Ethiopia.
questions.explanation: 'Endemic' means native to and found only in a specific place, which matches 'found only in Ethiopia'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Kirar and Washint are among the ___ musical instruments of Ethiopia.
questions.explanation: Kirar and Washint are traditional Ethiopian musical instruments.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Many farmers are ___ their crops in the field because the crops are ripe.
questions.explanation: Ripe crops are gathered through harvesting.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Children in the kindergarten like to draw pictures.
questions.explanation: 'Draw' in this context is closest in meaning to 'make' (create pictures).

questions.subject: english
questions.q: My uncle is an addicted person. He smokes cigarettes every 30 minutes.
questions.explanation: 'Addicted' means habitually dependent on something, similar in meaning to 'habituated'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The school is studying the causes of dropout as many students left school in the middle of the semester.
questions.explanation: 'Dropout' refers to students leaving school before completing it, matching 'leaving'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: One cause of air pollution is gases released from factories to the atmosphere.
questions.explanation: 'Pollution' means contamination of the environment.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: According to the passage, obesity: (Reading passage "Obesity": Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have an adverse effect on health, leading to reduced life expectancy and/or increased health problems. Body mass index (BMI), a measurement which compares weight and height, defines people as overweight (pre-obese) when their BMI is between 25 kg/m2 and 30 kg/m2, and obese when it is greater than 30 kg/m2. Obesity increases the likelihood of various diseases, particularly heart disease, type 2 diabetes, breathing difficulties during sleep and certain types of cancer. Obesity is most commonly caused by a combination of excessive dietary calories, lack of physical activity, and genetic susceptibility. Evidence to support the view that some obese people eat little yet gain weight due to a slow metabolism is limited; on average obese people have a greater energy expenditure than their thin counterparts due to the energy required to maintain an increased body mass. The primary treatment for obesity is dieting and physical exercise. To supplement this, anti-obesity drugs may be taken to reduce appetite or inhibit fat absorption. In severe cases, surgery is performed or an intra-gastric balloon is placed to reduce stomach volume leading to earlier satisfaction and reduced ability to absorb nutrients from food. Obesity is a leading preventable cause of death worldwide, with increasing occurrence in adults and children, and authorities view it as one of the most serious public health problems of the 21st century.)
options: is a health problem that can be avoided
is the root cause of various diseases
increases the life expectancy of people
questions.explanation: The passage describes obesity as a medical condition affecting health, and its treatments (diet, exercise) imply it can be avoided/prevented.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Obesity can be treated in the following ways except one:
questions.explanation: The passage mentions dieting, physical exercise, and drugs that reduce appetite or inhibit fat absorption — not increasing appetite.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Obesity can:
options: reduce the volume of a stomach
occur more in adults than in children
questions.explanation: The passage describes obesity as a 'leading preventable cause of death worldwide', meaning it can be prevented.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...various...' in paragraph 2, line 1 means:
questions.explanation: 'Various diseases' means different kinds of diseases.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...absorb...' in paragraph 3, line 4 means:
questions.explanation: 'Absorb' means to take in (nutrients), as in 'ability to absorb nutrients from food'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...their...' in paragraph 2, line 6 refers to:
questions.explanation: '...obese people have a greater energy expenditure than their thin counterparts...' — 'their' refers to obese people.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...this...' in paragraph 3, line 2 refers to:
questions.explanation: 'To supplement this, anti-obesity drugs may be taken...' — 'this' refers to the obesity treatment (dieting and physical exercise) mentioned just before.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: If I have enough time, I ___ a film.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, ...will + base verb.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: ___ of these questions is difficult for you?
questions.explanation: 'Which' is used to ask about a choice among a specific, limited set (these questions).

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Usually breakfast ___ at 7:30 in the morning.
questions.explanation: Present simple passive, singular subject 'breakfast': 'is served'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: I think she works in one of the two offices, ___ in Health office ___ in Education office.
questions.explanation: 'Either...or' expresses one of two possibilities, matching 'one of the two offices'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: We were very tired ___ we continued playing the game.
questions.explanation: The contrast between being tired and continuing to play requires 'but'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: ___ I got good mark in my English exam.
questions.explanation: Got is past tense, so the sentence needs a past time expression: 'Last semester'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Have you ___ seen a wild animal?
questions.explanation: Present perfect questions use 'ever': 'Have you ever seen...?'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Keep children away from ___ things like fire.
questions.explanation: Fire is a dangerous thing, so children should be kept away from dangerous things.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Check if all the windows are closed before you ___.
questions.explanation: After 'before you', the base/present form is used: 'leave office'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The thieves are hiding in the park; the guard is watching ___.
questions.explanation: 'Them' is the correct object pronoun form for 'the thieves'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Last night I was very tired, so I ___ to bed early.
questions.explanation: Past tense narrative requires the past form: 'went'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Students ___ to respect school rules.
questions.explanation: 'Ought' is followed by 'to + verb' ('ought to respect'), matching the sentence structure with 'to respect' already given.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: When I went to the library, my sister stayed ___ home.
questions.explanation: 'Stay at home' is the standard collocation.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Kebede wrote a comment after he ___ the message.
questions.explanation: Past perfect ('had read') is used for an action completed before another past action ('wrote').

questions.subject: english
questions.q: When you are taking medicine, you ___ follow the doctor's advice strictly.
questions.explanation: 'Have to' expresses obligation, fitting the need to strictly follow advice.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The teacher was checking homework ___ late coming students knocked at the door.
questions.explanation: 'When' introduces the interrupting action while the past continuous action ('was checking') was in progress.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: It was a 30 minutes work, but it took me ___ hour to finish.
questions.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a vowel sound, so the article 'an' is used.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The new building is the same height as the old building. This means: The new building is ___ the old building.
questions.explanation: 'Same height as' is restated using the equal comparison 'as tall as'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Hankamo: Did you submit the assignment? Aberash: No. I ___ submit it this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 'Am going to' is the correct future-intention structure with the subject 'I'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Ladawe: ___ can I get to the bus station? Ketema: Please take the city bus at the crossroads.
questions.explanation: 'How can I get to...?' is the standard way to ask about the means/route, matching the answer about taking the bus.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Kassa: I am very interested in sports. Martha: Me too, ___.
options: I don't like playing football & tennis.
I am not interested in sports.
questions.explanation: 'Me too' signals agreement, so the follow-up should express a shared positive interest in sports.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Deraro: Goodbye. See you tomorrow. Hiwot: ___.
questions.explanation: A farewell is naturally answered with a matching farewell: 'Goodbye. See you, too.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Saron: I am still continuously coughing. What should I do? Argaw: You ___ go out at night. It's extremely cold.
questions.explanation: Advising against an action when someone is sick uses 'had better not'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Azeb: ___ the test, Sara? Sara: It was fine but few questions were difficult.
questions.explanation: 'The test' is singular and the reply is in past tense ('was fine'), so 'How was the test?' is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Director: What should we do about the stolen books? Teacher: ___ we have to report to the police immediately.
questions.explanation: 'In my opinion' introduces a suggestion/opinion, fitting the teacher's response about reporting to the police.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Student: ___. I couldn't understand it. Teacher: Ok. I said: How do we form the past participle of regular verbs?
options: Would you mind repeating the question?
What kind of question is it?
I said don't repeat the question.
questions.explanation: The student is politely asking the teacher to repeat the question, which prompts the teacher to restate it.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Shuramo: Let's go home. The teacher is not coming. Mohammed: ___. We have to wait until the bell rings.
questions.explanation: Mohammed's reply insists on waiting, which contradicts Shuramo's suggestion, so it expresses disagreement: 'I don't agree'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Abeba: ___ I help you to finish the job? Solomon: Thanks, I will finish it myself.
questions.explanation: 'How can I help you...?' is an offer of help, matching Solomon's polite refusal.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Sultan: I am pleased to meet you. Senait: ___.
options: I am not pleased to meet you.
I am pleased to meet you, too.
questions.explanation: A polite greeting is reciprocated: 'I am pleased to meet you, too.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Argaw: Which subject do you like most? Barasa: ___ English.
questions.explanation: Answering 'which subject do you like most' naturally continues with 'My favorite subject is English.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Desta: ___ Fitsum: Yes, you may.
options: Can I use your pen once, please?
I don't want to use your pen, please.
May I use your pen once, please?
Should I use your pen once, please?
questions.explanation: Fitsum's reply 'Yes, you may' directly answers a question using the modal 'may': 'May I use your pen once, please?'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Rearrange: take/to/are/they/test/going/Monday/on/a. The correct word order is:
options: On Monday they are going to test a take.
They are going to take a test on Monday.
On Monday to take a test they are going.
They are going on Monday a test to take.
questions.explanation: Correct order: subject 'They' + 'are going to take' + object 'a test' + time 'on Monday'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Rearrange: the/furniture/we/will/sell/the/tomorrow/market/in. The correct word order is:
options: We will sell the furniture in the market tomorrow.
We will in the market sell tomorrow the furniture.
The furniture we will sell in the market tomorrow.
Tomorrow in the market the furniture we will sell.
questions.explanation: Correct order: subject 'We' + verb 'will sell' + object 'the furniture' + place 'in the market' + time 'tomorrow'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: 1. I remember my childhood generally as being happy. 2. These fears have caused me some uncomfortable moments. 3. I also remember my frightening moments. 4. I can recall some of my happiest times. The correct order of the above jumbled sentences is:
questions.explanation: Logical order: general statement (1) → happiest times (4) → frightening moments (3) → fears causing discomfort (2).

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which sentence has the correct comma use?
options: My father visited Kenya and Nigeria, Ghana, Sudan.
My father visited Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Sudan.
My father visited Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana and Sudan.
My father visited Kenya, and Nigeria, and Ghana, and Sudan.
questions.explanation: In a list of items, commas separate all items except the last two, which are joined by 'and': 'Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana and Sudan.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which sentence is correctly punctuated?
questions.explanation: A simple declarative statement ends with a period: 'She works in the bank.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is written with the correct capitalization?
options: All the students are taking english and amharic exams.
all the students are taking English and Amharic exams.
All the students are taking English and Amharic exams.
all the students are taking english and amharic exams.
questions.explanation: Sentences start with a capital letter, and language names (English, Amharic) are proper nouns and must be capitalized.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the word with the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'festival'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the word with the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'comfortable'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correctly joined? 'I was listening to music. My friend was watching TV.'
options: I was listening to music since my friend was watching TV.
I was listening to music while my friend was watching TV.
I was listening to music or my friend was watching TV.
I was listening to music because my friend was watching TV.
questions.explanation: Two actions happening at the same time are joined with 'while'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correctly joined? 'The director is attending the meeting. The manager is attending the meeting.'
options: Either the director or the manager is attending the meeting.
Both the director and the manager is attending the meeting.
Both the director and the manager are attending the meeting.
Either the director or the manager are attending the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'Both...and' takes a plural verb: 'Both the director and the manager are attending the meeting.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Of the following, one is a positive aspect of using mobile phones. (Reading passage "Mobile Phones": Mobile phones have become an essential part of our daily lives, from communication and entertainment to accessing information. Modern smart phones have revolutionized the way we interact with the world. However, while the benefits of mobile phones are undeniable, their excessive use can also have negative impacts on individuals and society. One of the positive aspects of mobile phones is their ability to connect people across long distances, whether it's a quick text message to a friend or a video call with a family member on the other side of the world. Mobile phones have made communication more accessible and rapid. Furthermore, mobile phones provide a wide range of applications and resources, allowing users to access news, educational materials, and productivity tools with just a few taps on the screen. Despite their many benefits, the overuse of mobile phones can lead to negative consequences. Excessive screen time can strain users' eyes and cause physical discomfort. Constant notifications and social media updates can contribute to increased stress and anxiety. In addition, the distraction of mobile phones has been linked to accidents and decreased productivity, especially in academic and professional settings.)
questions.explanation: The passage states mobile phones connect people across long distances, e.g. text messages or video calls.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which one of the following is mentioned as a potential negative impact of excessive mobile phone use?
options: Decreased stress & anxiety from excessive mobile use
A strain on users' eyes from excessive screen time
The possibility of making video calls using mobile phones
questions.explanation: The passage says 'Excessive screen time can strain users' eyes and cause physical discomfort.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What did the writer intend to tell the users of mobile phones?
options: Appreciating people who regularly use mobile phones
Advising people to use mobile phones wisely
Raising awareness to keep mobile phones from theft
Describing only the advantages of mobile phones
questions.explanation: The passage balances benefits and negative impacts of overuse, implying the writer wants readers to use mobile phones wisely.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...we...' in paragraph 1, line 3 refers to:
options: video calls made by mobile phones
questions.explanation: '...revolutionized the way we interact with the world' — 'we' refers to people/users interacting with the world through mobile phones.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...their...' in paragraph 3, line 1 refers to:
questions.explanation: 'Despite their many benefits, the overuse of mobile phones...' — 'their' refers back to mobile phones.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...excessive...' in paragraph 1, line 4 means:
questions.explanation: 'Excessive' means beyond what is normal or necessary — i.e. extreme.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: If I had known his phone number, I would have called him. This means:
options: I know his phone number, but I didn't call him.
I don't know his phone number, but I called him.
Even if I know his phone number, I don't want to call him.
I didn't know his phone number, so I didn't call him.
questions.explanation: Third conditional (unreal past): the speaker did not know the number, so the call did not happen.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Dawit is not as clever as Amen. This means:
options: Both Dawit and Amen are clever.
Amen is not as clever as Dawit.
questions.explanation: 'Not as...as' means the first person is less than the second — so Amen is cleverer than Dawit.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The number of late coming students in the school is reduced because of the harsh measurements taken by the new director.
questions.explanation: 'Harsh' means severe or tough, matching strict disciplinary measures.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Doing a physical exercise regularly has many benefits for health.
questions.explanation: 'Benefits' means advantages.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The government has applied traffic laws to minimize the increasing number of car accidents on roads.
questions.explanation: 'Laws' in this context is closest in meaning to 'regulations'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: This year, in the country wheat farming yields a surplus amount.
questions.explanation: 'Yields' (produces a crop) is closest in meaning to 'harvests'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The ruler of the country has introduced a new economic policy.
questions.explanation: 'Ruler' (a person who leads/governs a country) is closest in meaning to 'governor'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: I like playing basketball very much. It's my ___ sport.
questions.explanation: Loving a sport 'very much' matches calling it your 'favorite' sport.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The museum manager ___ the traditional goods on the table for the visitors.
questions.explanation: Goods put on a table for visitors to see are 'displayed'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The Ministry of Health is working hard to ___ mosquito from low land areas.
questions.explanation: A health ministry works to remove/get rid of (eliminate) mosquitoes, not collect or expand them.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The school director ___ the broken desks with the new ones.
questions.explanation: Swapping broken desks 'with the new ones' means they were 'replaced', not repaired/fixed/mended.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The ___ of natural resources helps to keep our environment safe.
questions.explanation: 'Conservation' (protecting/preserving) of natural resources keeps the environment safe.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Which one is not among Galileo's experiment for invention? (Reading passage "Galileo Galilei": Galileo Galilei was born in the year 1564 in the town of Pisa, Italy. When he was 20 years old, he was studying in Pisa. His father wanted him to be a doctor, but Galileo was bored with school except for math. Because math was the one subject where he was doing well, the mathematician offered to tutor him privately so Galileo could become a qualified mathematician. Galileo's father was disappointed, but he agreed. Because he needed to earn money, Galileo began experimenting with different things, trying to come up with some sort of invention that he could sell for money. He had a little bit of success with his invention that was like a compass that could be used to measure plots of land. He had already experimented with pendulums, thermometers, and magnets. When he heard that a Dutch inventor had invented something called a spyglass, Galileo decided to work on one of his own. Within 24 hours, while keeping it a secret, Galileo had invented a telescope that could magnify things to make them appear ten times larger than actual size. One night, he pointed his telescope toward the sky, and made his first of many space observations: the moon was not smooth, like everyone thought. As technology has improved, first Galileo, and then many others, have made improvements on the telescope, the wonderful device that allows us to see things from a distance. (Note: this passage was reconstructed from a partially worn exam photo; a few connecting words may not exactly match the original print.))
questions.explanation: The passage says Galileo had experimented with pendulums, thermometers, and magnets — the spyglass was the Dutch inventor's invention, not Galileo's own experiment.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What did Galileo do to earn money? He started:
questions.explanation: 'Because he needed to earn money, Galileo began experimenting with different things...'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: What was the compass like invention could be used for? For:
questions.explanation: The passage says his compass-like invention 'could be used to measure plots of land.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...magnify...' in paragraph 3, line 3 means:
questions.explanation: 'Magnify' means to make something appear larger — i.e. enlarge.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...he...' in paragraph 1, line 6 refers to:
questions.explanation: 'Galileo's father was disappointed, but he agreed.' — 'he' refers to Galileo's father.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: '...it...' in paragraph 3, line 2 refers to:
questions.explanation: '...while keeping it a secret...' refers to the spyglass the Dutch inventor had made.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Why did the Dutch inventor want to keep his invention secret? Because:
options: he didn't want other people to know about his invention.
Galileo tried to steal his invention.
he wanted to sell it and earn money.
he wanted to invent a telescope before Galileo.
questions.explanation: Keeping a new invention secret typically protects the inventor's ability to profit from and sell it. (Flagged for teacher verification — the exact reasoning in the original passage was not fully legible in the photo.)

questions.subject: english
questions.q: At the end of every school year, trees ___ in our school by students.
questions.explanation: Habitual, general-truth passive with a present time expression ('at the end of every school year') takes present simple passive: 'are planted'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Travelling by plane is ___ than travelling by train.
questions.explanation: Comparisons with 'than' use the comparative form: 'more expensive'. (Flagged for teacher verification — the exact set of 4 options was partly unclear in the photo.)

questions.subject: english
questions.q: To answer the questions correctly, you ___ read the instructions carefully.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs (must/should) are followed directly by the base verb, with no 'to'. (Flagged for teacher verification — 'must' could also fit; the exact intended answer in the key was not confirmed.)

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Aster: What were you doing in the garden this morning? Blen: I ___ some mango fruits.
questions.explanation: The question 'What were you doing' (past continuous) is answered with past continuous: 'was collecting'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: He has ___ me the book. I will return it tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Present perfect ('has given') is formed with has/have + past participle.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The film ___ I watched last night was very interesting.
questions.explanation: 'Which' is used for things (a film), not people, places, or as a standalone question word.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The teacher ___ taking attendance while the students were copying note.
questions.explanation: 'While' introduces a background past continuous action ('were copying'); the interrupting/starting action is past simple: 'started'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: I usually walk on foot to school, but ___ I take a taxi when I get money.
questions.explanation: Having money for a taxi is an occasional exception to usually walking, matching 'sometimes'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Azeb has a headache. If she took a pain killer, she ___ better soon.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: If + past simple, ... would + base verb: 'would get'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Last night, there was a ___ rain that damaged some houses.
questions.explanation: An adjective, not an adverb, is needed to describe the noun 'rain': 'heavy'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Yesterday, many students ___ absent from school because of the extreme heat.
questions.explanation: Past time ('yesterday') with a plural subject ('many students') takes 'were'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Teacher: Did you all check the correct answer? Students: ___
questions.explanation: A question in past simple ('Did you...') is answered with 'did'/'didn't': 'Yes, we did.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Abera and Kiflu are friends, but they frequently ___ agree on many issues.
questions.explanation: The prefix 'dis-' forms 'disagree', matching friends who don't always see eye to eye.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: You ___ bring your textbooks when you come to school. Otherwise you will not be allowed to get into class.
questions.explanation: 'You' as subject takes 'have to' (not 'has to'); 'must to' and 'shall to' are not grammatical.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: His idea was unaccept___ because it was different from the agenda.
questions.explanation: The suffix '-able' forms the adjective 'unacceptable'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: My mother ___ watches TV. She is very busy all the day.
questions.explanation: Being 'very busy all the day' means she rarely watches TV, matching 'hardly'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: My friend is naturally talented. He ___ easily play different musical instruments.
questions.explanation: Natural talent/ability is expressed with the modal 'can'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Mekdes speaks fluent English, ___ her writing is poor.
questions.explanation: 'Whereas' introduces a contrast between good speaking and poor writing.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Teacher: Tell me the difference between a triangle and a rectangle. Student: One difference is that they have different number of sides. ___ is they have different number of angles.
questions.explanation: The student is listing a second difference, so 'Another difference' fits.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: You: I think most of the traffic accidents in our country are caused by careless walkers. Police: ___ careless drivers are main reasons for the accidents.
options: I totally agree with your idea
questions.explanation: The police officer partly disagrees, redirecting blame toward careless drivers, matching 'That is partly true, but'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Teacher: Can you tell me one thing drivers shouldn't do while driving? Student: They ___ talk using their mobiles.
questions.explanation: A prohibition ('shouldn't do') is best expressed with 'must not'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Sara: Will there be a test next week? Azeb: ___ Why don't you ask the monitor if he has any information?
questions.explanation: Azeb doesn't know the answer, so she deflects the question to the monitor: 'I'm not sure about that.'

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Debebe: I would like to buy a bicycle as I want to go to school riding. Tashite: ___
options: When are you going to buy a bicycle?
How much are you going to pay for the bicycle?
Where are you going to buy the bicycle from?
What would you like to buy if you won a lottery?
questions.explanation: A natural follow-up question to a stated plan is asking when it will happen. (Flagged for teacher verification — the photographed answer mark for this item was unclear.)

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Habib: I am planning to spend the vacation with my grandparents. Kebede: ___ are you going to do when school is closed?
questions.explanation: Kebede is asking about the activity/plan itself, matching 'What are you going to do'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Girum: They came to visit the new library. Lantu: ___ did the guests come to our school?
questions.explanation: 'They came to visit the new library' states a purpose, matching the question word 'Why'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: For question 55, rearrange the sentences into a meaningful paragraph: A. Cotton is one of the most popular natural fibers in the world. B. For example, it is used to make clothes, bed sheets and home textiles. C. It is also a good choice for a wide range of uses. D. It is known for its softness and durability. The correct order is:
questions.explanation: Logical order: introduce cotton (A) → its known quality (D) → that quality makes it a good choice (C) → example of its uses (B).

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence that is correctly punctuated.
options: Helen got the highest mark in English,
Helen got the highest mark in English?
Helen got the highest mark in English
Helen got the highest mark in English.
questions.explanation: A simple statement ends with a period.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence that is correctly punctuated.
options: My sister gave me some sugar, flour, onions and potatoes.
My sister gave me some sugar, flour, onions and, potatoes.
My sister gave me some, sugar, flour, onions and potatoes.
My sister gave me some sugar flour, onions, and, potatoes.
questions.explanation: Items in a list are separated by commas, with 'and' before the last item and no extra commas.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence that is correctly punctuated.
options: Kassa was born on Tuesday, june 22/2003.
kassa was born on tuesday, June 22/2003.
Kassa was born on Tuesday, June 22/2003.
Kassa was born on tuesday, June 22/2003.
questions.explanation: Proper nouns (Kassa, Tuesday, June) must be capitalized, and the sentence must start with a capital letter.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the word that has the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'country'.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the word that has the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'hygiene'.

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Bunjuge budu uddano uddidhe waa ta'ino. Xuruurroonni handaariti eote fiche ___ yitannote.

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Kaaliiqira galatu ikkosina techo dikkote gidu kaxxine shalanganniho. Xuruurroonni handaariti eote fiche maati?

questions.subject: sidaamu

questions.subject: sidaamu

questions.q: Hanqallonna Garje jaalla ikkitino daafira mimmitu maafuda reqecci diassitanno. Xuruurroonni qaali fiche ___ yitannote.

questions.q: Mitte dagara addi addi handaarira afaaleeyye heedhasera hasiissanno. Xuruurroonni qaaliti addaarro fiche ___ yitannote.

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: 'Boociro jirtete guutaho,' yitanno coyfooliishsho giddo xuruurroonni qaaliti addaarro fiche ikkara dandaannohu hiikkonneeti?

questions.q: Aliidi niwaawera umo ikkara dandaannohu hiikkonneeti?
questions.passage: Biddissa II passage "Umikki Niwaawe": Cirata Sidaamu dagara ha'nura bude ikkite, kokkete mereero 'ihi! ihi!' yitanno coyfooliishsho giddo huuronni kalaqantannote. Ciratto seekke hegersate: ay, mamoote, mayramma mama ciratanno? yitanno xa'muwa dawarama hasiissanno. Qaete anni qaesi higasi egensiisate nafara iille ciratanno. Lame hige cirate, "Keere hossinoonni? questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Niwaawete layinki gufo garinni minaanni ikkinota nafara uurre ciratanni taxxi yaannohu mayraati?

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Niwaawete sayikki gufoti gara hedo maati?

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Niwaawete sayikki gufo garinni "Mannu mineenmi no," yitanno hedo hiikkonneeti?

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Niwaawete garinmi qaesi higasi egensiisate ciratannohu ayeti?

questions.subject: sidaamu
questions.q: Niwaawete garinni cirata lainohunni adda ikkinohu hiikkonneeti?
options: Moychu woy mannu doogote hee'riro aguramokki gede cirantammi

questions.subject: sidaamu

Aanteteno, Hindenna Chaynu hoodissinonsa gede dhagge faajje assitanno. Qoleno, AKG 1916 Ameeriku gobbara paarkubba mannu kisannokki gede qorombe uurrisa hananfoonni. Aanteteno, manchu beetti kalaqamu qarqari aana iillishannoti hi'naancho hekko lexxitanni dagguta, AKG 1960te kalqete deerrinni baca mootimmubba qarqara agarate kaa'litanno seerubba qixxeesi'ra hanaffino. Tenne ledo xaadinohunnino, AKG 1970 Ameeriku Mootimma Qarqaru Agarooshshi Ejense uurrissino. Hoodisseno, Kileb of Romi yinanni uurrinsha bikkimale dagate kiiro lexxonna qarqaru daafamme yaachishshanni noota AKG 1972 Ze Limitis of Girowuz yitanno rippoortensanni qorophisiissino. Qarqaru agarooshshi xaa yannarano kalqete deerrinni hasaawu sirnya ikke leellanno. Qarqaru agarooshshi sase wodhiworo afi'rino. Umiti, qarqara gawajjara dandaanno yine huluullammanniri daafira balanxe mashalaqqe aatenni qorophisiissannote. Layinkitino, qarqaru daafammera kora ikkitanno bissa, iillitanno gawajjora, baatate yawo noonsata odeessitannote. Sayikki wodhiworono qarqara gawajjara dandaannorenna qaafo adhate loonsanni hee'noonnire afate qoosso dagoomaho noosita xawissannote.
