questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The solution set of the inequality 3(3x+10) + 4x > 5x + 3(3x-4) is:
questions.explanation: Expanding: 13x + 30 > 14x - 12, so 42 > x, i.e. x < 42.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The solution set of the inequality (3x-6)/2 + (5-2x)/3 ≤ -13/6 is:
questions.explanation: Multiplying every term by 6: 3(3x-6) + 2(5-2x) ≤ -13 → 5x - 8 ≤ -13 → 5x ≤ -5 → x ≤ -1.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: In a classroom containing 72 students, the number of girls is twice the number of boys. What is the number of girls?
questions.explanation: Let boys = b, girls = 2b. Then b + 2b = 72, so 3b = 72, b = 24, and girls = 2×24 = 48.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: Which one of the following pairs of figures are similar to each other?
options: A pair of small tick-marked rectangles of different sizes
A pair of rectangles of clearly different proportions, alongside a diamond
A triangle paired with a square
A set of triangles of differing sizes
questions.explanation: Answer not fully verified — this question depends on comparing the proportions of shapes drawn in the photographed figure, which weren't fully legible. Please confirm with a teacher which pair has proportional corresponding sides (the hallmark of similar figures).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: In the figures given below, AB = 3cm, BC = 2cm, and DE = 1.5cm. If ΔABC ~ ΔDEF, then what is the length of EF?
questions.explanation: The scale factor from ΔABC to ΔDEF is DE/AB = 1.5/3 = 1/2, so EF = BC × 1/2 = 2 × 1/2 = 1cm.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: If the ratio of corresponding areas of two similar triangles is 169/144, what is the ratio of their perimeters?
questions.explanation: The ratio of perimeters (like any linear measurement) is the square root of the ratio of areas: √(169/144) = 13/12.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: If the ratio of corresponding sides of two similar triangles is √11/√7, then what is the ratio of their areas?
questions.explanation: The ratio of areas is the square of the ratio of corresponding sides: (√11/√7)² = 11/7.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: Consider the triangle given below, with angles (4x)° at B, (3x-4)° at A, and (2x+4)° at C. What is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle sum to 180°: 4x + (3x-4) + (2x+4) = 180 → 9x = 180 → x = 20.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: Consider the given figure below, where BC is extended to D, with interior angles x at B and y at A, and w marking the exterior angle at C. Which one of the following relations is TRUE?
questions.explanation: By the exterior angle theorem, an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two remote (non-adjacent) interior angles: x + y = w.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: Let the figure given below be a right angled triangle at C. Which one of the following is TRUE about ΔABC?
questions.explanation: Since the right angle is at C, the hypotenuse is the side opposite it, AB — so by the Pythagorean theorem, (AC)² + (BC)² = (AB)².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 4 — Similar Figures & the Pythagorean Theorem
questions.q: Consider the following right angled triangle. If AC = 10cm and AB = 6cm, then what is the length of BC?
questions.explanation: With the right angle at B, AC is the hypotenuse: AC² = AB² + BC² → 100 = 36 + BC² → BC² = 64 → BC = 8cm (a 6-8-10 right triangle).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In the figure below, O is the center of the circle. If m(∠BAO) = 63°, then what is the measure of (∠ACB)?
questions.explanation: Since OA = OB (radii), triangle OAB is isosceles, so ∠ABO = ∠BAO = 63°, making the central angle ∠AOB = 180° - 63° - 63° = 54°. The inscribed angle ∠ACB, subtending the same arc AB, is half the central angle: 54°/2 = 27°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A farmer wants to fence a circular region of diameter 42 meters. If the cost of the fencing material is 100 Birr per meter, then what is the total birr that is needed to fence the whole region? (use π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Circumference = π × d = 22/7 × 42 = 132 meters. Total cost = 132 × 100 = 13,200 Birr.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Solid Figures: Surface Area & Volume
questions.q: A triangular pyramid is given below. Which one of the following is NOT TRUE about the pyramid? It has three
questions.explanation: A triangular pyramid (tetrahedron) has only ONE base (plus 3 lateral faces and 3 lateral edges) — so "three bases" is the false statement.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Solid Figures: Surface Area & Volume
questions.q: Look at the following right rectangular prism given below, with edges √2cm, 2√2cm, and 3√2cm. What is the total surface area of the prism?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Solid Figures: Surface Area & Volume
questions.q: Consider the following right circular cylinder given below, with radius r = 3cm and height h = 7cm. What is the total surface area of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: Total surface area = 2πr(r+h) = 2π(3)(3+7) = 2π(3)(10) = 60π cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Solid Figures: Surface Area & Volume
questions.q: Consider the following right circular cylinder given below, with radius r = 6cm and height h = 8cm. What is the volume of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: Volume = πr²h = π(6²)(8) = π(36)(8) = 288π cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Solid Figures: Surface Area & Volume
questions.q: A manufacturer has designed to produce a spherical plastic balloon of radius 2cm. How much plastic material is needed?
questions.explanation: The plastic material needed equals the sphere's surface area: 4πr² = 4π(2²) = 16π cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If two fair coins are thrown at the same time, then what is the probability of getting at least one tail?
questions.explanation: P(at least one tail) = 1 - P(no tails) = 1 - P(two heads) = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If two fair dice are thrown at the same time, then what is the probability that the sum of the numbers on the top of two dice is 12?
questions.explanation: The only way to get a sum of 12 is rolling (6,6), which is 1 outcome out of 36 possible outcomes: 1/36.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A bag contains 4 red and 5 black balls of the same size. If a ball is drawn from the bag at random, what is the probability of getting a red ball?
questions.explanation: There are 4 red balls out of 9 total balls (4 red + 5 black), so P(red) = 4/9.

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «የእሳቱ ___ ዳር ያሉትን ሰዎች ሁሉ ገፈፉት፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር በባዶ ቦታው ላይ የሚገባው ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ወላፈን» የእሳት ነበልባል ወደ አካባቢው የሚደርስ ሙቀት/ብርሃን ውጤት ስለሆነ ለዓረፍተ ነገሩ ይስማማል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «የሰራነው ስራ ጥሩ ስለነበር ነፍሳችን ___ አደረገች፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር በባዶ ቦታው ላይ የሚገባው ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ሀሴት» ደስታን/እልልታን የሚገልጽ ቃል በመሆኑ ጥሩ ስራ ከመስራት ጋር ይስማማል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «መምህርና ተማሪዎቹ ገጽ ለገጽ ተገናኝተው ተወያዩ፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍቺው ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: «ገጽ ለገጽ» ማለት ፊት ለፊት በመገናኘት መወያየትን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ለጠላ ጉሽ ካልን ለጠጅ ምን እንላለን?
questions.explanation: ጠጅ ውስጥ የሚገኘው ደለል/ትራፊ ክፍል «አንቡላ» ይባላል፣ ጠላ ላይ ደግሞ ተመሳሳዩ «ጉሽ» ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የቃላት ስውር ወይም ድብቅ ፍቺ ምን በመባል ይታወቃል?
questions.explanation: ስውር/ድብቅ ወይም ተዘዋዋሪ ፍቺ «ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺ» ተብሎ ይጠራል፤ ይህም ከቀጥተኛው እማራዊ ፍቺ ይለያል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ኢያንቱ ለክፉም ሆነ ለጠጉ ነገር መራት ናት፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺው ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: «መራት» የሚለው ቃል በዚህ ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ለማንኛውም ሁኔታ የመቻቻል/የመቻል ባህርይን ስለሚያመለክት ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺው «ቻይ» ይሆናል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ቆቅ» ለሚለው ቃል እማራዊ ፍቺ ሊሆን የሚችለው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: «ቆቅ» በቀጥተኛ (እማራዊ) ፍቺው የወፍ ዝርያ ስም ሲሆን፣ «ብልጣ ብልጥ» የሚለው ፍካሬያዊ (ዘይቤያዊ) ፍቺው ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ደራርቱ ንብ ናት፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: ንብ በትጋቷ የምትታወቅ በመሆኗ «ንብ ናት» መባል «ታታሪ ናት» ለማለት ያገለግላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «የአማርኛ መምህራችንን ዕፀያ» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የተሰመረበት ቃል ተቃራኒ ፍቺ ___ ነው።
questions.explanation: «ዕፀያ» መልካም/ደግ ማለት ስለሆነ ተቃራኒው «መጥፎ» ይሆናል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ሆቡዕ» ለሚለው ቃል ተቃራኒ ፍቺ የሚሆነው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: «ሆቡዕ» ማለት ግልጽ ያልሆነ/የተደበቀ ማለት ሲሆን ተቃራኒው «ግልፅ» ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሱት ድርብ ቃል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ቤተ መዘክር» ሁለት ቃላት ተዋህደው አዲስ ትርጉም የሚሰጡ ድርብ ቃል ናቸው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ግብዓት መራቱ በስንስት ስዓት ተፈፀመ፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል ፍቺ የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: «ግብዓተ መሬት» የቀብር ስነስርዓትን የሚያመለክት ሐረግ ስለሆነ ፍቺው «ቀብሩ» ይሆናል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ህይወት ያለው በድን አይቹ መጣሁ፡፡» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የሚታየው ዘይቤ ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: ህይወት ያለው ነገር «በድን» ተብሎ በተቃርኖ መገለጹ «አያም» የተሰኘውን የተቃርኖ ዘይቤ ያሳያል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ፀንፉ የሆር ንዑ ይመስላል፡፡» የሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የያዘው ዘይቤ የዛው ___ ነው።
questions.explanation: አንዱን ነገር ከሌላው ጋር በ«ይመስላል» በማነጻጸር የቀረበ ስለሆነ «አነጻጻሪ» ዘይቤ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ነገሮችን፣ እሳቤዎችን፣ ድርጊቶችን፣ ሁነቶችን፣ ወዘተ. በማነጻጸር፣ በማጋነን፣ በአካላዊ ባህርይ በማላበስ፣ ወዘተ. የሚያቀርብ የቃላት አጠቃቀም ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ንጽጽር፣ ግነት እና ሰውኛን የመሳሰሉ ዘዴዎችን ተጠቅሞ ሀሳብን ማቅረብ «ዘይቤያዊ አጠቃቀም» ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀፅ አንድ፣ መሰረት ስዎችን ከዘዙ እኩይ ነገሮች የሚታደገው ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: አንቀጹ እንደሚያስረዳው ሰውን ከክፉ ተግባር የሚታደገው ውስጣዊው ሰብዓዊ ማንነቱ/ህሊናው ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀፅ አንድ፣ መስመር ስድስት «መንከስና መጠላፍ» የሚለው አገላለጽ ምን ያመለክታል?
questions.explanation: «መንከስና መጠላለፍ» እርስ በርስ የመጋደል/የመጣላት ሁኔታን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀፅ አንድ፣ መስመር ድስት «የግድ ነው» የተባለው ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: አንቀጹ ሰዎች በሰላምና በፍቅር ተከባብረው መኖራቸው የግድ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ያስረዳል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በምንባቡ መሰረት የሰው ልጅ ማንነት በስንት ይከፈላል?
questions.explanation: ምንባቡ የሰው ልጅን ውስጣዊ ማንነት በሶስት ደረጃ ይከፍላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀፅ ሁለት የግብረገብ ዓላማ ሆኖ የተገለፀው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አንቀጹ የግብረገብ ዓላማን ልዩነትን እያከበሩ አንድነትን መገንባት ላይ ያተኩራል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀፅ ሁለት ‹‹የቀጭጨዋል›› የሚለው ቃል ፍቺ ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: «ቀጭጫል» ማለት ማነስ/መድረቅ/መጥፋትን ስለሚያመለክት ተቀራራቢ ፍቺው «ያጠፋል» ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: እንደፀሀፊው እምነት፣ የሰው ልጅ ውስጣዊ ማንነት መገለጫ ዘዴ የቱ ነው?
options: የሰውን ልጅ ውስጣዊ ማንነት ማቅ አስቸጋሪ መሆኑን
የሰው ልጅ ያለማህበራዊ ትስስር ጉድሎ መሆኑን
questions.explanation: ፀሀፊው የሰው ልጅ ውስጣዊ ማንነት ውስብስብና ለመረዳት አስቸጋሪ መሆኑን ያስረዳል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከምንባቡ መሰረት የሰው ልጅን ማህበራዊ ማንነት የሚገልፀው የቱ ነው?
options: የሰው ልጅን ውስጣዊ ማንነት ማወቅ አስቸጋሪ መሆኑን
ለሰው ልጅ አብሮነትና ስለም ተፈላጊ መሆናቸውን
የሰው ልጅ ያለማህበራዊ ትስስር ግድሎ መሆኑን
questions.explanation: ሰው ማህበራዊ ፍጡር ስለሆነ ያለ ማህበራዊ ትስስር ህይወቱ ጉድለት ያለበት እንደሚሆን ምንባቡ ያስረዳል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንቀፅ ‹‹የቀጭጨዋል›› የሚለው ቃል የተጠቀሰበት ዓረፍተ ነገር ትርጉም ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: ቃሉ ስሜት ወይም ማንነት እየመነመነ/እየደረቀ መሄድን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ትልቁ ጥያቄ ያንድን ሰው ማንነት እናውቃለን ካልን ከሁሉቱ የቱን ነው?
options: በሁስቱ መከካል መጣጣም ሲኖርም ላይኖርም ይችላል
በተጨማሪም በጥሩ ስነምግባርና አስተሳሰብ ሊታነፁ ይገባል
ነገር ግን ተገላጭ ነገር ስለሚያስረዳ ጥቂት ከአንቀጽ ይለያል
questions.explanation: ምንባቡ የግለሰብ ውስጣዊና ማህበራዊ ማንነት መካከል ስምምነት ሊኖርም ላይኖርም እንደሚችል ያብራራል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሁለትና ሶስት በላይ የሆኑ ተያያዥ ሀሳቦችን የያዙ ተከታታይ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች የሚያደራጅ የፅሁፍ ክፍል ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ተያያዥ ዓረፍተ ነገሮችን በአንድ ሀሳብ ዙሪያ የሚያደራጅ የጽሁፍ ክፍል «አንቀጽ» ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «አብዲሳ አጋ እባላለሁ፡፡ የተወለድኩት በ1911 ዓ.ም በወለጋ ጠቅላይ ግዛት ውስጥ በነጃ ኪዳነ ምህረት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ቀበሌ ነው። …» የሚለው ፅሁፍ የደርስት አይነት ምሳሌ ሊሆን ይችላል?
questions.explanation: ስለ አንድ ግለሰብ ህይወት ታሪክ በቅደም ተከተል የሚተርክ ፅሁፍ በመሆኑ «ተራኪ» ጽሁፍ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ቀጥሎ የቀረበው ፅሁፍ ለተጠየው የደርስት አይነት ምሳሌ ሊሆን ይችላል? (ስለ ግጭት መንስኤዎችና እልባት አሰጣጥ የሚያትት)
questions.explanation: ፅሁፉ የተለያዩ አመለካከቶችን በማነጻጸርና በመሞገት ስለሚያቀርብ «አከራካሪ» ጽሁፍ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሁስትና ከዚያ በላይ የተዘበራረቁ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች የተቀመጡት የተመቻቸ ንባብና ግንዛቤ ተከትሎ ተከታሳቸውን የያዘው አማራጭ የቱ ነው? (ህጻናትና ችግኞች ማነጻጸሪያ)
questions.explanation: ትክክለኛው ቅደም ተከተል በመጀመሪያ ንጽጽሩን በማስተዋወቅ (ህጻናትና ችግኞች መመሳሰላቸውን)፣ ቀጥሎ የችግኝ ፍላጎትን፣ ቀጥሎ የህጻናትንም ተመሳሳይ ፍላጎት፣ በመጨረሻም ተጨማሪ ሀሳብን በሚያክል መልኩ ይደራጃል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ተመሳሳይ የተዘበራረቁ ዓረፍተ ነገሮችን (ስለ አንቀጽና ድርሰት ትርጉም) በትክክለኛ ቅደም ተከተል የሚያስቀምጠው አማራጭ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ድርሰት መከፋፈሉን በመግለጽ (ሐ)፣ የአንቀጽን ትርጉም በመስጠት (ሀ)፣ ከዓረፍተ ነገር ጋር በማነጻጸር (ለ)፣ በመጨረሻም ልዩነቱን በመግለጽ (መ) መደራጀት ይኖርበታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: አንድን ነገር አሰራር ወይም ሂደት በቅደም ተከተል በማብራራት የሚያቀርብ ጽሁፍ ምን አይነት ጽሁፍ ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ሂደትን ወይም አሰራርን በምክንያትና በማስረጃ አስደግፎ የሚያብራራ ጽሁፍ «አስረጂ» ጽሁፍ ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ልጅቱ ትምህርት ቤት ስትሄድ በመንገድ ላይ ተኩላ አግኝቷት ደነገጠች፡፡» የመሰለ ታሪክ የሚተርክ ጽሁፍ ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ክስተትን በቅደም ተከተል የሚተርክ ታሪካዊ ጽሁፍ «ተራኪ» ጽሁፍ ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: ትምህርቱን በጣም ወድጄዋለሁ ___ ስለዚህ በርትቼ አጠናለሁ። በባዶ ቦታው የሚገባው ስርዓተ ነጥብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሁለት ተያያዥ ሀሳቦችን ለማገናኘት ተጨማሪ ማብራሪያ ከመስጠት አንፃር ድርብ ነጥብ (፤) መጠቀም ይመረጣል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: ትክክለኛውን የስርዓተ ነጥብ አጠቃቀም የተከተለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የቱ ነው? (ጥያቄ በጥቅስ ውስጥ)
options: ከንደኛህ ጋር ተያይዛችሁ ስትወጡ በሩን አልቆለፍካችሁም ነበር በማለት ጠየቀው?
ከንደኛህ ጋር ተያይዛችሁ ስትወጡ በሩን አልቆለፍካችሁም ነበር? በማለት ጠየቀው?
«ከንደኛህ ጋር ተያይዛችሁ ስትወጡ በሩን አልቆለፍካችሁም ነበር?» በማለት ጠየቀው።
«ከንደኛህ ጋር ተያይዛችሁ ስትወጡ በሩን አልቆለፍካችሁም ነበር?» በማለት ጠየቀው
questions.explanation: ቀጥተኛ ጥያቄ ጥቅስ ምልክት ውስጥ ተቀምጦ የጥያቄ ምልክቱ ከመዝጊያ ጥቅሱ በፊት፣ ዓረፍተ ነገሩ ደግሞ በመጨረሻ ነጥብ ሊዘጋ ይገባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: ትክክለኛውን የስርዓተ ነጥብ አጠቃቀም የተከተለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የቱ ነው? (ዝርዝር ግብዓቶች)
options: አንቱ ገበያ ሄጆ «ማጭድ፣ ማረሻ፣ አካፋና ዶማ» ገዝቶ መጣ።
አንቱ ገበያ ሄጆ ማጭድ፣ ማረሻ፣ አካፋና ዶማ ገዝቶ መጣ።
«አንቱ ገበያ ሄጆ ማጭድ፣ ማረሻ፣ አካፋና ዶማ ገዝቶ መጣ።»
አንቱ ገበያ ሄጆ ማጭድ፣ ማረሻ፣ አካፋና፣ ዶማ ገዝቶ መጣ።
questions.explanation: ተከታታይ ዝርዝር ግብዓቶች በነጠላ ሰረዝ ተለያይተው ጥቅስ ምልክት ሳያስፈልጋቸው በቀጥታ ሊጻፉ ይገባል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: አጭር ልቦለድን በሚመለከት የአላባውያኑን ምንነት ተምረናል፣ ___ መሸጋገሪያ ቃላትን ወይም ሀረጋትን እንማራለን፡፡ በባዶ ቦታው የሚገባው ትክክለኛ ቃል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሀሳቡ ከቀደመው ትምህርት ቀጣይ ርዕስ ላይ የሚያተኩር በመሆኑ «በመቀጠል» የሚለው ተያያዥ ቃል ይስማማል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: ‹‹ዘመናት›› በሚለው ቃል ላይ የተጨመረው የብዙ ቁጥር አመልካች ምዕላድ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ዘመን» ወደ «ዘመናት» ሲቀየር የተጨመረው የብዙ ቁጥር መገለጫ ምዕላድ «-አት/-ኦች» አይነት ቅጥያ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: ‹‹ልጅ ወደሆስፒታል ተወሰደ፡፡›› በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ሀረግ ___ ሀረግ ነው።
questions.explanation: «ወደሆስፒታል» የሚለው ሀረግ ግሱን «ተወሰደ» የሚያመላክተው ስፍራ ገላጭ በመሆኑ ተውሳከ ግሳዊ ሀረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Punctuation, Word Choice & Text Structure
questions.q: ‹‹ልጅቷ ውብ ናት፡፡›› በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ «ውብ» የሚለው ቃል የቃል ክፍል ነው?
questions.explanation: «ውብ» ስሙን «ልጅቷ»ን የሚገልጽ ቅጽል (adjective) ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በሠንጠረዡ መሰረት፣ የ9ኙ ተማሪዎች ቁጥር ከዓመት ዓመት እያሻቀበ (እየጨመረ) የመጣው በየትኛው ት/ቤት ነው?
questions.explanation: ጥሪት ት/ቤት ቁጥር ከ2012-2015 ዓ.ም. 700→740→800→880 እያለ በተከታታይ ጨምሯል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በሠንጠረዡ መሰረት፣ የተማሪዎች ቁጥር ከዓመት ዓመት እያነሰ (እየቀነሰ) የመጣው በየትኛው ት/ቤት ነው?
questions.explanation: ብርሃን ት/ቤት ቁጥር ከ2012-2015 ዓ.ም. 950→880→870→790 እያለ በተከታታይ ቀንሷል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በ2013 ዓ.ም. ብርሃን ት/ቤት የነበሩ ተማሪዎችን ቁጥር ያህል በ2015 ዓ.ም. የነበረው የትኛው ት/ቤት ነው?
questions.explanation: ብርሃን በ2013 ዓ.ም. 880 ተማሪ ነበረው፤ ጥሪት ት/ቤትም በ2015 ዓ.ም. 880 ተማሪ ደርሷል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከ2012 እስከ 2015 ዓ.ም. ድረስ ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ በጣም ትንሽ የተማሪዎች ቁጥር የተመዘገበው በየትኛው ዓመትና ት/ቤት ነው?
questions.explanation: በሠንጠረዡ ውስጥ ከተመዘገቡት ቁጥሮች ሁሉ ትንሹ 700 ሲሆን፣ ይህም የ2013 ዓ.ም. ጥሪት ት/ቤት ውጤት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ‹‹አፕር ልበልድን በሚመለከት የአላባውያኑን ምንነት ተምረናል፡፡›› በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ካሉት ቃላት የትኛው የስም ዘር ነው?
questions.explanation: «ምንነት» ከ«ምን» በሚል ጥያቄያዊ ስርወ ቃል ተመስርቶ የተፈጠረ ስም ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች በአሁን ጊዜ የተፃፈው የቱ ነው?
options: ከጥቂት ደቂቃዎች በኋላ ገ ንፃ ራ እንጀምራለን
ሩት የተሰጣትን ቤት ስራ አየሰራች ነው
questions.explanation: «እየሰራች ነው» የሚለው የግስ አገባብ በአሁን ጊዜ (አሁናዊ) ውስጥ የሚፈጸም ተግባርን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች በአሁን ጊዜ ያልተፃፈው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «በሚቀጥለው ዓመት ትመጣለች» የወደፊት ጊዜን የሚያመለክት ስለሆነ ከሌሎቹ በተለየ በአሁን ጊዜ አልተጻፈም።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ በተገቢ ስፍራ የተዋቀረ ዓረፍተ ነገር የቱ ነው?
options: ስምንተኛ ክፍል ተማሪዎችን የሚያስተምሩ መምህራኖች ብዛት አስር ናቸው
ስምንተኛ ክፍል ተማሪዎችን የሚያስተምር መምህር ብዛት አስር ነው
ስምንተኛ ክፍል ተማሪዎችን ያስተማሩ መምህራኖች ብዛት አስር ነው
ስምንተኛ ክፍል ተማሪዎችን የሚያስተምሩ መምህራን ብዛት አስር ነው
questions.explanation: የብዙ ቁጥር ስም «መምህራን» ከነጠላ ግስ «ነው» ጋር ትክክለኛ የቁጥር ስምምነት ይፈጥራል፤ ድርብ ብዙ ቁጥር («መምህራኖች») ስህተት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ‹‹ልጅ ደረሰብትን ቀዳ›› ከሚለው ተነስተን «ደረሰብትን» የሚለው ቃል የትኛው የቃል ክፍል ነው?
questions.explanation: «ደረሰብት» የቁስ ስም (ደብተር) ተውላጠ ስም ተጨምሮበት የቀረበ ስም ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ‹‹ኢትዮጵያውያን አትሌቶች በጣም ፈጣን ናቸው፡፡›› በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ሀረግ የተሰመረበት ሀረግ ___ ነው።
questions.explanation: «በጣም ፈጣን» የሚለው ሀረግ አትሌቶችን የሚገልጽ ቅጽል ስለያዘ ቅፅላዊ ሀረግ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ‹‹አበበ በፍጥነት ወደ ትምህርት ቤት ሮጠ፡፡›› በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ «በፍጥነት» የሚለው ቃል የቃል ክፍል ነው?
questions.explanation: «በፍጥነት» ግሱን «ሮጠ»ን የሚገልጽ ተውሳከ ግስ (adverb) ነው፤ የሩጫውን ሁኔታ ይገልጻል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች በተገብር ግስ የተዋቀረው የቱ ነው? (ስለ ተለያዩ ክስተቶች)
questions.explanation: «ሰርቶ ጨረሰ» ተገብር (ንቁ) ግስ ሲሆን ሌሎቹ ሶስቱ በተሳቢ (ግብረ ገብር) መልክ ‹ተ-› ተቀጥያ የያዙ ናቸው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ዓረፍተ ነገሮች በተገብር ግስ የተዋቀረው የቱ ነው? (ስለ ተማሪዎች ተግባር)
questions.explanation: «ለበሰ» ንቁ (ተገብር) ግስ ሲሆን ሌሎቹ በተሳቢ ወይም ንዑስ ግንባታ ስለቀረቡ ይለያሉ።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ውብልስብ (ግነታዊ) ዓረፍተ ነገር የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: ትምህርት ቤቷ ዛሬ ጠዋት ትንሽ ሆነች
questions.explanation: «ትምህርት ቤቷ ዛሬ ጠዋት ትንሽ ሆነች» የሚለው ከእውነታ ያለፈ ግነት (ማጋነን) ስለያዘ ግነታዊ ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ‹‹መስና በቀጥታ ___ በተዘዋዋሪ መልኩ ሊፈጸም ይችላል፡፡›› በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ባዶ ቦታ ላይ የሚገባው አያያዥ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሁለት አማራጭ ሁኔታዎችን (ቀጥታ ወይም ተዘዋዋሪ) ለማገናኘት «ወይም» የተባለው አያያዥ ተስማሚ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ጠያቂ (መጠይቃዊ) ዓረፍተ ነገር የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ቀለበቱን ማን ወሰደው?» የጥያቄ ምልክት የያዘና መልስ የሚፈልግ ስለሆነ ጠያቂ ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ነቀላ (አሉታዊ) ዓረፍተ ነገር የሆነው የቱ ነው?
options: አባቴ ከገበያ ትናንት ትልቅ በግ ገዛ
questions.explanation: ተግባርን በቅደም ተከተል ብቻ ከመግለጽ ውጪ ግልጽ የመካድ/አሉታዊ መልክ ባይኖረውም ከቀሪዎቹ አንፃር በአወቃቀሩ ልዩ ተደርጎ ተመርጧል፤ መምህር ማረጋገጥ ይመከራል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ‹‹ሴትዮዋ ___ ሸንቁር በርሜል ምስጢር መያዝ አትችልም?›› በባዶው ቦታ ላይ ገብቶ ሊያደርስ የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ንፅፅርን ለማመላከት «እንደ» የሚለው መስተዋድድ ተስማሚ ነው (እንደ ሸንቁር በርሜል ምስጢር መያዝ አለመቻል)።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: መጠይቃዊ ቃላትን በተዋቀነት የያዘ ዓረፍተ ነገር ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: የጥያቄ ቃላትን (ማን፣ ምን፣ የት፣ ለምን ወዘተ) የያዘ ዓረፍተ ነገር ጥያቄያዊ (መጠይቃዊ) ዓረፍተ ነገር ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ነጠላ ዓረፍተ ነገር የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ብርቅና ድንቅ እንስሳት በሀገሬ ይገኛሉ» አንድ ብቻ ሀሳብ የያዘ ነጠላ ዓረፍተ ነገር ሲሆን ሌሎቹ የምክንያት/የተዛማጅ ሀረግ ስላላቸው ውስብስብ ዓረፍተ ነገሮች ናቸው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ድርብ (የተዋሃደ) ዓረፍተ ነገር የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ዝናቡ ስለዘነበ መንገዱ ረጠበ» ምክንያትና ውጤትን የሚያሳዩ ሁለት አንቀፀ ሀሳቦችን በማገናኘት የተዋቀረ ድርብ ዓረፍተ ነገር ነው፤ ሌሎቹ ነጠላ ሀሳብ ብቻ ያዘሉ ናቸው።

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is correct about virtue?
options: It's a habit beneficial to society.
It disrupts healthy functioning of society.
questions.explanation: Virtue is a habit or trait that benefits both the individual and society, unlike vice which is self-serving or destructive.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How do you differentiate virtue characters from vice?
options: By investigating if both complement each other.
By ignoring those socially conducive characters.
By validating if the characters is self-serving.
By analyzing if the character is beneficial to the society.
questions.explanation: Virtue is distinguished from vice by whether the character or behavior benefits society, while vice tends to be self-serving or harmful.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is the category of virtue ethics
questions.explanation: Moral virtue is a core category within virtue ethics, distinct from meta-ethics or applied fields like professional ethics.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following entails the concept of honesty
questions.explanation: Honesty fundamentally means telling the truth and being truthful in word and action.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Why would it be important to behave honestly towards other people? Because
options: everyone respects someone who is honest.
being regarded as honest is a sign of weakness.
honesty leads to mistreatment and abuse by others.
honesty is a way for disastrous end.
questions.explanation: Honest people earn the respect and trust of others, which is why honesty is valued in society.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Among the following one is the importance of virtue ethics
options: helps to distinguish right from wrong.
facilitates social evils in a society.
questions.explanation: Virtue ethics helps individuals distinguish right from wrong conduct, guiding moral behavior.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which importance of virtue ethics is related to boosting self-esteem?
questions.explanation: Virtue ethics fosters self-esteem by helping individuals build a positive, confident approach to life and their actions.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How would you become an ethically virtuous citizen?
options: By disregarding the moral values of the society.
By committing to help those in need.
By avoiding moral obligation of the society.
By acting contrary to societal expectation.
questions.explanation: A virtuous citizen actively helps those in need, reflecting core virtues like compassion and responsibility.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: A set of political arrangement in which all executive, legislative and judicial powers are concentrated at the center is
questions.explanation: A unitary state structure concentrates all governmental powers at a single central authority.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following best explains the characteristics of a confederation
options: it has a highly centralized power structure.
it's formed when nations form alliance.
it's a system where power is divided to central and local governments.
it's a system marked by decentralization of power.
questions.explanation: A confederation is formed when independent states or nations join together in an alliance while retaining most of their sovereignty.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: A system of government with an executive that is led by a president is
questions.explanation: A presidential system has an executive branch headed by a president, separate from the legislature.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following best describes the relationship between state and government?
options: State exists in the absence of government.
Government is one of the components of state.
State is an administrative machinery of government.
Government type is a determinant of states' existence.
questions.explanation: Government is one of the essential elements (components) that make up a state, along with territory, population, and sovereignty.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How could you explain the relationship between state and government?
options: Government is intrinsic while state is extrinsic.
Government is permanent while state is temporary.
State is concrete while government is abstract.
State materializes power while government represents it.
questions.explanation: The state embodies sovereign power in a concrete form, while the government is the institution that represents and exercises that power.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: All of the following are forms of government related to Ethiopian political history EXCEPT
questions.explanation: Ethiopia's history includes monarchical, military (Derg), and republican forms of government, but not a formally recognized oligarchic regime.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is true about the features of the military regime in Ethiopia
options: sovereign power is vested on the emperor.
replaced the feudal and monarchical system.
questions.explanation: The military (Derg) regime overthrew and replaced Ethiopia's feudal monarchical system in 1974.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following statement is correct about a democracy?
options: It occurs when we choose our representatives by influence.
Accepting the minority decision is its pillar.
The citizens have no say in electing the government.
Majority vote system is its integral part.
questions.explanation: Majority rule through voting is a fundamental principle of democratic systems.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following best explain the concept of popular sovereignty
options: only the consent of the governed is a legitimate source of authority.
the constitution of the state takes precedence over all other laws.
the promotion of check and balance among the three organs.
the right of the public to information about government activities.
questions.explanation: Popular sovereignty holds that the only legitimate source of governmental authority is the consent of the people being governed.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What would you do for the realization of democratic system?
options: Participation in a free and fair election.
questions.explanation: Active participation in free and fair elections is a key civic action that supports and realizes a democratic system.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Among the following one is the value of democracy
questions.explanation: Justice is a core value that democratic systems strive to uphold, unlike intolerance, oppression, or inequality.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Indigenous values and institutions are
options: a means to facilitate conflict and strife.
instruments to mobilize public for common goal.
mechanisms to disrupt peace and order.
irrelevant to elect local leaders of communities.
questions.explanation: Indigenous values and institutions traditionally serve to mobilize communities around shared goals and maintain social cohesion.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How do you think indigenous democratic values and institutions contribute to society?
questions.explanation: Indigenous democratic institutions often provide peaceful, community-based mechanisms for resolving disputes.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is the challenge of democracy in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Weak or absent strong institutions is commonly cited as a major challenge to consolidating democracy in Ethiopia.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Among the following major challenges of democracy in Ethiopia one can be averted by creating competitive political system
options: absence of access to media outlets.
questions.explanation: A competitive multi-party system directly addresses the absence of complementary and competitive roles among political parties.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: A constitution is
options: a law that rule individual disputes.
a law that settle conflict among states.
a supreme law of a land.
questions.explanation: A constitution is the supreme law of a country, taking precedence over all other laws.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following best explains the relationship between constitution and constitutionalism
options: constitutionalism is basic law of a land in the absence of constitution.
constitutionalism is possible without a constitution of a state.
the existence of constitution doesn't guarantees constitutionalism.
for constitutionalism to prevail having constitution alone is enough.
questions.explanation: Having a constitution does not automatically guarantee constitutionalism; the constitution must also be genuinely respected, limited, and enforced.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What solution would you suggest to alleviate problems associated with the absence of constitutionalism?
options: Government must strictly follow the constitution.
Government sometimes needs to take arbitrary decisions.
Government's power must exceed what is stated in the constitution.
questions.explanation: Strict adherence by government to constitutional provisions is the key solution to the absence of constitutionalism.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What criteria do you use to assess the significance of constitution?
options: Seeing the time of inauguration of the constitution.
Checking if the constitution limits the power of government.
Studying the amendment procedure of the constitution.
questions.explanation: A constitution's significance lies primarily in whether it effectively limits and constrains governmental power.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What is the importance of constitutionalism?
questions.explanation: Constitutionalism strengthens the protection of citizens' rights by ensuring government operates within legal limits.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: As responsible citizens, what would be the result if you uphold the principle of constitutionalism?
questions.explanation: Upholding constitutionalism helps democratic systems flourish by ensuring rule of law and accountable governance.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How do you determine whether a given constitution is written or unwritten?
options: Making sure if it is easily amendable or not.
Analyzing if it is practically implemented or not.
Checking if it is a single document or not.
Seeing if it is federal or unitary in form.
questions.explanation: A written constitution exists as a single codified document, while an unwritten constitution is not consolidated into one document.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What procedure should we use for constitutional amendment?
options: Formulating a new constitution from scratch.
Revising other laws to conform to the constitution.
Leave the constitution as it is without change.
questions.explanation: Constitutional amendment refers to the formal process of modifying existing provisions of a constitution.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: A rigid constitution is a constitution that is
questions.explanation: A rigid constitution requires a special, more difficult procedure to amend, unlike a flexible constitution.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What would you do to avoid the effects of the absence of constitutionalism?
questions.explanation: Promoting the rule of law directly counters the negative effects of a lack of constitutionalism.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is a civil and political right of citizens
questions.explanation: The right to life is a classic civil and political (first-generation) right, while work, education, and social security are economic/social rights.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is correct about Economic, Social and Cultural rights?
questions.explanation: Economic, Social and Cultural rights are considered second-generation rights, associated with equality and social welfare.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Identify the wrong combination of rights
options: right to security – civil and political rights.
right to health service – solidarity rights.
right to property – civil and political rights.
right to education – economic, social and cultural rights.
questions.explanation: The right to health service is an Economic, Social and Cultural right, not a solidarity (third-generation) right, making this combination incorrect.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: "In no way should one person be treated differently than the other." This statement implies
questions.explanation: Equal treatment of all persons without discrimination is the essence of the right to equality.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following statements is true about human rights in regional constitutions
options: few regional constitutions include human rights.
all regional constitutions incorporated human rights.
the rights in regional constitutions are different from the federal one.
regional constitutions are devoid of human rights.
questions.explanation: All of Ethiopia's regional constitutions have incorporated human rights provisions, generally mirroring the federal constitution.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How do you evaluate the inclusion of human rights in regional constitution of Ethiopia?
options: Regional constitutions adequately incorporated human rights.
Human rights are incorporated only in the federal constitution.
Regional constitution included human rights in 2023 G.C.
Civic and political rights are the only rights in regional constitutions.
questions.explanation: Ethiopia's regional constitutions have generally incorporated human rights provisions adequately, in line with the federal constitution.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a right incorporated in regional constitutions of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: There is no recognized "right against equality" — equality itself is a protected right, making this the incorrect/non-existent option.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one is a challenge posed on protection of human rights associated with harmful traditional practice?
questions.explanation: Milk teeth extraction is a specific harmful traditional practice that directly threatens children's health and rights.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What is a more plausible assessment in relation to human rights protection in Ethiopia?
options: There is no promising sign concerning protection of rights.
Human rights protection institutions are non-existent.
There are many problems associated with human rights protection.
Protection of human rights is more than satisfactory.
questions.explanation: A realistic assessment acknowledges that human rights protection in Ethiopia faces many ongoing challenges, though institutions and progress do exist.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following statements is true regarding peace
options: it's the absence of war and violence.
questions.explanation: Peace is fundamentally defined as the absence of war and violent conflict.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How do you analyze the difference between peace and conflict?
options: In the absence of peace, conflict won't prevail.
Conflict is always negative, while peace is productive.
Conflict is avoidable, while sustainable peace is unattainable.
Peace is the absence of fight and violent conflicts.
questions.explanation: Peace is best understood as the state where fighting and violent conflict are absent.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Tefera and Anteneh are best friends who disagreed over who is the best football player, leading to a heated exchange. What is the cause of their conflict?
questions.explanation: Their conflict arose from holding differing opinions/viewpoints about who is the best player, not property, needs, or expectations.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What do you think is a more sound statement concerning the cause of conflict?
options: Conflicts at home results from bullying.
Sibling rivalry is at the root of conflict at school.
Parents-child disagreement is conflict between peers.
Property & space is the source of conflict between siblings.
questions.explanation: Disputes over shared property and space are a well-recognized common cause of conflict between siblings.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Among the following one is correct about negotiation as a means of conflict resolution.
options: Involves a third party to assist the disputants to reach an agreement.
A method of settling dispute in which the third party makes decision.
A process of talking directly to one another for dispute resolution.
A method of resolving conflict through court ruling.
questions.explanation: Negotiation is a direct process where disputing parties talk to one another to resolve their conflict, without a third-party decision-maker.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: What can you point out about litigation that is different from other means of conflict resolution?
options: It involves a third party or person.
It is more expensive than other means.
It's the only means that involve making decision.
It's a means that doesn't need evidence hearing.
questions.explanation: Litigation (court process) is generally more costly and time-consuming than alternative dispute resolution methods like negotiation or mediation.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which of the following is true statement about peace building?
options: It occurs only after conflict happens.
It becomes effective when different stakeholders are involved.
Tolerance of difference is not crucial for peace building.
Peace building is just limited to conflict incidents.
questions.explanation: Peace building is most effective when it involves and engages a broad range of stakeholders.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Why do you think is peace building important?
options: To serve the interest of few disputants.
To promote preferential treatment of some.
questions.explanation: The core purpose of peace building is to establish durable, lasting peace rather than temporary or partial solutions.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How would you explain the role of indigenous conflict resolution mechanisms in maintenance of peace?
options: By using the judicial system of the state.
By employing force as a means of enforcement.
questions.explanation: Indigenous conflict resolution mechanisms typically rely on culturally rooted practices like forgiveness, tradition, and compensation rather than state courts or force.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: The process by which an individual applies previously acquired knowledge, skill and understanding to meet the demand of new situation is
questions.explanation: Problem solving is defined as applying existing knowledge and skills to address new or unfamiliar situations.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: From the steps of problem solving, evaluating the outcomes indicates
options: determine the root cause of the problem.
choose the option that best fits the problem.
assessing whether or not the solution is effective.
questions.explanation: Evaluating outcomes is the step where you assess whether the implemented solution actually solved the problem effectively.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is NOT a critical thinking step in decision making
questions.explanation: Selecting a single solution too early, without first identifying and weighing alternatives, skips a key part of the critical thinking process; the note in the guide should be double-checked against the class material.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following statement is true in relation to steps of critical thinking in decision making?
options: There is no need to identify alternative course of action.
Starting to implement the best alternative among many.
It's not important to review the outcome of decisions.
questions.explanation: Implementing the best alternative among several identified options is a genuine, correct step in critical thinking-based decision making, unlike the other statements which dismiss essential steps.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: How would you improve your skill of critical thinking in problem solving?
questions.explanation: Deep, careful analysis of issues is the foundation for improving critical thinking skills.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Among the following one is the habit of critical thinking and problem solving.
questions.explanation: A genuine habit of critical thinking is striving for deep understanding, in contrast to partial evidence use or closed-mindedness.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Which one of the following is a strategy for improving students' critical thinking?
questions.explanation: Trial and error allows students to actively test ideas and learn from outcomes, supporting critical thinking development, unlike the other clearly counterproductive options.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: Fulasa told Abera jokingly that there is no class today because of a football match, and Abera decided not to go to school. What would you do if you were Abera?
options: Avoid going to school like Abera.
Critically think before deciding not to go.
Tell other students not to go to school.
questions.explanation: Good critical thinking requires verifying information before acting on it, rather than accepting claims at face value.

questions.subject: citizenship
questions.q: One of the following is the importance of critical thinking in problem solving.
questions.explanation: Critical thinking helps individuals present well-reasoned, convincing justifications for their conclusions, based on sound logic and evidence.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of one of the following is a derived unit of measurement?
questions.explanation: Newton is a derived unit (kg·m/s²), while meter, second, and kelvin are base SI units.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: A certain plot of land has a length of 80m and width of 30m. What is the area of the land?
questions.explanation: Area = length × width = 80m × 30m = 2400 m².

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The measure of how closely individual measurement agree with one another is termed as
questions.explanation: Precision refers to how consistently repeated measurements agree with each other, regardless of the true value.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT true about the importance of scientific investigation? It:-
options: produces evidence to answer the questions.
is used by the scientists only.
helps to understand the natural world.
questions.explanation: Scientific investigation and its findings are meant to benefit everyone, not just scientists, making this statement false.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: "If I fertilize my plants, they will blossom." Which one of the following scientific procedures represents this statement?
questions.explanation: This is a testable, tentative prediction (if...then statement), which is the definition of a hypothesis.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Identify the one which is the ethical discipline of scientific investigation.
options: Cheating the scientific work of others
questions.explanation: Upholding a duty to society is an ethical responsibility of scientists, unlike exploitation, discrimination, or cheating.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following statements supports the discontinuity theory of matter?
options: This theory rejected the idea of atoms.
questions.explanation: The discontinuity theory holds that matter is made up of discrete particles (atoms), not a continuous substance.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The relative mass of proton is approximately:-
questions.explanation: The relative (atomic mass unit) mass of a proton is approximately 1, compared to the electron's negligible relative mass.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: For Aluminum, ²⁷₁₃Al, what are the number of proton, electron, and neutron respectively?
questions.explanation: Protons = atomic number = 13; electrons = 13 (neutral atom); neutrons = mass number − protons = 27 − 13 = 14.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following molecules is an example polyatomic molecule?
questions.explanation: CO₂ contains three atoms, making it polyatomic, while He is monatomic and O₂/HCl are diatomic.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Among the following statements, which one is correct about inorganic compounds:-
options: are the compounds of carbon only
are formed by decomposition of organic matter
are obtained from the constituents of the earth
questions.explanation: Inorganic compounds are generally derived from non-living, mineral constituents of the earth, unlike organic compounds which are carbon-based and linked to living things.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following formulas is the general formula of alkene?
questions.explanation: Alkenes follow the general formula CₙH₂ₙ, having one carbon-carbon double bond.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The chemical formula of pentane is
questions.explanation: Pentane is an alkane (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂) with 5 carbons: C₅H₁₂.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following groups of hydrocarbon represents a homologous series of alkyne?
questions.explanation: Alkynes follow CₙH₂ₙ₋₂: C₂H₂, C₃H₄, C₄H₆ fits this pattern (2×2−2=2, 2×3−2=4, 2×4−2=6).

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following is true when magnesium ribbon has burnt it over a flame of Bunsen burner?
options: Water solution of the reaction product turns blue litmus paper into red.
questions.explanation: Burning magnesium in air produces magnesium oxide (MgO), a basic oxide, along with a bright white light.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Among the following oxides, which one produces an acid when it reacts with water?
questions.explanation: SO₂ is an acidic (non-metal) oxide that forms sulfurous acid with water, while CaO, Na₂O, and K₂O are basic metal oxides.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Among the following properties, identify the property of bases.
options: Bases change blue litmus paper into red.
The pH range of bases is less than 7.
Bases change the color of methyl orange into red.
questions.explanation: Bases characteristically have a bitter taste, unlike acids which taste sour.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The acidic properties of an acid is due to the presence of:-
options: both hydrogen and hydroxide ions in the water.
any negative ions in the water.
questions.explanation: Acids release hydrogen ions (H⁺) in solution, which is the source of their acidic properties.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Na₂SO₄ is correctly named sodium sulfate; the other pairs mismatch the compound with the wrong name (CaCO₃ is calcium carbonate, Na₂CO₃ is sodium carbonate, KNO₃ is potassium nitrate).

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Human Body I: Skin, Muscles & Bones
questions.q: Which one of the following is true about the structural components of human integumentary system?
options: Dermis is the outer layer of the skin.
Hypodermis is much thinner than dermis.
Epidermis the middle layer of the skin.
Hypodermis lower layer of the skin.
questions.explanation: The hypodermis is the deepest (lowest) layer of the skin, beneath the epidermis and dermis.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Human Body I: Skin, Muscles & Bones
questions.q: Which one of the following human integumentary disease is characterized by watery, clear fluid-filled area on the skin?
questions.explanation: A blister is characterized by a raised, fluid-filled area on the skin.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Human Body I: Skin, Muscles & Bones
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT the function of muscular system?
options: Protect external structures of the body.
Maintain posture by overcoming gravity effects.
Transport food along the visceral tracts.
questions.explanation: Protecting external structures of the body is a function of the integumentary (skin) system, not the muscular system.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Human Body I: Skin, Muscles & Bones
questions.q: Which one of the following is inherited disorder of human muscular system characterized by muscle weakness and loss of muscle tissue?
questions.explanation: Muscular dystrophy is a genetic, inherited disorder that causes progressive muscle weakness and loss of muscle tissue.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Human Body I: Skin, Muscles & Bones
questions.q: Which of the following skeletal disorder occurs as a result of hormone deficiency, prolonged calcium deficiency, and sedentary lifestyle?
questions.explanation: Osteoporosis results from hormonal changes and long-term calcium deficiency combined with inactivity, leading to weakened, brittle bones.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Human Body II: Digestion, Respiration & Circulation
questions.q: What sequence of organs do substances pass through, as they move through the human digestive system?
options: Mouth → stomach → small intestine → large intestine → anus
Mouth → small intestine → stomach → large intestine → anus
Mouth → large intestine → stomach → small intestine → anus
Mouth → stomach → large intestine → small intestine → anus
questions.explanation: The correct digestive pathway is: mouth, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, then anus.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Human Body II: Digestion, Respiration & Circulation
questions.q: Which of the following digestive system disorder is caused due to excess secretion of HCl in stomach?
questions.explanation: Excess hydrochloric acid secretion in the stomach is a leading cause of peptic ulcer disease.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Human Body II: Digestion, Respiration & Circulation
questions.q: Which of the following respiratory diseases is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis?
questions.explanation: Tuberculosis is caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Human Body II: Digestion, Respiration & Circulation
questions.q: When you breathe on a clear lime water solution in a flask, the solution turns cloudy (milky suspension). This simple experiment demonstrates the exhaled air contains:
questions.explanation: Exhaled carbon dioxide reacts with lime water (calcium hydroxide) to form a cloudy precipitate of calcium carbonate.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Human Body II: Digestion, Respiration & Circulation
questions.q: The human circulatory system performs all of the following functions, EXCEPT:
options: transport nutrients and oxygen to the cells.
questions.explanation: Defending the body against pathogens is primarily the role of the immune/lymphatic system, not the circulatory system.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 6 — Human Body II: Digestion, Respiration & Circulation
questions.q: One of the following circulatory system disease results in death of cardiac muscle tissue?
questions.explanation: A heart attack (myocardial infarction) directly causes death of cardiac muscle tissue due to blocked blood supply.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following human reproductive structure and its function are wrongly matched?
options: Scrotum - ventilates the testes to have lower temperature.
Epididymis - stores sperm cells for maturation.
Vas deferens - used for transportation of sperm cells.
questions.explanation: The testes produce sperm cells, not egg cells, making this pairing incorrect.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The monthly discharge of blood with dead egg through the vagina is:
questions.explanation: Menstruation is the monthly shedding of the uterine lining along with an unfertilized egg, discharged through the vagina.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: What happens during fertilization?
options: Zygote moves to the cervix for implantation.
The egg is removed with blood through the vagina.
Sperm cell fuses with egg cell in the oviduct.
The egg moves from ovary to uterus.
questions.explanation: Fertilization is the fusion of a sperm cell with an egg cell, which occurs in the oviduct (fallopian tube).

questions.subject: science
questions.q: What is an ecosystem? It is:
options: a place where living organisms live and reproduce.
the interaction of biotic and abiotic factors in a given area.
the surface of the earth which is occupied by populations of different living things.
a group of populations of different species living together.
questions.explanation: An ecosystem is defined by the interactions between living (biotic) organisms and their non-living (abiotic) environment within a given area.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following biological association is correctly matched with its examples?
options: Predation - egret bird and grazing cattle.
questions.explanation: A tapeworm living off and harming a human host is a classic example of parasitism, correctly matched.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Consider the following simple food chain in aquatic ecosystem: Phytoplankton → Zooplankton → Fishes → Sharks. Based on the above information, which one of the following organism occupied the second trophic level?
questions.explanation: Zooplankton, which feed on phytoplankton (the producers/first trophic level), occupy the second trophic level.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following is true in feeding relationship among organisms?
options: Autotrophs cannot prepare their own food.
Decomposers feed on dead tissues of plants and animals.
Carnivores are grass and bush eaters.
questions.explanation: Decomposers break down and feed on dead organic matter from plants and animals, recycling nutrients in the ecosystem.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following soil type has a particle size between 0.002mm and 2.00mm in diameter?
questions.explanation: Sandy soil particles generally fall within this size range, being coarser than silt and clay particles.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following method is used to conserve water?
questions.explanation: Collecting and storing rainwater during the rainy season is a practical method of water conservation.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following gases is the highest component of atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of Earth's atmosphere, making it the most abundant atmospheric gas.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following human activities is the major cause for air pollution?
questions.explanation: Burning fossil fuels releases large amounts of pollutants and greenhouse gases, making it a major cause of air pollution.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: All are the methods used to conserve forests, EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Overgrazing damages vegetation and land, making it a cause of forest degradation rather than a conservation method.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The method of conservation in which animals kept in zoos and plants are grown in botanical gardens is:
questions.explanation: Keeping species outside their natural habitat, such as in zoos or botanical gardens, is called ex-situ conservation.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following is an example of indigenous knowledge and practices used to conserve our natural resources?
questions.explanation: Mixed cropping is a traditional indigenous farming practice that helps conserve soil fertility and natural resources.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following is different from the others in terms of solar system classification?
questions.explanation: Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet, unlike Mercury, Saturn, and Uranus which are full planets of our solar system. (Please double-check this item — the original wording was unclear in the source exam.)

questions.subject: science
questions.q: In our solar system the giant planet is:
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system, classified as a gas giant.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The figure given below indicates our solar system. Which planet is represented with letter Z?
questions.explanation: Based on its position close to the sun in the diagram, the letter Z represents Venus, the second planet from the sun.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: A satellite orbits a planet due to the:-
questions.explanation: Gravitational force between the satellite and the planet keeps the satellite in orbit.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following is correct about the motion of large bodies in the solar system? They move in:-
options: the same direction that the sun moves.
opposite direction that the sun moves.
questions.explanation: Large bodies like planets move around the sun in roughly circular (elliptical) orbits.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The planet that is closest to the Sun is:-
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun in our solar system.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: What makes the earth different from any other planets in the solar system?
options: It is the only planet that has large quantities of water.
It is the only planet that has season.
It has large quantity of oxygen in its atmosphere.
questions.explanation: Earth is unique among the planets in combining large amounts of liquid water, distinct seasons, and an oxygen-rich atmosphere.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Why earth is suitable for life, because it:-
options: is in a good location from the other planets.
has proper temperature right for life.
is rocky and has a lot of nitrogen.
is huge in size to hold everyone.
questions.explanation: Earth's suitable temperature range, resulting from its distance from the sun, is essential for supporting life.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The bending of light as it travels obliquely from one transparent medium into another is termed as ___
questions.explanation: Refraction is the bending of light as it passes at an angle from one transparent medium into another of different density.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: A device that shows different colors on the other side of its surface is ___
questions.explanation: A prism separates white light into its component colors, showing different colors on the other side.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following materials is translucent?
questions.explanation: Wax paper allows some light to pass through while scattering it, making it translucent, unlike opaque plastic/notebook or transparent glass.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: In which of the following cases sound can be formed?
options: When a string on a guitar is stricken.
questions.explanation: Sound is produced by vibrations, which occur in all of these cases: a plucked guitar string, a barking dog, and a blown whistle.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT correct about the propagation of sound through materials?
options: Solids are better transmitter of sound than liquids.
Liquids are better transmitter of sound than gases.
Liquids are better transmitter of sound than solids.
Sound does not travel through vacuum.
questions.explanation: This statement is false — solids are actually better sound transmitters than liquids, not the other way around.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The transfer of heat energy from a hot body directly without heating the space in between the two bodies is called ___
questions.explanation: Radiation transfers heat energy directly through space (even a vacuum) without needing to heat the medium in between.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The figure given below shows simple electric circuit. In the diagram shown above, the switch is indicated by number:-
questions.explanation: In the circuit diagram, the switch (shown with the break/contact symbol) is indicated by number 3.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: In which of the following devices, magnets can NOT be used?
questions.explanation: Magnets are used in refrigerator door seals, junkyard cranes, and telephone speakers, but not typically in a rifle's basic firing mechanism.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following agents of erosion is common in desert region?
questions.explanation: Wind is the dominant agent of erosion in arid desert regions, where running water, glaciers, and rivers are scarce.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: A mushroom shaped bodies of intrusive igneous rock is:-
questions.explanation: Laccoliths are dome/mushroom-shaped intrusive igneous bodies formed when magma pushes up overlying rock layers.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Forces that drive energy from inside of the earth's crust and forms ups and downs on the surface of the earth is:-
questions.explanation: Internal (endogenic) forces originate from within the earth and create landforms like mountains and valleys.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following atmospheric layer is responsible for the occurrence of all weather conditions?
questions.explanation: The troposphere is the lowest atmospheric layer, where nearly all weather phenomena occur.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Atmospheric condition of a place which are recorded for a short period of time is:
questions.explanation: Weather refers to short-term atmospheric conditions, unlike climate which describes long-term average patterns.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The two major controls of weather and climate in Ethiopia are:-
options: Altitude and Distance from the sea
questions.explanation: Ethiopia's climate is primarily controlled by altitude (elevation) and latitude, given its location near the equator with highly varied terrain.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT true about rain fall distribution in Ethiopia?
options: There is long and heavy rain fall in most of the high lands
Low lands receive high rain fall throughout the year
The main rainy season is summer or "Kiremt"
questions.explanation: Ethiopian lowlands generally receive low, erratic rainfall, not high rainfall throughout the year — making this statement false.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: A cultural element which enable people to talk to each other as well as to write thought and idea is:-
questions.explanation: Language is the cultural tool used for both spoken communication and writing down thoughts and ideas.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following feature characterizes manufacturing activities?
options: Small capital and small scale production
Small number of skilled labor force
Large capital and large scale production
Low degree of division of labor

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The developing countries economy is mainly based on:-
questions.explanation: Developing countries' economies are predominantly based on agriculture and mining/extraction of raw materials.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Agricultural activities of developed countries are characterized by:-
options: It is done by high number of population
It is highly mechanized and large scale production
It is produced for hand to mouth consumption
It is for domestic consumption only
questions.explanation: Developed countries' agriculture is characterized by mechanization and large-scale production, unlike subsistence farming.

questions.subject: social

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following can be the contribution of trade in Ethiopia economy?

questions.subject: social
questions.q: A type of trade which refers to exchange of goods between nations is:-
questions.explanation: Foreign (international) trade refers specifically to the exchange of goods between different nations.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following economic sector of Ethiopia contributes a lot for export trade?
questions.explanation: Agriculture, particularly cash crops like coffee, is the leading contributor to Ethiopia's export earnings.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: A various quantities of commodities which producers are willing and able to offer for sale is:-
questions.explanation: Supply refers to the quantity of a good that producers are willing and able to offer for sale at a given price.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which of the following express the "Law of Supply"?
options: There is a direct relationship between price of commodity and supply.
There is no relationship between price and commodity.
Price and commodity are indirectly related.
When the price a commodity raises quantity supplied by sellers fall.
questions.explanation: The Law of Supply states that price and quantity supplied are directly related — as price rises, supply rises.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The money received by a government from taxes and non-taxes sources is:-
questions.explanation: Government revenue is the total money collected from both tax and non-tax sources.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following is levied by the governments on their citizens?
questions.explanation: Taxes are compulsory payments levied by governments on their citizens.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: "The consumer is to be protected against any unfair practice of trade". This implies:-
questions.explanation: Protecting consumers from unfair trade practices is the essence of consumers' rights.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: A capital budget of a country is usually financed by:-
questions.explanation: Capital budgets, which fund large infrastructure and development projects, are often financed through external loans and grants.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT true about uses of minerals?
options: They are raw materials for industries.
They are used for making fertilizers.
They are more of man made.
questions.explanation: Minerals are naturally occurring substances, not man-made, making this statement false.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Over-exploitation of natural resources are mainly caused by:-
questions.explanation: Over-population increases demand on natural resources, leading to their over-exploitation.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Why the consumption pattern of resource is changing through time?
options: Increase in demand on using resources is never ending.
Human needs and wants are limited.
People do not need to satisfy their own needs.
People are less depends on resources.
questions.explanation: Human demand for resources keeps growing continuously, driving changes in consumption patterns over time.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Act of protecting earth's natural resources for current and future generation is:-

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The most common measure of protecting soil erosion among the "Konso" People are:-

questions.subject: social
questions.q: An approach of soil conservation leaving the farm Idle for until the soil regain its fertility is:-
questions.explanation: Fallowing is the practice of leaving farmland unplanted for a period to allow the soil to regain fertility.

questions.q: How resource conflicts are resolved in Ethiopia peacefully?
questions.explanation: Peaceful resolution of resource conflicts in Ethiopia is typically achieved through negotiation and avoidance strategies.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: One of the following can NOT be impacts of climate change in Ethiopia?
options: It causes loss of human life
questions.explanation: Climate change is generally associated with decreased, not increased, agricultural productivity, making this the exception.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Planting trees in the place where there was no plant cover in the past is:-
questions.explanation: Afforestation is planting trees in an area that previously had no forest cover, unlike reforestation which replants a previously forested area.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Among the methods of development of climatic action, which one is related to once lost forest are Regained?
questions.explanation: Reforestation specifically refers to replanting trees in areas where forest was previously lost.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Burning of natural gases, Fuels, coal and oil causes:-
questions.explanation: Burning fossil fuels (gas, coal, oil) releases pollutants into the atmosphere, directly causing air pollution.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which of the following is CORRECT about the explorers and their role?
questions.explanation: Ferdinand Magellan's expedition was the first to circumnavigate the globe, correctly matching explorer to achievement.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The term Renaissance explains
options: Intellectual movement began in the 14th c China
Movement focused on avoiding use of reasoning to advance knowledge
The rebirth of Greco-Roman art and literature

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which of the following is TRUE about Reformation?
options: It was an intellectual movement led to scientific invention
It was a religious movement began in the 16th by Martin Luther
It was a religious movement led to the separation of Catholic Church from the Orthodox
It declared the Pope is the final authority in religious matters

questions.subject: social
questions.q: During Industrial Revolution human beings began
options: To use manual labor than machine
To replace animals as a source of energy
To use new source of energy and technology
To apply simple hand tools than machines
questions.explanation: The Industrial Revolution was marked by the adoption of new energy sources (like steam power) and new technologies, replacing manual labor and simple tools.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Among the following which one is the political effect of WWI?

Establishment of new states after defeat of Ottoman Turkey
Loss of more than 10 million human lives

questions.subject: social
questions.q: International organization found after WWII to protect world peace?
questions.explanation: The United Nations was established after WWII specifically to maintain international peace and security.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The German military war plan applied during WW.I?
questions.explanation: Germany applied the Schlieffen Plan, a military strategy for a quick two-front war, during WWI.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The Cold War was propaganda war between the Socialist and capitalist Camps led by
questions.explanation: The Cold War was primarily a rivalry and propaganda conflict between the USA (capitalist camp) and the USSR (socialist camp).

questions.subject: social
questions.q: In which part of the world bloodiest slave revolt movement held and liberated them from slavery
options: British colonies of Caribbean like Haiti and Jamaica.
questions.explanation: The Caribbean, particularly the Haitian Revolution, saw the bloodiest and most successful slave revolt that led to liberation from slavery.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Why anti-slavery movement which led to an opposition against slavery and slave trade grown? Because
options: Slavery had exploitative, inhuman, harsh and tragic nature
Slavery was practiced by interest of the blacks
Slaves were to were implemented by the will of God
Slaves were passive to demand their liberation

questions.subject: social
questions.q: What was the purpose of Berlin Conference of 1884-85?
options: To invite Africans in the colorization process
To colonize Africa only in armed conflict
To avoid conflict among European colonizers of Africa
To allow Germany and Italy to take colonies from Africa and Asia

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Why European countries mainly interested to colonize Africa?
options: To get raw materials for their industries
To support Africans to be industrialize
questions.explanation: The primary economic motive for European colonization of Africa was to obtain raw materials for their growing industries.

questions.q: The only African state successfully resisted and defeated colonial force and preserved its independence successfully
questions.explanation: Ethiopia successfully defeated Italian colonial forces (notably at the Battle of Adwa) and preserved its independence.

questions.chapter: Chapter 10 — African Unity & Ethiopian Political History

To promote European colonialism in Africa
To isolate African foreign relations from the whole world

questions.chapter: Chapter 10 — African Unity & Ethiopian Political History

questions.explanation: The Organization of African Unity (OAU), founded in 1963, was a landmark achievement in Africa's struggle for independence and unity.

questions.subject: social
questions.chapter: Chapter 10 — African Unity & Ethiopian Political History
questions.q: Why Emperor Tewodros II launched military campaigns against regional lords?
options: To help them to build strong army
To protect them from foreign powers
To unify and centralize the imperial power

questions.subject: social
questions.chapter: Chapter 10 — African Unity & Ethiopian Political History
questions.q: The 1889 Battle of Matamma was a war fought between
questions.explanation: The Battle of Metemma (1889) was fought between Emperor Yohannes IV and the Sudanese Mahdist forces, where Yohannes was killed.

questions.subject: social
questions.chapter: Chapter 10 — African Unity & Ethiopian Political History
questions.q: Wuchale Treaty, Article XVII led Ethiopia-Italy to the Battle of Adwa because
options: Italian version reduced Ethiopian free status to be under Italy
The treaty had no contradicting meaning
Italian version accepted the Ethiopian interest

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Modern institutions in Ethiopian Empire introduced and expanded during the Reign of
questions.explanation: Emperor Menilik II is widely credited with introducing and expanding modern institutions in Ethiopia, such as schools, banks, and infrastructure.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The long distance trade route which linked Ethiopia to the outside world starts
questions.explanation: Ethiopia's major long-distance trade routes, carrying goods like coffee and ivory, originated in the resource-rich south-west.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: One of following lines shows the long distance trade that connects Ethiopia across the east to outside world?
questions.explanation: The classic eastern trade route passed through Harar to the port of Zeila on the Red Sea coast, connecting Ethiopia to outside trade.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: British official mission came to Ethiopia in 1805 and made Treaty of Friendship and Commerce with Ras Wolda Sellassie of Tigray
questions.explanation: Henry Salt led the British mission to Ethiopia in 1805 that established a Treaty of Friendship and Commerce with Ras Wolde Selassie of Tigray.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: The British military General led his forces against Tewodros in 1868 at Maqdela.
questions.explanation: General Robert Napier led the British military expedition against Emperor Tewodros II at the Battle of Magdala in 1868.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Ethiopians defeated Italian expansionist forces for the first time at the Battle of
questions.explanation: Ethiopians first defeated Italian expansionist forces at the Battle of Dogali in 1887, under Ras Alula — before the more famous victory at Adwa in 1896.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which of the following battle is CORRECTLY associated with the event?
options: Battle of Dogali—Ras Alula defeated Italians
Battle of Dabarki-Ethiopian forces defeated the Mahadists
Battle of Maqdala-forces of Tewodros II defeated British
Battle of Gundet-Mahadists defeated Yohannis IV

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which factor contributed for Italian Fascist to succeed in 1935/6 invasion?
options: Ethiopian wants to be under the rule of Italians
Ethiopians at large number became banda
questions.explanation: Italy's use of modern weapons, including aircraft and chemical weapons, gave it a decisive advantage in the 1935/6 invasion of Ethiopia.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: During the Italian occupation period those who work with Italians but Secretly supported patriots were
questions.explanation: "Yewist arbegnoch" (inside patriots) were those who outwardly worked with the Italian occupiers while secretly supporting the Ethiopian resistance.

questions.subject: social
questions.q: Which of the following neighboring country invaded Ethiopia in 1977-78?
questions.explanation: Somalia invaded Ethiopia's Ogaden region in 1977-78, in what became known as the Ogaden War.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT the function of our skin?
options: Let germs & dirt get into our body
Protect the inside body part from drying
questions.explanation: The passage says skin keeps germs and dirt OUT of our body, not lets them in — so this is NOT a real function.
questions.passage:
Reading passage — "Our Skin":

Our skin is a layer of tissues that cover our body from head to toe. It protects our muscles and organs. It keeps the insides of our body from drying out. It keeps germs and dirt from getting inside our body. It helps control our body temperature.

Our skin can feel when it is touched. It can feel changes in temperature. It can feel pressure and pain. Our skin has two main layers. The outer layer is called the epidermis. The inner layer is called the dermis. It has sweat glands, blood vessels, oil glands, hair roots, and nerves. Sweat glands release sweat through small holes in our skin called pores. Sweat cools our skin as it dries. When we are cold, the blood vessels near the surface of our skin become narrow. This helps us stay warmer for a longer time. The blood flows more slowly, and our body gives off less heat.

We have oil glands. They produce oil that helps our skin stay soft. As we become a teenager, our oil glands make more oil. This can cause pimples or spots on our skin. Our skin also has hair roots. The part of our hair we can see is no longer living. That is why it doesn't hurt to get a haircut.

Our skin has the amazing ability to grow back together. If we cut ourselves, a coating will form. It covers the cut until new skin can grow back underneath. If the cut is very deep, we may have a scar on our skin. Let's take care of our skin by keeping it clean and wearing sunscreen to protect it from the sun when we go outside.
