Reading passage — "Our Skin":

Our skin is a layer of tissues that cover our body from head to toe. It protects our muscles and organs. It keeps the insides of our body from drying out. It keeps germs and dirt from getting inside our body. It helps control our body temperature.

Our skin can feel when it is touched. It can feel changes in temperature. It can feel pressure and pain. Our skin has two main layers. The outer layer is called the epidermis. The inner layer is called the dermis. It has sweat glands, blood vessels, oil glands, hair roots, and nerves. Sweat glands release sweat through small holes in our skin called pores. Sweat cools our skin as it dries. When we are cold, the blood vessels near the surface of our skin become narrow. This helps us stay warmer for a longer time. The blood flows more slowly, and our body gives off less heat.

We have oil glands. They produce oil that helps our skin stay soft. As we become a teenager, our oil glands make more oil. This can cause pimples or spots on our skin. Our skin also has hair roots. The part of our hair we can see is no longer living. That is why it doesn't hurt to get a haircut.

Our skin has the amazing ability to grow back together. If we cut ourselves, a coating will form. It covers the cut until new skin can grow back underneath. If the cut is very deep, we may have a scar on our skin. Let's take care of our skin by keeping it clean and wearing sunscreen to protect it from the sun when we go outside.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: A dog is bigger than a cat, but smaller than a lion. This means:
options: A dog is bigger than a cat.
A dog is bigger than a lion.
A cat is bigger than a lion.
A lion is bigger than a dog.
questions.explanation: Since a dog is smaller than a lion, it follows logically that a lion is bigger than a dog.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Degu is an Ethiopian, but Liza isn't. She is an American.
questions.explanation: Since Degu is Ethiopian (and Liza, not Degu, is American), it follows that Degu isn't an American.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: His way of spending money is economical. He uses his salary wisely.
questions.explanation: "Economical" (using money wisely) is closest in meaning to "reasonable" spending.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: In order to be disciplined, students have to respect their schools' rules and regulations.
questions.explanation: "Rules and regulations" is closest in meaning to "instructions".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Some wild animals are becoming extinct because people are destroying their habitat.
questions.explanation: "Extinct" means no longer existing, which is closest in meaning to "nonexistent".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Ethiopia is a native home for different species of trees.
questions.explanation: "Native" (original, not introduced) is closest in meaning to "natural".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: To be healthy, you should keep your personal hygiene.
questions.explanation: "Healthy" is closest in meaning to "well".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Please refer to the ---------- if you want to operate the machine.
questions.explanation: An instruction "manual" is what you refer to in order to learn how to operate a machine.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: The company should ---------- the payment to avoid salary differences among workers with similar jobs.
questions.explanation: "Equalize" the payment means making it equal, directly avoiding salary differences for similar jobs.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Many farmers in lowland areas ---------- mainly maize.
questions.explanation: Farmers "produce" (grow) crops like maize as their main agricultural activity.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Speaking language is a ---------- character of humans among animals.
questions.explanation: Language is a "unique" characteristic that distinguishes humans from other animals.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Please ---------- when you ride on your bike. The road is slippery.
questions.explanation: On a slippery road, the sensible advice is to "take care" (be careful).

questions.subject: english
questions.q: According to the passage, owls find food in the dark using their senses of:
questions.explanation: The passage explains owls use their large eyes (seeing) and very good hearing to find food in the dark.
questions.passage:
Reading passage — "Owls":

Most human beings are awake during the day and sleep all night. Owls live the opposite way. Owls are nocturnal. This means that they sleep all day and stay awake at night. Because owls are nocturnal, this means they must eat at night. But finding food in the dark is difficult. Owls have very large eyes. These eyes absorb more light than normal. Since there is little light during the night, it is helpful to be able to absorb more of it. This helps owls find food in the dark.

Owls also have very good hearing. Even when owls are in the trees, they can hear small animals moving in the grass below. This helps owls catch their prey even when it is very dark.

Like owls, mice are also nocturnal animals. Mice have an excellent sense of smell. This helps them find food in the dark. Being nocturnal helps mice hide from the many different animals that want to eat them. Most of the birds, snakes, and lizards that like to eat mice sleep at night — except, of course, owls!

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Based on the information in paragraph 3, which statement is correct?
options: Mice and owls hide from other animals at night.
Mice and owls look for their food at night.
Mice and owls often hunt snakes & lizards.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 3 explains both mice and owls are nocturnal and search for food at night.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Which one of the following sentences is in simple present tense?
options: The students are taking English final exam.
The students took English final exam.
The students take English final exam.
The students have taken English final exam.
questions.explanation: "The students take English final exam" uses the simple present tense form of the verb.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Hagereselam is ---------- than Yirgalem.
questions.explanation: Comparing two things requires the comparative form "colder", not the superlative "coldest".

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: When you cross a highway, you ---------- walk only on the zebra crossing.
questions.explanation: "Should" expresses advice/obligation, fitting the safety instruction about crossing on the zebra crossing.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Last week our teacher ---------- us a story about a rabbit and a tortoise.
questions.explanation: "Last week" signals the simple past tense, so "told" is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: She has ---------- her book at school. She is still looking for it.
questions.explanation: "Lost" (past participle of "lose") correctly completes the present perfect tense "has lost".

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Haile Gebre Sillassie, ---------- has won many gold medals, was a famous runner.
questions.explanation: "Who" is the correct relative pronoun referring to a person as the subject of the relative clause.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: My father ---------- goes to work on foot. He sometimes takes a taxi.
questions.explanation: "Usually" fits best, since he mostly walks but sometimes takes a taxi.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: I don't have the habit of drinking tea, so I ---------- drink tea.
questions.explanation: Not having the habit of drinking tea means he "rarely" drinks it.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: If my mother goes to the market, she ---------- me some fruits.
questions.explanation: This is a first conditional sentence (present simple + will), so "will buy" is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Last night was a cloudy night and it rained ----------.
questions.explanation: "Heavily" is the adverb form needed to modify the verb "rained".

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Farmers ---------- different agricultural products in the market.
questions.explanation: "Farmers" is plural, so the correct simple present verb form is "sell".

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: You ---------- bring your Id card whenever you come to the exam center. Otherwise you can't sit for exam.
questions.explanation: "Must" expresses the strong obligation implied by "otherwise you can't sit for exam".

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Last Friday, I ---------- to the cinema and watched a movie.
questions.explanation: "Last Friday" signals simple past tense, so "went" is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: "The man gave the report to the manager." The question form of this sentence is:
options: Does the man give the report to the manager?
Did the man give the report to the manager?
Does the man gave the report to the manager?
Did the man gave the report to the manager?
questions.explanation: The simple past question form uses "Did" plus the base form of the verb: "Did the man give...?"

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: Your house is always clean. I like the ---------- of each room.
questions.explanation: A noun is needed after "the", so "cleanness" (the quality of being clean) is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.chapter: Chapter 5 — Grammar: Tense, Comparison & Sentence Structure
questions.q: The whole nation is taking part in election because election is a ---------- issue.
questions.explanation: An adjective is needed to describe "issue", so "national" is correct.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: When the guests ---------- I was cleaning the rooms.
questions.explanation: The main clause is in past continuous ("was cleaning"), so the time clause needs simple past: "arrived".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Water these plants twice a week, ---------- the flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: "Likewise" means "in the same way", instructing the same watering routine for the garden flowers.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Asfaw: I have a strong headache.
Hirut: Drink a cup of coffee, please.
Asfaw: ----------?
options: do you have a headache, too
questions.explanation: Asfaw's natural follow-up, after receiving advice, is to ask whether Hirut also experiences headaches: "Do you have a headache, too?"

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Lemlem: Have you heard that our friend Abera is dismissed from school?
Kassa: I am sorry. ---------- What has happened to him?
questions.explanation: Bad news about a friend being dismissed would naturally make Kassa feel angry/upset, fitting "makes me angry".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Abebe: I am going to sell my old car for 250,000 birr.
Daimo: Oh, it's a good price, ----------.
options: I am afraid I don't agree
I am not sure about that
questions.explanation: Since Daimo calls it "a good price", the natural completion is agreement: "I agree with your idea".

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Interviewer: ----------?
Interviewee: It is very necessary to be healthy and happy.
options: How often do you keep your personal hygiene?
What do you do to keep your personal hygiene?
questions.explanation: The answer discusses necessity/importance, matching the question "How important is personal hygiene?"

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Debebe: Is Hawassa hotter than Arbaminch?
Azalech: No. ----------.
questions.explanation: Saying "No" to "Is Hawassa hotter?" means the opposite is true: Arbaminch is hotter than Hawassa.

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Sara: ----------?
Osolo: I am a teacher in a government school.
options: Why do you want to be a teacher?
questions.explanation: Osolo's answer states their job, directly answering "What is your occupation?"

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Zena: Have you ever been to Addis Ababa?
Merima: ----------.
questions.explanation: The grammatically correct short answer to a present perfect question ("Have you...?") is "Yes, I have."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Teacher: Can you tell me about yourself?
Student: Sure. ----------
options: My name is Hussen Ahmed. I am 15.
Why do you ask me about myself?
I can't tell you about myself.
questions.explanation: A natural self-introduction starts with the student's name and age.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: where / the guests / were / from
questions.explanation: The correct question word order is: "Where were the guests from?"

questions.subject: english
questions.q: the door / the gentleman / for / opened / her
options: The gentleman the door opened for her.
Her opened the door for the gentleman.
The gentleman opened the door for her.
Her the door opened for the gentleman.
questions.explanation: The correct sentence order is: "The gentleman opened the door for her."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: football / he / plays / with / his friends
options: He plays football with his friends.
His friends plays football with he.
He his friends with plays football.
His friends with he plays football.
questions.explanation: The correct sentence order is: "He plays football with his friends."

questions.subject: english
questions.q:
Rearrange the following jumbled expressions into a meaningful dialogue:
1. Kebede: OK, I will.
2. Lemma: Fine, how is your wife?
3. Kebede: She's fine.
4. Lemma: Please give her my greetings.
5. Kebede: Hi, Lemma, how are you?
questions.explanation: The logical order is: Kebede greets (5) then Lemma asks about the wife (2) then Kebede answers she's fine (3) then Lemma sends greetings (4) then Kebede agrees (1): 5,2,3,4,1.

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence that is correctly punctuated and capitalized.
questions.explanation: A simple declarative statement should end with a period: "She was born in May."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence that is correctly punctuated and capitalized.
options: I bought an expensive, large and new table.
I bought an expensive large, and new, table.
I bought an expensive large, and new table.
I bought an expensive, large, and new table.
questions.explanation: A list of three adjectives before a noun needs commas after each one: "expensive, large, and new table."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the sentence that is correctly punctuated and capitalized.
questions.explanation: The sentence must start with a capital letter, and "English" (a language name) is always capitalized: "He speaks English."

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the word that has the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is "expensive".

questions.subject: english
questions.q: Choose the word that has the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is "believe".

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «የዘፋኙ አቀንቃኝ ድምፅ ከራቅ ይሰማል» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ የተሰመረበት ቃል («አቀንቃኝ») ፍቺ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «አቀንቃኝ» ለአንድ ጉዳይ ግንባር ቀደም ሆኖ የሚንቀሳቀስ/የሚያስተባብር ማለት ስለሆነ ከ«መሪ» ጋር ይመሳሰላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «አለሚቱ ሲጣ ናት» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል («ሲጣ») ፍቺ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ሲጣ» ትዳር ያልያዘች/ብቸኛ ሴትን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: አንድ ቃል በዓረፍተ ነገር ውስጥ ተቀምጦ የሚያገኘው ፍቺ ምን በመባል ይታወቃል?
questions.explanation: ቃላት በገቡበት ዓረፍተ ነገር/አውድ ውስጥ የሚያገኙት ፍቺ «አውዳዊ ፍቺ» ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ቋንጣ» ለሚለው ቃል እማራዊ ፍቺው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ቋንጣ» ማለት ተዘልዝሎ በፀሐይ/በጭስ የደረቀ ስጋ ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «አንበሳ» ለሚለው ቃል ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አንበሳ በጀግንነቱ/በጥንካሬው ዝነኛ በመሆኑ ፍካሬያዊ ፍቺው «ጀግና» የሚለውን ያመለክታል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «እናቱ ሁልጊዜ ራራት ታሳየዋለች» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል («ራራት») ፍቺ ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: «ራራት» ማዘንን/ደግነትን የሚያሳይ ስሜት ነው። (የፎቶው ገፅ ትንሽ ደብዛዛ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «በዓሉ ላይ የተገኘው ህዝብ እልፍ ነው» በሚለው ዓረፍተ ነገር የተሰመረበት ቃል («እልፍ») ፍቺ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «እልፍ» ማለት እጅግ በርካታ/ብዙ ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ንዋይ» ከሚለው ቃል ጋር ተመሳሳይ ፍቺ ያለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ንዋይ» ገንዘብ/ሀብት ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ፋና» ከሚለው ቃል ጋር ተመሳሳይ ፍቺ ያለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: «ፋና» ብርሃን/የንጋት ብርሃን ማለት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ተደራሲ» ለሚለው ቃል ተቃራኒ ፍቺ የሚሆነው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: «ተደራሲ» መልዕክት ተቀባይ (ተመልካች/አድማጭ/አንባቢ) ማለት ሲሆን፣ ተቃራኒው መልዕክት አመንጪ የሆነው «አዘጋጅ» ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: «ለጋስ» ለሚለው ቃል ተቃራኒ ፍቺ የሚሆነው የትኛው ነው?
questions.explanation: «ለጋስ» ማለት በችሮታ የማይሰስት ማለት ሲሆን ተቃራኒው «ንፉግ» (የሚሰስት) ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ሁለትና ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑ ሰዎች ቀልደኞች ጣል ጣል እያደረጉ እርስ በርስ የሚያደርጉት ንግግር ምን ይባላል?
questions.explanation: ተዝናኖታዊ፣ ቀልድ የተቀላቀለበት የሰዎች መካከል ንግግር «ጭውውት» ይባላል።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በአንድ የውይይት ሂደት የሚሳተፍ ሰው ምን ማድረግ አለበት?
options: አፍ ላይ የመጣን ቃል ሁሉ መጠቀም
questions.explanation: የተሳካ ውይይት የሚገነባው ሌሎችን በማዳመጥና ሃሳባቸውን በማክበር ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የመድረክ ንግግር ሲዘጋጅ ተገቢነት የሌለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የአድማጩን ማንነት/ፍላጎት ግምት ውስጥ ማስገባት የመድረክ ንግግር ዝግጅት አስፈላጊ አካል ስለሆነ ቸል ማለት ተገቢ አይደለም።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: የመድረክ ንግግር ሲቀርብ መከናወን ያለበት የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ውጤታማ የመድረክ ንግግር የሚጀምረው ዓላማውን በግልጽ በማስረዳት ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: ቀጥሎ የቀረበውን ምልልስ የተሟላ የሚያደርገው አማራጭ የቱ ነው?
options: ለረጅም ጊዜ የተቀለበ በግ ስለሆነ ነው።
questions.explanation: ጋሼ የበጉን ትክክለኛ ዋጋ ስለጠየቀ፣ ምላሹ ቀልዱን ትቶ ትክክለኛውን ዋጋ የሚጠይቅ መሆን አለበት።
questions.passage:
ጋሼ፦ ይህ በግ ስንት ነው?
ሻጭ፦ ሃያ አምስት ሺህ ብር ነው።
ጋሼ፦ የበግ ዋጋ የበሬ ዋጋ ሆነ እንዴ?
ሻጭ፦ ታዲያ በግ ተራ ስንት መጣህ?
ጋሼ፦ ______

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በክርክር አቀራረብ ወቅት ተግባራዊ ሊደረግ የሚገባው የቱ ነው?
options: በተገቢ አካላዊ እንቅስቃሴ ብቻ ክርክሩን ማጀብ
ክርክሩ የሚቀርብበትን ቅደም ተከተል ብቻ መወሰን
questions.explanation: ጠንካራ ክርክር የሚገነባው በአሳማኝና በተጨበጡ መረጃዎች ላይ ተመስርቶ ነው።

questions.subject: amharic
questions.q: በክርክር ዝግጅት ወቅት ተግባራዊ ሊደረግ የሚገባው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ውጤታማ ክርክር ከመከራከሪያ ርዕሱ ሳይወጣ በትኩረት መቅረብ ይኖርበታል።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ 4,950ን በትክክል የማይካፍለው ቁጥር የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 4,950 = 2×3²×5²×11. በ4 ስናካፍለው ሙሉ ቁጥር አይሰጥም (4,950÷4=1,237.5)፤ በ5፣ 3፣ እና 2 ግን በትክክል ይካፈላል።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: የ12 እና "ግ" ትንሹ የጋራ ብዜት (ት.ጋ.ብ) 60 እና ትልቁ የጋራ አካፋይ (ት.ጋ.አ) 6 ከሆነ "ግ" ስንት ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: የ600 ዋና ዋና ተካፋይ ቁጥሮች ትንተና 2³×3×5^ግ ከሆነ "ግ" ስንት ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ጥንድ ክፍልፋዮች ውስጥ አቻ (እኩል) ክፍልፋዮች ያልሆኑት የትኞቹ ናቸው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከታች በቁጥር መስመር ላይ ከተጠቀሱት ፊደላት 1.8ን የሚወክለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 1.8 በ1.5 እና 2 መካከል፣ ወደ 2 ተጠግቶ ይገኛል፤ ከምልክቶቹ ውስጥ ለዚህ ቦታ የቀረበው "ሐ" ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: 0.32 × 0.4 እኩል ይሆናል፦

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: 1.25 በዝቅተኛ ክፍልፋይ ሲገለጽ ትክክል የሚሆነው የቱ ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ከ2⅗ ÷ ⅔ ጋር እኩል የሆነው የቱ ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ያለእኩልነት ገለጻዎች ውስጥ ትክክል የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: 2.56 ከ2.73 ያንሳል ስለዚህ 2.56 < 2.73 ትክክለኛ ንጽጽር ነው። ሌሎቹ ሁሉ ስህተት ናቸው።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: 3⅖ + 2.31 በአስርዮሽ ሲገለጽ ትክክል የሚሆነው የቱ ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: አንድ ነጋዴ ካለው 12.8 ሜትር ገመድ ላይ ግማሹን ቢሸጥ ምን ያህል ይቀረዋል?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: በአንድ ት/ቤት 120 መምህራን ካሉ፣ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ 60% ወንድ መምህራን ቢሆኑ የሴት መምህራን ብዛት ስንት ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ሀ=2፣ ለ=1፣ ቀ=3 ከሆነ 3ቀ + 2ሀ − 4ለ ስንት ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ቀጥሎ በቀረበው ሠንጠረዥ "ቀ" እና "ሽ" ኢ-ርቢዕ (inverse) ተዛምዶ ቢኖራቸው የ"መ" ዋጋ ስንት ይሆናል? (ቀ: 1,2,3,4 — ሽ: 240,120,መ,60)

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: የአንድ ወንበር ዋጋ 500 ብር ከሆነ የ25 ወንበሮች ዋጋ ስንት ይሆናል?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ቀ − 5 = 7 ለሚለው የእኩልነት ዓረፍተ ነገር መፍትሔ የሚሆነው የቱ ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ሽ + 3 ≥ 7 ለሚለው ያለእኩልነት ዓረፍተ ነገር መፍትሔ የማይሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሽ + 3 ≥ 7 → ሽ ≥ 4። ስለዚህ 6፣ 5 እና 4 መፍትሔዎች ናቸው፤ 3 ግን (3+3=6<7) መፍትሔ አይደለም።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ርዝመቱ 8 ሳ.ሜ እና ወርዱ 5 ሳ.ሜ የሆነ ራክታንግል ስፋቱ ምን ያህል ነው?
questions.explanation: ስፋት = ርዝመት × ወርድ = 8×5 = 40 ሳ.ሜ²።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ቀጥሎ በቀረበው ምስል የተመለከተውን ውስብስብ (ኤል-ቅርጽ) ራክታንግላዊ ቅርጽ ስፋት በሳ.ሜ² ስንት ይሆናል?
questions.explanation: ውስብስቡን ወደ ሁለት ራክታንግሎች በመክፈል ስፋቶቻቸውን ደምረን እናገኛለን። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: 5 ሜ² ስንት ሳ.ሜ² ነው?

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የአንግል መጠን መለኪያ መሳሪያ የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ፕሮትራክተር (protractor) አንግል ለመለካት የሚያገለግል መሳሪያ ነው።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ሹል (acute) አንግል ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሹል አንግል ከ90° ያነሰ አንግል ነው። 90° ቀጥተኛ (right) አንግል ስለሆነ ሹል አንግል አይደለም።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ቀጥሎ በቀረበው ምስል "ሽ" እና "ቀ" ተቃራኒ (ወደ ተቃራኒ አቅጣጫ የተዘረጉ) ቀጥታ መስመሮች ናቸው። በምስሉ 60° እና "ለ+40°" ተዘራርፎ ቢቀርብ የ"ለ" ዋጋ ስንት ነው?
questions.explanation: ቀጥ ለቀጥ የተቆራረጡ መስመሮች ተቃራኒ አንግሎች እኩል ናቸው፦ ለ+40=60 → ለ=20°።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: አንግል "ሁ" እና አንግል "ለ" ዝርግ (supplementary) አንግሎች ናቸው። አንግል "ሁ" 92° ከሆነ አንግል "ለ" ስንት ይሆናል?
questions.explanation: ዝርግ አንግሎች ድምር 180° ነው፦ ለ = 180−92 = 88°።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ቀጥሎ ከቀረቡት የሶስት አንግል ስብስቦች ውስጥ የቀጥተኛ ሶስት ማዕዘን (90° ያለው) አንግሎች ስብስብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሁሉም ስብስቦች ድምራቸው 180° ቢሆንም፣ 90° አንግል ያለው (ቀጥተኛ ሶስት ማዕዘን) ብቻ የመጀመሪያው ስብስብ (45°፣45°፣90°) ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ጠጣር ቅርጾች መካከል ጠፍጣፋ ገጽታ (ፍላት ፌስ) የሌለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ስፌር (ሉል) ክብ ገጽታ ብቻ ያለው ጠጣር ቅርጽ ሲሆን ጠፍጣፋ ገጽታ የለውም፤ ሌሎቹ ሁሉ ጠፍጣፋ ገጽታዎች አሏቸው።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: አንድን የመጫወቻ ኩብ (ዳይስ) አንድ ጊዜ ወደላይ ብንወረውረው ኢ-ተጋማሽ (ጎዶሎ/odd) ቁጥር የመውደቅ ዕድሉ ስንት ነው?
questions.explanation: ከ1-6 ካሉት ቁጥሮች ውስጥ ኢ-ተጋማሽ የሆኑት 3ቱ ናቸው (1,3,5)፤ ስለዚህ ዕድሉ 3/6=1/2 ነው።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት የመረጃ ስብስቦች መካከል ባለ ሁለት ሞድ (bimodal) የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: በስብስቡ 12,14,15,12,14,3 ውስጥ 12 እና 14 እያንዳንዳቸው ሁለት ጊዜ ተደጋግመው ስለሚገኙ ሁለት ሞዶች (12 እና 14) አሉት፤ ይህም ባለ ሁለት ሞድ ያደርገዋል።

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: መረጃ በጥያቄ ቅጽ (ቅጸ-ጥያቄ) ለመሰብሰብ ጥያቄው ሊኖረው የሚገባው ትክክለኛ ባህርይ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ጥሩ የቅጸ-ጥያቄ ጥያቄ ግልጽ፣ ቀጥተኛና ለተጠያቂው ለመረዳት ቀላል መሆን አለበት። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: maths
questions.q: በተሰጠው ባር ግራፍ ላይ የክፍል ደረጃዎች የተማሪዎች ብዛት ተመልክቷል፦ 1ኛ=60፣ 2ኛ=50፣ 3ኛ=40፣ 4ኛ=30፣ 5ኛ=45። ተቀራራቢ/ተመሳሳይ የተማሪ ብዛት ያላቸው ሁለት ክፍሎች የትኞቹ ናቸው?
questions.explanation: 3ኛ (40) እና 5ኛ (45) ክፍሎች ከሌሎቹ ጥንዶች ይልቅ ተቀራራቢ የተማሪ ብዛት አላቸው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — መገኛ፣ ካርታና የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጂኦግራፊ (Location, Maps & Geography)
questions.q: የኢትዮጵያ የኬንትሮስ (longitude) ስፋት ትክክለኛው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ኢትዮጵያ በ33°-48° ምስራቅ ኬንትሮስና በ3°-15° ሰሜን ኬክሮስ መካከል ትገኛለች።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — መገኛ፣ ካርታና የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጂኦግራፊ (Location, Maps & Geography)
questions.q: ለኢትዮጵያ ዋነኛ የወደብ አገልግሎት የምትሰጠው ሀገር የቱ ናት?
questions.explanation: ኢትዮጵያ ወደብ አልባ ሀገር በመሆኗ አብዛኛውን የወደብ አገልግሎቷን የምታገኘው ከጅቡቲ ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — መገኛ፣ ካርታና የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጂኦግራፊ (Location, Maps & Geography)
questions.q: የቪክቶሪያ ፏፏቴ በየትኞቹ ሁለት ሀገራት ድንበር ላይ ይገኛል?
questions.explanation: የቪክቶሪያ ፏፏቴ በዛምቢያና በዚምባብዌ ድንበር ላይ በዛምቤዚ ወንዝ ላይ ይገኛል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — መገኛ፣ ካርታና የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጂኦግራፊ (Location, Maps & Geography)
questions.q: የመሬትን ትክክለኛ ገጽታ (satellite view) ለማየት የሚያገለግል መተግበሪያ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ጎግል ኤርዝ (Google Earth) የመሬትን ትክክለኛ የሳተላይት ገጽታ ለማየት ያገለግላል፤ ጂፒኤስ ደግሞ አቅጣጫ/መገኛ ለማወቅ ያገለግላል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 1 — መገኛ፣ ካርታና የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጂኦግራፊ (Location, Maps & Geography)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ ደረጃ ትልቁ ሐይቅ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሐይቅ ጣና በስፋቱ የኢትዮጵያ ትልቁ ሐይቅ ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ስለ ሰው ስርዓተ ልመት (digestive system) ትክክለኛ ተዛምዶ የሚያሳየው የቱ ነው?
options: ትንሹ አንጀት - ምግብ መፍጨት የሚጀምርበት አካል ነው
ትልቁ አንጀት - ያልተፈጨ ምግብ ብቻ ይከማችበታል
questions.explanation: ጨጓራ ፕሮቲን-ተኮር ምግቦችን በአሲድና በኢንዛይም (ፔፕሲን) ይፈጫል። ምግብ መፈጨት የሚጀምረው በአፍ ነው፤ ትልቁ አንጀት በዋነኝነት ውሃ ይመጣል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: በስርዓተ ልመት ውስጥ ምግብ መፈጨት የሚጀምርበት አካል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ምግብ መፈጨት የሚጀምረው በአፍ ውስጥ በምራቅ ኢንዛይም አማካኝነት ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ትክክለኛ የስርዓተ ትንፋሽ (respiratory) ቅደም ተከተል የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አየር ወደ ሰውነት የሚገባው በአፍንጫ በኩል ሆኖ በቢይ ትንፋ (ትራኪያ) አልፎ ወደ ሳንባ፣ ከዚያም ወደ አየር ከረጢቶች (ሳንባ ጡቢዎች) ይደርሳል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.q: በአክስጅን የበለጸገ ደም ልብን ለቆ ወደ ሰውነት ክፍሎች የሚላከው ከየትኛው የልብ ክፍል ነው?
questions.explanation: በአክስጅን የበለጸገ ደም ከግራ ልብ ገንዳ (left ventricle) ተነስቶ ወደ ሰውነት ክፍሎች ይላካል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — መሠረታዊ ተፈጥሮ ሳይንስ (Basic Natural Science)
questions.q: ውሃ ከሚከተሉት ንጥረ ነገሮች ውህደት የሚገኝ ነው?
questions.explanation: ውሃ (H₂O) የሀይድሮጂንና የኦክስጂን ውህድ ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — መሠረታዊ ተፈጥሮ ሳይንስ (Basic Natural Science)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ልኬቶች ውስጥ ትክክለኛ ተዛምዶ ያሳየው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ርቀት/ርዝመት በኪሎ ሜትር ይለካል፤ ኪሎ ግራም የክብደት፣ ሊትር የይዘት መለኪያ ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — መሠረታዊ ተፈጥሮ ሳይንስ (Basic Natural Science)
questions.q: ድምጽ ሊተላለፍ የማይችለው በየትኛው ሁኔታ ውስጥ ነው?
questions.explanation: ድምጽ ለመተላለፍ መካከለኛ (ማቴሪያል) ያስፈልገዋል፤ ባዶ ቦታ (ቫክዩም) ውስጥ ምንም ማቴሪያል ስለሌለ ድምጽ አይተላለፍም።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — መሠረታዊ ተፈጥሮ ሳይንስ (Basic Natural Science)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ተመሳሳይ (homogeneous) ድብልቅ ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የአሸዋና ውሃ ድብልቅ አካላቱ በቀላሉ ስለሚለያዩ ያልተመሳሳይ (heterogeneous) ድብልቅ ነው፤ የጨው ውሃ ግን ተመሳሳይ ድብልቅ ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 3 — መሠረታዊ ተፈጥሮ ሳይንስ (Basic Natural Science)
questions.q: ከድብልቅ ውስጥ አልኮል ለመለየት በዋነኝነት የሚያገለግለው ዘዴ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አልኮል የመፍላት ነጥቡ ከውሃ ስለሚለይ በትነት/ዲስቲሌሽን ዘዴ ይለያል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: የኢትዮጵያን የአየር ንብረት ከሚቆጣጠሩት ነገሮች ውስጥ የማይመደበው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የሕዝብ ቁጥር የአየር ንብረት መቆጣጠሪያ አይደለም፤ ከፍታ፣ ደመናና ከባህር ያለው ርቀት ግን የአየር ንብረት ወሳኝ ነገሮች ናቸው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ታዳሽ የተፈጥሮ ሀብት የሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ደኖች እንደገና ሊበቅሉ/ሊታደሱ ስለሚችሉ ታዳሽ ሀብት ናቸው፤ ነዳጅ፣ የድንጋይ ከሰልና የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ግን የማይታደሱ (fossil) ሀብቶች ናቸው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ የውሃ ሀብት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ የሚያሳድረው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የዝናብ መጠን መቀነስ የውሃ ምንጮች እንዲደርቁ በማድረግ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ ያሳድራል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ የዱር እንስሳት ላይ ትልቅ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ የሚያሳድረው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የደን መጨፍጨፍ የዱር እንስሳትን መኖሪያ በማጥፋት ትልቅ ጉዳት ያደርሳል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ገና በስፋት ጥቅም ላይ ያልዋለው የኃይል ምንጭ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ኢትዮጵያ በዋናነት የውሃ፣ የፀሐይና የንፋስ ኃይል ብትጠቀምም የኒዩክለር ኃይል ገና ጥቅም ላይ አልዋለችም።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ በዋናነት የአካባቢ ብክለትን የሚያስከትለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ያለ በቂ ቁጥጥር የሚስፋፋ ኢንዱስትሪ ፍሳሽና ጭስ በመልቀቅ ለከፍተኛ የአካባቢ ብክለት ትልቅ አስተዋፅኦ ያደርጋል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: በኢትዮጵያ ድርቅን ለመቀነስ ዘላቂ መፍትሔ ሊሆን የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ዛፍ መትከልና ደን ማልማት የአፈር እርጥበትን በመጠበቅ ድርቅን ለመቀነስ ይረዳል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ የተፈጥሮ ሀብት ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሀውልት በሰው የተሠራ ነው፤ አፈር፣ ማዕድናትና ዕፅዋት ግን የተፈጥሮ ሀብቶች ናቸው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: የተፈጥሮ ሀብት ዘላቂ አጠቃቀም ዘዴ ያልሆነው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ደን መጨፍጨፍ ሀብትን የሚያሟጥጥ እንጂ ዘላቂ አጠቃቀም አይደለም።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 4 — የአየር ንብረትና የተፈጥሮ ሀብት (Climate & Natural Resources)
questions.q: ደረቃማ/ሞቃት አካባቢዎች በብዛት ከሚገኙ የኢትዮጵያ ዕፅዋት ውስጥ ድርቅን መቋቋም የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ግራር (Acacia) ድርቅን የሚቋቋም እና በደረቃማ/ቆላማ የኢትዮጵያ አካባቢዎች በስፋት የሚገኝ ተክል ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ብሔራዊ በዓላት ውስጥ በትግራይ ክልል የሚከበረው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: አሸንዳ በትግራይ ክልል የሚከበር ባህላዊ በዓል ነው፤ ፍቼ ጫምበላላ የሲዳማ ብሔር አዲስ ዓመት በዓል ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ሲዳምኛ (ሲዳኡ አፎ) የሚመደብበት የቋንቋ ቤተሰብ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ሲዳምኛ ልክ እንደ ኦሮምኛና ሶማልኛ የኩሽ ቋንቋ ቤተሰብ አባል ነው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከሚከተሉት ውስጥ ትክክል ያልሆነው ተዛምዶ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የሰሜን ተራሮች ብሔራዊ ፓርክ የሚገኘው በአማራ ክልል እንጂ በአፋር አይደለም፤ ሌሎቹ ተዛምዶዎች ትክክል ናቸው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: የተፈጥሮ ወይም የባህል ቅርስ ተመዝግቦ መጠበቅ የሚያስገኘው ዋነኛ ጥቅም ምንድነው?
questions.explanation: የተመዘገቡ ቅርሶች ቱሪዝምን በመሳብ ሀገሪቱን ከማስተዋወቅና የውጭ ምንዛሬ ከማግኘት አንጻር ትልቅ ጥቅም አላቸው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ቱሪዝም ለኢትዮጵያ ኢኮኖሚ ከሚያበረክተው አስተዋፅኦ ውስጥ ትክክለኛው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ቱሪዝም የስራ ዕድል በመፍጠርና የውጭ ምንዛሬ በማስገባት ለኢኮኖሚ ዕድገት አስተዋፅኦ ያደርጋል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ንጹህ ያልሆነ/ጎጂ ልማዳዊ ድርጊት ተብሎ ሊመደብ የሚችለው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ግግ ማስወጣት (ጡንቻ/ጉሮሮ አካባቢ መቁረጥ) በሳይንሳዊ መሠረት የሌለው ጎጂ ልማዳዊ ድርጊት ተብሎ ይመደባል። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት መካከል ለዜጎች ችግር ከሚፈጥሩ ጉዳዮች ውስጥ የማይመደበው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: የሕዝብ ቁጥር መቀነስ በራሱ ለሌሎቹ ችግሮች ተመሳሳይ ጫና አይፈጥርም፤ ሌሎቹ ግን ግልጽ ማህበራዊ/አካባቢያዊ ችግሮች ናቸው። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ደን ጭፍጨፋን ለመከላከል ከሚወሰዱ እርምጃዎች ውስጥ የማይመደበው የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ያለ ገደብ የእርሻ ቦታ ማስፋፋት ራሱ ለደን ጭፍጨፋ ምክንያት ስለሆነ የመከላከያ እርምጃ ሊሆን አይችልም።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት አንፃር ዝቅተኛ የነፍስ ወከፍ ገቢ ካላቸው ሀገራት አንዷ የቱ ናት?
questions.explanation: ከደሴት ሀገራቱ መካከል ኮሞሮስ በአንፃራዊነት ዝቅተኛ የነፍስ ወከፍ ገቢ ካላቸው ትመደባለች። (ማስታወሻ፦ ፎቶው ትንሽ ደብዛዛ/የተገለበጠ ስለነበር መምህር ቢያረጋግጠው ይመረጣል።)

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ከምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት ውስጥ በአልማዝ ማዕድን ሀብት ትታወቀው ሀገር የቱ ናት?
questions.explanation: ታንዛንያ ጉልህ የአልማዝና የሌሎች ማዕድናት ክምችት ካላቸው የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት አንዷ ናት።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ኢኮኖሚ መሠረት ሆኖ የሚያገለግለው ዋነኛ ዘርፍ የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ግብርና በአብዛኞቹ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ሀገራት የኢኮኖሚ መሠረት ሆኖ ያገለግላል።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: ቡና ውስጥ የሚገኝና ሰውነትን የሚያነቃቃ ንጥረ ነገር የቱ ነው?
questions.explanation: ካፌይን በቡና ውስጥ የሚገኝ ማነቃቂያ ንጥረ ነገር ነው።

questions.subject: science6
questions.chapter: ምዕራፍ 5 — ማህበራዊ፣ ባህላዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮች (Social, Cultural & Economic Issues)
questions.q: በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ተደጋጋሚ ድርቅ ከሚያጋጥማቸው ሀገራት ውስጥ አንዷ የቱ ናት?
questions.explanation: ሶማሊያ ደረቃማ የአየር ንብረት ስላላት በተደጋጋሚ ለከፋ ድርቅ ትጋለጣለች።

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: The set of all even natural numbers is an infinite set.
questions.explanation: Even natural numbers (2, 4, 6, …) never stop, so the set is infinite.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: Every non-empty subset of ℕ has a smallest element.
questions.explanation: This is the Well-Ordering Principle for the natural numbers.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: Every integer can be identified with a rational number.
questions.explanation: Any integer n can be written as n/1, which is a rational number.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: For each rational number, one can find the very next rational number.
questions.explanation: Rational numbers are dense — between any two rationals there is another, so no rational number has an immediate "next" one.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: There is no largest rational number.
questions.explanation: For any rational number you name, adding 1 gives a larger one, so no largest rational number exists.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: Between any two rational numbers, there is an integer.
questions.explanation: Not always — e.g. between 1/4 and 1/3 there is no integer at all.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following is a perfect square?
questions.explanation: 7² = 49. The others (30, 42, 12) are not perfect squares.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a perfect square?
questions.explanation: 64 = 8², 100 = 10², 144 = 12², but 72 is not a perfect square.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The sum of the squares of three consecutive natural numbers is 50. What are the numbers?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The sum of the squares of three consecutive natural numbers is 77. What are the numbers?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: 64 can correctly be written as which pair of powers?
questions.explanation: 2⁶ = 64 and 4³ = 64, so both expressions equal 64.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The side length of a cube is 25 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube = side³ = 25³ = 15,625 cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The side length of a cube is 40 cm. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube = side³ = 40³ = 64,000 cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Solve the inequality: 2(x − 3) − 5 < 4(x − 5)

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Find the solution set of 3x − 3 < −6 for x ∈ W (whole numbers).
questions.explanation: 3x < −3 → x < −1. No whole number (0, 1, 2, …) is less than −1.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Find the solution set of 7x + 6 ≤ 3x + 2 for x ∈ ℕ (natural numbers).
questions.explanation: 4x ≤ −4 → x ≤ −1. No natural number satisfies this.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Solve x − 4(x + 1) ≥ −13 − (x − 2) for x ∈ ℤ⁺ (positive integers).
questions.explanation: −3x − 4 ≥ −11 − x → −2x ≥ −7 → x ≤ 3.5, so the positive integers satisfying this are 1, 2, 3.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Solve 14(x − 4) < 8x − 16 for x ∈ ℚ⁺ (positive rationals).
questions.explanation: 14x − 56 < 8x − 16 → 6x < 40 → x < 20/3, and x must stay positive.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The population of a town follows P(t) = 95,000 + 75t, where t is years since 1995. What is the population in 2004?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Find the slope of the line through A(3, 7) and B(5, −1).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Find the slope of the line through T(1, 8) and R(9, 8).
questions.explanation: Both points have the same y-coordinate (8), so the line is horizontal and its slope is 0.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: In △ABC ~ △XYZ, AB = 25, BC = 20, and the corresponding sides are XY = k, YZ = 8. What is k?
questions.explanation: Matching angles give AB/XY = BC/YZ → 25/k = 20/8 = 2.5 → k = 25/2.5 = 10.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Find x that makes △ABC ~ △DEF, given AB = 4, AC = 8, DE = 12, DF = 3(x + 1).
questions.explanation: The scale factor is DE/AB = 12/4 = 3. So DF = 3 × AC → 3(x+1) = 3×8 = 24 → x + 1 = 8 → x = 7.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two similar parallelograms have sides 1 cm & b, and 3 cm & 7.5 cm (matching in that order). Find the perimeter of the smaller parallelogram.
questions.explanation: Scale factor 1:3, so b/7.5 = 1/3 → b = 2.5 cm. Perimeter = 2(1 + 2.5) = 7 cm.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two similar computer screens have corresponding side ratio 14 : 21. The smaller screen's perimeter is 42 inches. What is the larger screen's perimeter?
questions.explanation: 14:21 simplifies to 2:3. Larger perimeter = 42 × (3/2) = 63 inches.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Rhombus A (area 36 cm²) is similar to Rhombus B (area 64 cm²). What is the ratio of their side lengths (A to B)?
questions.explanation: Area ratio 36:64 = 9:16, and side ratio is the square root of the area ratio: √9 : √16 = 3 : 4.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Classify the triangle with sides 10, 15, 20.
questions.explanation: 10² + 15² = 325, which is less than 20² = 400, so the triangle is obtuse.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Classify the triangle with sides 9, 40, 41.
questions.explanation: 9² + 40² = 81 + 1600 = 1681 = 41², so it's a right triangle.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Can 6, 12, and 18 be the side lengths of a triangle?
options: No — it fails the triangle inequality
questions.explanation: 6 + 12 = 18, so the two shorter sides only just reach the longest side — this fails the strict triangle inequality (sum must be greater, not equal).

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right triangle has legs 5 and 12. Find the hypotenuse.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right triangle has legs 15 and 8. Find the hypotenuse.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right triangle has legs 15 and 20. Find the hypotenuse.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A rectangle has length 8 cm and diagonal 10 cm. What is its width?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A garage door is 12 feet high and 16 feet wide. How long should a banner be to stretch corner to corner?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: A diameter is the largest chord of a circle.
questions.explanation: The diameter passes through the center and is the longest possible chord.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: A tangent line to a circle can pass through the center of the circle.
questions.explanation: A tangent only touches the circle at one point and stays outside otherwise, so it can never pass through the center.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: The degree measure of a quadrant angle (quarter-circle central angle) is 90°.
questions.explanation: A quadrant is one-fourth of the 360° circle: 360°/4 = 90°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: A minor arc is greater than a semicircle.
questions.explanation: By definition a minor arc is the smaller arc — it is less than a semicircle (180°), not greater.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: True or False: A sector is the region bounded by two radii and an arc of the circle.
questions.explanation: That's the definition of a sector.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If m(∠ABC) = 120° (an inscribed angle intercepting arc AC), what is m(arc AC)?
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle is half its intercepted arc, so the arc is double the angle: 2 × 120° = 240°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: If m(arc AC) = 10°, what is the inscribed angle m(∠ABC) intercepting it?
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle equals half its intercepted arc: 10°/2 = 5°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: ∠ABC is a right angle inscribed in a circle. What is the measure of the arc AC it intercepts?
questions.explanation: The intercepted arc is double the inscribed angle: 2 × 90° = 180° — a semicircle.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Which of the following does NOT contain a chord of a circle?
questions.explanation: A tangent line touches the circle at only one point, so it can never contain a chord, which needs two points on the circle.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two chords intersect inside a circle. The arcs they intercept measure 50° and 70°. What is the angle formed at the intersection?
questions.explanation: The angle equals half the sum of the intercepted arcs: (50° + 70°)/2 = 60°.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two chords intersect inside a circle forming a 70° angle. One intercepted arc measures 128°. What does the other arc measure?

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right prism has lateral surface area 180 sq. units and altitude 4 units. Find the perimeter of its base.
questions.explanation: Lateral area = perimeter × height → perimeter = 180 ÷ 4 = 45 units.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right circular cylinder has radius 2 cm and height 3 cm. Find its volume.
questions.explanation: Volume = πr²h = π(2²)(3) = 12π cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right circular cylinder has radius 2 cm and height 3 cm. Find its total surface area.
questions.explanation: Total surface area = 2πr(h + r) = 2π(2)(3 + 2) = 20π cm².

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A cube has lateral surface area 64 sq. cm. Find its volume.
questions.explanation: Lateral area = 4×side² = 64 → side² = 16 → side = 4 cm. Volume = 4³ = 64 cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A right circular cylinder has base diameter 14 cm and altitude 10 cm. Find its volume.
questions.explanation: Radius = 7 cm. Volume = πr²h = π(7²)(10) = 490π cm³.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A cylinder's radius is doubled and its height is halved. How does its volume change?
questions.explanation: New volume = π(2r)²(h/2) = π·4r²·h/2 = 2(πr²h) — exactly double the original.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: The base circumference of a right circular cone is 6π in. and its altitude is 14 in. Find its volume.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A cone has slant height 13 in. and altitude 5 in. Find its volume.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter of the English alphabet is chosen at random. What is the probability it's a vowel?
questions.explanation: There are 5 vowels (a, e, i, o, u) out of 26 letters: 5/26.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter of the English alphabet is chosen at random. What is the probability it's a consonant?
questions.explanation: There are 21 consonants out of 26 letters: 21/26.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting all heads?
questions.explanation: Sample space: {HH, HT, TH, TT}. Only HH is "all heads": 1/4.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: Two fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting at least one head?
questions.explanation: Only TT has no heads at all, so 3 of the 4 outcomes (HH, HT, TH) have at least one head: 3/4.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter is chosen at random from the word "ETHIOPIA". What is the probability it's the letter E?
questions.explanation: ETHIOPIA has 8 letters, and E appears once: 1/8.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter is chosen at random from the word "ETHIOPIA". What is the probability it's I, A, or H?
questions.explanation: ETHIOPIA has 8 letters: I appears twice, A once, H once — 4 out of 8 = 1/2.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter is chosen at random from the word "ISOSCELES". What is the probability it's the letter S?
questions.explanation: ISOSCELES has 9 letters, and S appears 3 times: 3/9 = 1/3.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter is chosen at random from the word "ISOSCELES". What is the probability it's a vowel?
questions.explanation: The vowels in ISOSCELES are I, O, E, E — 4 out of 9 letters: 4/9.

questions.subject: maths8
questions.q: A letter is chosen at random from the word "ISOSCELES". What is the probability it's a consonant?
questions.explanation: The consonants are S, S, C, L, S — 5 out of 9 letters: 5/9.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following is NOT the contribution of Ethiopian scientists in the field of science and technology?
options: Practicing research as a source of development.
Discouraging the use of laboratory techniques to support industrial practices.
Developing new knowledge for technological discoveries.
questions.explanation: Ethiopian scientists encourage, not discourage, the use of laboratory techniques to support industry, so option C is not a contribution.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following statements best describes mixtures? Mixtures:
options: can't be separated by physical means.
are formed by chemical combination of components.
are combinations of two or more components in varying proportion.
questions.explanation: A mixture is made of two or more substances physically combined in any proportion; its components can be separated by physical means.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following local techniques is used to separate the mixture of peas and beans?
questions.explanation: Peas and beans are similar in size and weight, so sieving or winnowing cannot separate them; they are picked out by hand (hand picking).

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following statements is CORRECT about the relationship between elements, compounds and mixtures?
options: Elements and compounds are pure substances.
Compounds and mixtures are not pure substances.
Elements and mixtures are pure substances.
All elements, compounds and mixtures are pure substances.
questions.explanation: Elements and compounds are pure substances (fixed composition). Mixtures are impure because their composition varies.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Consider the following laboratory apparatus: I. Flask  II. Filter funnel  III. Filter paper  IV. Thermometer. Which of the above laboratory apparatus are used to separate a mixture of sand and water by filtration?
questions.explanation: Filtration uses a filter funnel holding filter paper, with a flask to collect the filtrate. A thermometer is not needed. NOTE: the pencil mark on the photographed page pointed to a different option; the scientifically correct answer is I, II and III — teacher to verify.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The combining power of an element or a polyatomic ion with other substances is called ______.
questions.explanation: The combining power of an atom or ion is its valence (valency). NOTE: teacher to verify against the official key.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: What is the correct chemical formula of a compound formed from aluminum ion, Al³⁺, and sulphate ion, SO₄²⁻?
questions.explanation: Swap the charges: 2 Al³⁺ (+6) balance 3 SO₄²⁻ (−6), giving Al₂(SO₄)₃.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: To identify a liquid substance, Masuntu determined its density by pouring a sample of the liquid into a graduated cylinder. She found out that the volume to be 35.1 ml. She also found out the sample of the same liquid to weigh 30.5 g. (Given the density of liquids as follows: Ethylene glycol: 1.114 g/ml, Toluene: 0.869 g/ml, n-butyl alcohol: 0.810 g/ml and Isopropyl alcohol: 0.783 g/ml). What were the liquid and its density respectively?
questions.explanation: Density = mass ÷ volume = 30.5 g ÷ 35.1 ml ≈ 0.869 g/ml, which matches toluene.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: A certain groups of Grade 8 students planned to determine whether the melting of sulfur is a physical change or a chemical change. They collected a test tube, a watch glass, a Bunsen burner, tong and powdered sulfur. They heated the sulfur powder. After conducting an experiment, then they reported their works to their science teacher. Among the following statements, which one is CORRECT about their observation of the experiment?
options: Sulfur dissolves when it is heated.
The physical state of sulfur changes when it is heated.
The chemical property of sulfur changes during heating.
There is no change when sulfur is heated.
questions.explanation: Melting changes only the physical state (solid to liquid); no new substance forms, so it is a physical change.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Consider the following general properties of elements: I. shiny or luster appearance.  II. not malleable and ductile.  III. low melting and boiling point.  IV. high melting and boiling point. Among the general properties of elements listed above, which properties best describe metals?
questions.explanation: Metals are shiny (lustrous), malleable and ductile, and generally have high melting and boiling points, so I and IV.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: In your school, a science club students collected Bunsen burner, match, tong, crucible and magnesium metal to conduct a simple chemical reaction by burning magnesium metal in air of oxygen. After the experiment, they found a solid white powdery substance. Which one of the following conclusions is correct about the above experiment?
options: Magnesium is burnt in oxygen without heat.
Burning of magnesium gives magnesium oxide as a reactant.
The substance obtained after burning magnesium is different from magnesium metal in property.
Magnesium metal and oxygen are products of the reaction.
questions.explanation: Magnesium oxide (white powder) is a new substance with properties different from magnesium metal, showing a chemical change. Magnesium oxide is a product, not a reactant.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Consider the reaction between sodium metal and water to give sodium hydroxide and hydrogen gas: Na + H₂O → NaOH + H₂. Which of the following particle models CORRECTLY represents the balanced chemical equation of the reaction?
questions.explanation: The balanced equation is 2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂. Only model D shows 2 Na + 2 H₂O on the left and 2 NaOH + 1 H₂ on the right, with equal numbers of each atom on both sides.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: Which one of the following is CORRECT about a microscope?
options: Both simple and compound light microscope uses a single lens system.
The hand lens is an example of a compound light microscope.
The compound light microscope has the magnifying power of two convex lenses.
The magnification power of compound microscope is lower than that of a simple microscope.
questions.explanation: A compound light microscope combines two convex lenses (objective and eyepiece). The hand lens is a simple microscope, and a compound microscope magnifies more than a simple one.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: A grade 7 student took an unknown specimen and put it on a microscope slide, added methylene blue solution to it and observed under compound light microscope with middle power. The student observed a number of spherical (round) shaped cells which lack central vacuole. The student realized that the unknown specimen was an example of a/an ______.
questions.explanation: Animal cells such as human cheek cells are round and have no large central vacuole; plant cells (onion, algae) are more regular/rectangular with a central vacuole. NOTE: the pencil mark in the photo pointed to another option; teacher to verify.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: Which one of the following is TRUE about plant and animal cells?
options: Cell membrane is an organelle that is found in all plant and animal cells.
Chloroplasts are found in both plant and animal cells.
Cell wall is a tough, rigid layer that surrounds an animal cell.
The cell nucleus is an organelle that is found only in animal cells.
questions.explanation: Every plant and animal cell has a cell membrane. Chloroplasts and cell walls occur in plant cells only, and the nucleus is found in both.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: All are common characteristics for living organisms, EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis occurs only in plants, algae and some bacteria, so it is not common to all living things.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: This table shows the relationship between the hierarchical levels in the classification of organisms. From the above table which hierarchical level is correct for the three organisms?
questions.explanation: Kingdom (I) is wrong for honey bee (Fungi); Class (II) is wrong for mango (dicot) and human (Mammalia, not Primates); Species (IV) is wrong for mango and honey bee. Only Genus (III: Mangifera, Apis, Homo) is correct for all three.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: Which one of the following is INCORRECT about the body plan of organisms that belong to animal kingdom?
options: Arthropods are characterized by having jointed legs.
The skin of Echinoderm contains many spines.
Annelids are also called segmented worms.
Vertebrates are animals without a back bone.
questions.explanation: Vertebrates are animals WITH a backbone; animals without a backbone are invertebrates.

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: The following is a list of organisms belonging to different kingdoms. I. Mosses  II. Euglena  III. Ferns  IV. Paramecium  V. Blue green algae  VI. Eubacteria. From the above list, which pairs of organisms are the common examples in Kingdom Protista?
questions.explanation: Euglena and Paramecium are single-celled eukaryotes belonging to Kingdom Protista. Mosses and ferns are plants; blue-green algae and eubacteria are bacteria (Monera).

questions.subject: science
questions.chapter: Chapter 3 — Microscope, Cells & Classification of Living Things
questions.q: Which one of the following is TRUE about the organisms and their living habitat?
options: Angiosperms are found only in a terrestrial habitat.
Bryophytes are the simplest groups of land plants.
Epiphytes are plants that grow in moist area.
questions.explanation: Bryophytes (mosses and liverworts) are the simplest land plants. Some pteridophytes and angiosperms are aquatic, and epiphytes grow on other plants.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: One of the following is NOT supporting evidence about the shape of the earth.
questions.explanation: Gravitational attraction is a cause of the earth being round, not observable evidence of its shape. NOTE: teacher to verify against the official key.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following is TRUE about the earth's crust?
options: It is the innermost layer of the earth.
It is the outer most and thinnest layer of the earth.
It is found below the mantel.
questions.explanation: The crust is the outermost and thinnest layer of the earth.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: What will happen on September 22 and 23 due to the rotation of the earth?
options: South of the Antarctic will have a 24 hours day light.
Day light and darkness hours are the same in both hemispheres.
Day light hour begins to decrease in northern latitudes.
Day light and night hours are equal for both hemispheres.
questions.explanation: September 22–23 is the equinox: day and night are each about 12 hours everywhere, so daylight and night hours are equal in both hemispheres. NOTE: options B and D are worded almost identically — teacher to verify which the official key uses.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following motions is a rectilinear motion?
options: A car moving on a straight line
A car moving around a circular path
questions.explanation: Rectilinear motion is motion along a straight line.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: A non-contact force that pulls objects toward the earth is a/an:
questions.explanation: Gravity acts without contact and pulls objects toward the centre of the earth.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: A moving body decreased its motion and gradually stopped moving. The motion decreased and the body stopped moving due to the effect of ______.
questions.explanation: A force (friction) acting against the motion slows the body down until it stops.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: The form of energy that is possessed by a body due to its motion and position related to the earth's surface is called ______.
questions.explanation: Mechanical energy is the sum of kinetic (motion) and potential (position) energy.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following is a renewable energy source?
questions.explanation: Biomass can be regrown/replaced; petroleum, coal and natural gas are fossil fuels and non-renewable.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following energy conversion processes occurs whenever coal is burned?
questions.explanation: Burning coal releases the chemical energy stored in it as heat (thermal energy).

questions.subject: science
questions.q: In which one of the following statements, are the components of scientific investigation and its descriptions CORRECTLY paired?
options: Identifying the problem – state the problem as a question.
Experimentation – a critical look through our sense organs.
Making observation – studying the organized material to discover the essential facts.
questions.explanation: Analyzing data leads to drawing a conclusion. In C and D the descriptions are swapped: observation is the critical look through the senses, and analysis is studying organized material. NOTE: option B is also a reasonable pairing — teacher to verify against the official key.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following ethical disciplines is required by researcher scientists in performing fair testing during scientific investigation? Researcher scientists should:
options: fabricate, falsify or misrepresent data or result.
not share data, results, methods and ideas to others.
make faithful estimates of the errors that remains.
questions.explanation: Honest scientists report their results truthfully, including a fair estimate of remaining errors; fabricating data, mistreating colleagues or hiding results is unethical.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following alternatives contains the units of derived physical quantities?
questions.explanation: Newton (force), joule (energy) and cubic meter (volume) are all derived units. Kilogram, second, kelvin and meter are base units. NOTE: the pencil mark in the photo pointed to another option; teacher to verify.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Which one of the following statements is the CORRECT description of the structure of an atom?
options: The nucleus of an atom consists of proton and electron.
Most of the mass of an atom is concentrated in the nucleus of the atom.
Electrons and protons are moving around the nucleus of an atom.
Neutrons and electrons are the main constituents of the nucleus.
questions.explanation: Protons and neutrons make up the nucleus, which holds nearly all of the atom's mass; electrons orbit outside it. NOTE: the pencil mark in the photo pointed to another option; teacher to verify.

questions.subject: science
questions.q: Of the following particle models, which one CORRECTLY represents molecules of a compound?
questions.explanation: A compound molecule contains atoms of different elements joined together (model D). Models A, B and C show only one kind of atom (an element).
